articles.title: Stephen A Smith debriefs interview with President Trump, warns Democrats face steep challenge

paras.en: ESPN commentator Stephen A. Smith debriefed his White House interview with President Donald Trump during an appearance Thursday on "Hannity" and cautioned Democrats over the influence of the party's far-left flank.
Smith said the pair discussed "devastating" GOP midterm losses during a 40-minute, wide-ranging interview and criticized Trump for refusing to take blame, saying he was "immovable" on that point.
"We talked about the devastating losses in the midterms and how the GOP essentially got slaughtered," Smith told Fox News host Sean Hannity.
"I asked him, is he willing to point the finger at himself, and he was dogged… he was immovable in that regard," he added.

Trump repeatedly told Americans during his midterm blitz to vote as if he were on the ballot, but Smith said the commander-in-chief removed himself from that narrative during their Thursday interview.

"He said, ‘I wasn't on the ballot.’ I said, ‘That makes absolutely no sense, Mr. President. You said, put you on a ballot. That's what you told the American people to do.’ He said, ‘Well, they didn't do it.’ I said, ‘Well, what if they did do it and that was the reason you lost,’" Smith explained.
"He refused to accept that," he continued. "His attitude is that the candidates were not that great. If it were him that was running, this would not have happened. That's his mentality."
Smith explained why he doesn’t agree with Trump’s perception of how the midterms played out and argued that the blue wave stems from Americans being dissatisfied with his presidency.
"I think that he is somebody that is convinced his way is what it is. I just don't agree with him," Smith said.
"I think the American people made a statement against what they were seeing from him in terms of him not having his eye on the ball and coming across as a bit detached in their eyes," he added.

Smith told Fox News that Trump also gave him pushback when discussing the impact of the Iran War and tariffs on voter sentiment and the economy. He also addressed speculation that Trump offered him the role of White House press secretary.
"That was absolutely hilarious," Smith said. "Evidently, they don't know about the life that I live and the kind of affluence that ESPN and Disney have blessed me with."
"I wouldn't take that pay cut for almost anything but the presidency," he continued. "That ain't happening. Press secretary? Please."
Smith, who has lodged criticism at both Democrats and Republicans, warned that the Democratic Party faces a challenge from its far-left side.

"I definitely think that right now, the Democrats have a challenge on their hands because clearly there's a lot of people out there that view the Democratic Party as a divided party," he said. "Now they will tell you they're a very big tent and there's room for everybody, but I think that the progressive left has shown you there isn't room for everybody."
"If you're not willing to capitulate to their desires, their wishes and their ideological beliefs 100%, then they got a problem with you," he added.
Smith called out Democrats who have declined interviews and expressed gratitude that Trump agreed to sit down with him for an interview.

"[Trump] was just very rigid and immovable in his thinking that it was blown by the people who lost and that the candidates on the Republican side simply were not good enough. It was not about him," Smith said.
"... I give him credit," he continued. "I asked a question, and he answered, and he didn't run from anything."

articles.title: Jayden Daniels throws three touchdowns as Commanders rally past Giants Thursday night

paras.en: Taking a cue from coach John Harbaugh’s stated goal of going 1-0 each week, Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers viewed Thursday night’s rematch with Washington as carrying extra weight after the teams tied last month in Week 5.
The Week 10 matchup was never tied, and Washington ultimately won 24-21, giving the Commanders a much-needed victory over their NFC East rival.

J.J. McCarthy made his first home start since joining the Giants in a late-September trade from Minnesota. The young quarterback played college football at Michigan under Jim Harbaugh, John’s brother, and finished Thursday night with one touchdown and one interception.
McCarthy finished the loss with career-high 293 yards. He also played Thursday night just days after injuring his right hip against the Philadelphia Eagles
McCarthy briefly left that game but returned to finish what became a 19-11 Week 9 victory.
Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels threw three touchdowns and two interceptions at MetLife Stadium to keep Washington's hopes of winning the mediocre NFC East alive.
Thursday's comeback win also moved the Commanders to two games back of the division-leading Giants and now own the tiebreaker after last month's tie.

Daniels getting picked off by Jevon Holland on his 208th pass attempt and Ar’Darius Washington on his 211th looked like it would haunt Washington, which allowed McCarthy and Isaiah Likely to hook up for a 66-yard, go-ahead touchdown midway through the fourth quarter.

But the Giants were unable to move the ball effectively enough on the ground to run the clock. Jameis Winston tried to get the Commanders to jump offside with a hard count of "Who Let the Dogs Out" — with a series of barks — but that did not work and New York kept giving Daniels the ball back by punting the ball multiple times.
The Commanders host the Cincinnati Bengals on Monday night in Week 11, while the Giants host the Jacksonville Jaguars the day before.
The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.title: Highly contagious bird flu detected in Wisconsin as officials euthanize infected flock

paras.en: A highly contagious strain of bird flu has struck a backyard poultry flock in Wisconsin, prompting officials to euthanize the birds amid ongoing concerns about the spread of the potentially deadly disease.
The Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection (DATCP) confirmed Thursday a case of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) in a backyard poultry flock in Rusk County.
Officials did not specify how the flock became infected.
DATCP said all birds on the property were euthanized and will not enter the food system.
HPAI, a highly contagious virus that is often fatal to domestic poultry, has circulated among wild and domestic birds in North America since December 2021, according to DATCP.
The disease is caused by influenza type A viruses and can vary in severity depending on the strain and affected species.
The virus can spread through contact with infected birds, wild birds or their droppings, as well as contaminated equipment or clothing worn by people working with the animals, according to DATCP.
When HPAI is confirmed in a backyard poultry flock, officials may establish a 10-kilometer surveillance zone, though surrounding poultry premises would not face movement restrictions.

DATCP urged livestock owners to take precautions to protect their flocks and herds, including washing hands, disinfecting equipment, restricting access to animals and separating new additions for at least 30 days.
The agency also recommended that poultry owners keep their birds indoors when possible.

articles.title: Children’s exposure to home wood-burning could be as significant as traffic exhaust, study suggests
articles.author: Gary Fuller

paras.en: Children’s exposure to home wood-burning could be as significant as exposure to traffic exhaust, suggests new research across six European towns and cities.

Scientists measured the air in buildings where children spend much of their time; in schools, sports centres and homes. Specifically, they looked at polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH), a family of pollutants that are given off when fuels are burned.

Dr Barend van Drooge, from Barcelona’s Institute for Environmental Assessment and Water Research (IEAWR) and senior author of the study, said: “Some of these compounds are related to cancers after prolonged exposures, as recognised by the International Agency for Cancer Research, and evidence exists that they delay cognitive development.”
Measurements were made in and around Athens, Barcelona, Colchester, Copenhagen, Helsinki and Lisbon.
Van Drooge continued: “Urban areas with wood-burning, such as Colchester and Athens, had the highest PAHs levels. Barcelona and Lisbon, where wood-burning is not practised, had the lowest levels.”
In Colchester and Athens, PAH exposure was greater than the World Health Organization guidelines.

Maria Antonia Aretaki, of the IEAWR in Barcelona and first author of the study, said: “Understanding the pollutants in children’s everyday surroundings is an important step towards protecting their health. Children are particularly important given their vulnerability to environmental pollutants and the potential health implications from exposure during childhood.”

Sports centres had the lowest concentrations. This was followed by schools, through some, especially those in Lisbon, were affected by nearby busy roads. Ventilation and indoor sources were important, but the homes with some of the greatest PAH were in areas with wood-burning, and many had open fireplaces and stoves.
Winter PAH concentrations were greater than summer.

The researchers divided the PAH into two types, according to molecular weight. In the Colchester homes, the high-molecular-weight PAH in winter were more than 10 times those in summer. The low-molecular-weight PAH were around three times greater.

Van Drooge continued: “Wood-burning is known to be an important emitter of PAH, but it was surprising that it has become such an important contributor to the overall presence of PAHs in urban areas. However, none of the cities exceeded unacceptable limits for lifetime cancer risk.”

Within the UK, the impacts of wood-burning are unlikely to unique to Colchester. Separate analysis of energy performance certificates by researchers at University College London showed that Colchester ranked 120th out of 333 local councils for density of wood burners per square kilometre. Worthing, Norwich and Reading all had around four times more.

A wintertime study of 53 children from two primary schools in Anglesey (Ynys Môn) found that children living in homes with wood burners could be exposed to over three times more particle pollution than those in non-wood-burning homes. The Anglesey study also found that homes had more air pollution than schools.

In Greece, wood-burning increased during the financial crisis that began in 2008. The cost of heating oil soared and many people turned to wood heating. This contributed to increased deaths associated with particle pollution in Athens, especially for those aged over 70. In some Greek towns, wood-burning leads to PAH that are 100 times greater in winter compared with summer.

articles.title: Victoria election 2026: Labor and Greens trade accusations of ‘dodgy deals’ as preference fight puts key seats at risk
articles.author: Benita Kolovos Victorian state correspondent

paras.en: The Greens have retaliated against Labor’s decision to run an open ticket in a key inner-city seat by refusing to direct preferences to the party in 15 electorates across the state at this month’s Victorian election.
The move has sparked a war of words between the two parties, with each accusing the other of striking a “dodgy deal” that could help the Liberals and One Nation get elected on 28 November.
On Friday, the Greens confirmed they would only be directing voters to number the Greens one and One Nation last across 15 electorates.

The decision follows Labor’s decision on Tuesday to run an open ticket in the inner Melbourne seat of Prahran, where the Greens had been counting on Labor preferences to win it back. It has been held by the Liberals on a tiny 1.3% margin – after the Greens lost it at a byelection in 2025.
At the time, the Victorian Greens leader Ellen Sandell told Guardian Australia that Labor’s “unforgivable” decision could hand the upcoming election to a Liberal-One Nation coalition.
A Labor spokesperson turned the accusation back on the Greens on Friday, mirroring Sandell’s language.
“In one of the most consequential elections in Victoria’s history – the Greens have done a dodgy deal to help elect a Liberal One-Nation Government,” the spokesperson said.

“This is unforgivable and Victorians won’t forget it’s Ellen Sandell and the Greens to blame when Jess Wilson cuts our hospitals and schools – and One Nation winds back our nation leading reforms on women’s rights and Treaty.”
The Greens responded by accusing Labor of “lying to Victorian voters”.
“The Greens will be putting One Nation last in every single electorate across Victoria. We always encourage people to vote in line with their values,” their spokesperson said.
“After months of scaremongering about a Liberal-One Nation government, it is Labor who have done a dodgy backroom deal with the Liberals that could help elect one.”

The 15 electorates where the Greens will issue these how-to-vote cards are: Albert Park, Ashwood, Bellarine, Bendigo East, Bendigo West, Essendon, Euroa, Gippsland East, Mildura, Mornington, Point Cook, Polwarth, South Barwon, Tarneit, Werribee.

Labor fears the decision will particularly hurt their chances in Albert Park, Ashwood, Bellarine, the two Bendigo seats vacated by former premier Jacinta Allan and speaker Maree Edwards, and South Barwon.
The Coalition, meanwhile, is quietly confident it will improving its chances of fending off One Nation and snatching seats from Labor.

However, Tony Barry the Liberal strategist turned pollster with Redbridge and co-host of Guardian Australia’s Back to Back Barries podcast, said most Greens voters don’t closely follow their party’s how-to-vote cards.

“Historical preference flows from past state and federal elections shows about 85% of exhausted Greens votes flows to Labor and about 15% leakage to the Coalition and that rarely changes regardless of the particular circumstances,” Barry said.

But he said in Essendon, where Labor candidate Kat Theodosis is contesting the seat following Danny Pearson’s retirement, in a complex race involving the Liberals, One Nation and three independents candidates, it “might be enough to flip the seat to the Liberals.”

Meanwhile, the conservative Family First party is directing its preferences to Labor candidates affiliated with the Shop, Distributive and Allied Employees’ Association (SDA), placing them second on their how-to-vote cards. The cards feature an image of a baby next to the Labor candidate name with claims they have a “pro-life voting record”.

It prompted Pasoce Vale MP Anthony Cianflone, who is in a tight race against the Greens’ Angelica Panopoulos, to post a statement on social media saying he supported “women’s right to make their own decisions about their bodies and healthcare”.
“That’s why I have supported the Victorian Labor government’s reforms protecting these rights”

Family First have also preferenced Matthew Guy last in his safe Liberal seat of Bulleen. The party’s state leader, Moira Deeming, was disendorsed as a Liberal candidate after alleging Guy had placed her in a headlock earlier this year. Deeming later conceded she misunderstood the technical meaning of “headlock”.

articles.title: Nvidia scandal sparks US national security furore and calls to take tough line on China
articles.author: Jonathan Yerushalmy and agencies

paras.en: Nvidia’s ousted CEO Jensen Huang and Donald Trump’s commerce secretary are expected to testify before Congress in the coming weeks, as the fallout from Huang’s reported affair with an alleged Chinese spy reverberated across the US, sparking bipartisan concerns for national security and calls for a tougher stance against Beijing.
paras.zh: 预计英伟达被罢免的首席执行官黄仁勋和唐纳德·特朗普的商务部长将在未来几周内在美国国会作证。据报道，黄仁勋与一名涉嫌是中国间谍的女子有染，此事在美国引起轩然大波，引发了两党对国家安全的担忧，并呼吁对北京采取更强硬的立场。

paras.en: Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer said Huang and Nvidia must answer as to whether America’s security had been jeopardised, adding that the Trump administration also must account for what it did once it learned about Huang’s reported relationship with Alice Huang, who is accused of spying for China.
paras.zh: 参议院民主党领袖查克·舒默表示，黄仁勋和英伟达必须回答美国的安全是否受到威胁，并补充说，特朗普政府在获悉黄仁勋与被指控为中国从事间谍活动的黄雪琴存在关系后，也必须对其所作所为作出交代。

paras.en: Donald Trump’s close ties with Jensen Huang have also come under renewed scrutiny as a timeline of the saga started to emerge. The president called Jensen Huang two days before he stepped down and urged him to fight for his job, the New York Times has reported.
paras.zh: 随着这一事件的时间线开始浮出水面，唐纳德·特朗普与黄仁勋的密切关系也再次受到关注。据《纽约时报》报道，总统在黄仁勋离职前两天曾致电他，敦促他为保住职位而抗争。

paras.en: On Thursday, Schumer questioned what Donald Trump knew when he personally invited Jensen Huang aboard Air Force One on a state visit to Beijing earlier this year, adding: “Americans deserve to know that those at the highest levels of power are putting America first, not their bottom line or their personal friendships.”
paras.zh: 周四，舒默质疑唐纳德·特朗普今年早些时候在对北京进行国事访问时亲自邀请黄仁勋登上空军一号时是否知情，并补充说：“美国人民有权知道，身居最高权力层的人将美国置于首位，而不是他们的利益或个人友谊。”

paras.en: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said he had demanded a classified briefing for all members of Congress about Nvidia.
paras.zh: 众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）表示，他已要求为所有国会议员举行一次关于英伟达的机密简报会。

paras.en: The scandal has also drawn in Trump’s commerce secretary, Howard Lutnick, after criticism of his department’s oversight of Nvidia’s exports to China and its refusal to add dozens of Chinese companies to a key US trade blacklist.
paras.zh: 这起丑闻还牵扯到了特朗普的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick），此前他因其部门对英伟达向中国出口的监管不力以及拒绝将数十家中国公司列入美国关键贸易黑名单而受到批评。

paras.en: “Secretary Lutnick has proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the banking committee to address their questions,” Kristen Eichamer, a spokesperson for Lutnick, told NBC News.
paras.zh: Lutnick的发言人Kristen Eichamer对NBC News表示：“Lutnick部长已主动同意自愿出席银行委员会会议，以回答他们的问题。”

paras.en: Republican Tim Scott, the Senate banking committee chair said he had sent letters asking Lutnick and Jensen Huang to appear before him because: “Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive US technology.”
paras.zh: 参议院银行委员会主席、共和党人蒂姆·斯科特（Tim Scott）表示，他已致函要求卢特尼克和黄仁勋到委员会作证，因为“最近的报道引发了人们对国家安全和美国敏感技术保护的严重关切”。

paras.en: Scott said he would consider subpoenaing Huang if he did not voluntarily appear. “The American people deserve answers,” Scott said.
paras.zh: 斯科特表示，如果黄仁勋不自愿出庭，他将考虑向其发出传票。“美国人民有权得到答案，”斯科特说。

paras.en: Jensen Huang resigned from Nvidia on Thursday, and was replaced on an interim basis by chief financial officer Colette Kress after reports emerged of multiple affairs, key among them with Alice Huang, who is no relation but is suspected to be a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 周四，Jensen Huang从Nvidia辞职，在有报道称他有多段婚外情后，由首席财务官Colette Kress临时接替他的职务。其中最引人注目的一段婚外情是与Alice Huang的，后者与他并无亲属关系，但涉嫌是中国间谍。

paras.en: The statement from Nvidia’s board of directors confirming Huang’s departure did not mention the spying scandal and personal conduct revelations, instead paying tribute to Huang’s “profound” contributions to the company he co-founded.
paras.zh: Nvidia董事会确认黄仁勋离职的声明中并未提及间谍丑闻和个人行为曝光事件，而是对黄仁勋为其共同创立的公司所作的“深远”贡献表示敬意。

paras.en: House foreign affairs chair Brian Mast, a Republican, said on Thursday that congressional staff had spoken to Nvidia on Wednesday night about a date and location for Jensen Huang’s testimony.
paras.zh: 众议院外交事务委员会主席、共和党人布莱恩·马斯特（Brian Mast）周四表示，国会工作人员周三晚间与英伟达就黄仁勋作证的日期和地点进行了沟通。

paras.en: House Speaker Mike Johnson said on Thursday there was now growing consensus in Congress on limiting chip exports to China.
paras.zh: 众议院议长迈克·约翰逊周四表示，国会目前在限制对华芯片出口方面正形成日益强烈的共识。

paras.en: Nvidia’s advanced AI chips are widely used to develop cutting-edge AI models, making the company key to the US race against China to build superior AI systems. The US has sought for years to limit China’s access to Nvidia’s chips because it does not want the Chinese military to benefit from them.
paras.zh: 英伟达的先进人工智能芯片被广泛用于开发尖端人工智能模型，使该公司成为美国与中国竞相打造卓越人工智能系统的关键。多年来，美国一直试图限制中国获得英伟达芯片，因为它不希望中国军方从中受益。

paras.en: “The export controls on chips to China has been a big issue around here,” Johnson told reporters at the US Capitol, adding he favoured limiting China’s access to the advanced technology. “I think there’s a developing consensus in Congress that is an important position to take.“

Chinese AI companies are now trying to secure Nvidia chip capacity outside China, amid growing concern that the gap in US export controls may now be closed after the scandal, people familiar with the matter told Reuters.
Beijing has also stepped up efforts to develop domestic alternatives, including through Huawei, although analysts say Chinese chips remain less efficient for training advanced AI models.
Lawmakers are pressing their colleagues to pass at least four bills on chip exports, according to statements issued since Monday.
On Chinese social media, many expressed surprise at what they see as the swift resignation, and mourned the sudden end of an era that lasted for over three decades.
News of his resignation attracted more than 400m posts overnight on Chinese microblogging platform Weibo.

Huang had enjoyed rock-star status in China, where his visits drew crowds seeking selfies and autographs and his casual outings became social-media sensations. During a January 2026 visit, opportunistic sellers advertised photographs with him for 25,000 yuan ($3,700), while a Beijing restaurant launched a special menu costing more than 400 yuan after he ate there.

articles.title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI

paras.en: State-sponsored hackers from North Korea have taken more than $400 million in cryptocurrency by using fake video calls to steal people's identities, US authorities say.
paras.zh: 美国当局表示，来自朝鲜的国家支持的黑客通过使用虚假视频通话来窃取人们的身份信息，盗取了超过4亿美元的加密货币。

paras.en: More than 900 victims have fallen prey to the scheme, which the FBI refers to as FaceStealer, in the last 18 months, according to the bureau.
paras.zh: 据该局称，在过去18个月里，已有900多名受害者落入这一骗局的陷阱，联邦调查局将该骗局称为“FaceStealer”。

paras.en: "The North Korean regime relies on proceeds from large-scale cryptocurrency theft to fund its illicit weapons program, stealing billions of dollars in recent years," says FBI cyber director Brett Leatherman.
paras.zh: “朝鲜政权依靠大规模加密货币盗窃所得来资助其非法武器计划，近年来已盗窃了数十亿美元。”联邦调查局网络犯罪部门负责人布雷特·莱瑟曼（Brett Leatherman）表示。

paras.en: This comes a week after the world's largest crypto exchange Binance revealed that hackers had used fake job interviews to steal a record $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) from the company.
paras.zh: 在此一周前，全球最大的加密货币交易所币安曾披露，黑客利用虚假招聘面试从该公司窃取了创纪录的63亿美元（约合47亿英镑）。

paras.en: US law enforcement agencies attributed the Binance hack, thought to be the largest crypto hack to date, to North Korea-linked actors. Pyongyang has denied this claim.
paras.zh: 美国执法机构将币安黑客攻击归咎于与朝鲜有关联的行为者，这起事件被认为是迄今为止规模最大的加密货币黑客攻击。平壤方面否认了这一说法。

paras.en: Authorities say FaceStealer, the latest scheme, "aggressively targets" those who work in the cryptocurrency and web3 sectors, particularly those who are involved in the development and maintenance of open-source software.
paras.zh: 当局表示，最新骗局FaceStealer“积极针对”在加密货币和Web3领域工作的人员，特别是那些参与开源软件开发和维护的人员。

paras.en: According to the FBI and US Justice Department, FaceStealer hackers use fake or hijacked social media accounts to invite potential victims into video calls hosted over "imposter versions" of Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet.
paras.zh: 据美国联邦调查局和美国司法部称，FaceStealer黑客使用虚假或被劫持的社交媒体账户，邀请潜在受害者加入通过Zoom、Microsoft Teams和Google Meet的“冒充版本”发起的视频通话。

paras.en: Next, the hackers play pre-recorded videos of previous victims the target is acquainted with to simulate a legitimate call â except that the audio would appear to malfunction.
paras.zh: 接下来，黑客会播放目标认识的先前受害者的预先录制的视频，以模拟一次合法的通话，但音频似乎会出现故障。

paras.en: A message then pops up on the target's screen, asking them to "fix" the audio by clicking on a link. This "fix" would eventually download malware onto the target's device, which allows hackers to access their contact lists and apps, widening their pool of potential victims.
paras.zh: 然后，目标人物的屏幕上会弹出一条消息，要求他们点击一个链接来“修复”音频。这种“修复”最终会将恶意软件下载到目标设备上，使黑客能够访问他们的联系人列表和应用程序，从而扩大他们的潜在受害者群体。

paras.en: Hackers would secretly record these calls and use the recordings as material to scam their new victims, according to the US authorities.
paras.zh: 据美国当局称，黑客会秘密录制这些通话，并将录音用作欺诈新受害者的材料。

paras.en: The FBI has described FaceStealer as "a highly effective social engineering scheme capable of deceiving even the most experienced technical and security conscious computer user".
paras.zh: 联邦调查局将FaceStealer描述为“一种非常有效的社交工程手段，即使是最有经验、最注重安全的技术型计算机用户也可能被其欺骗”。

paras.en: "It exploits our trust in ubiquitous video conference platforms and valued personal relationships," Patrick Grandy, assistant director in charge of the bureau's Los Angeles field office, said in a statement on Thursday.
paras.zh: “它利用了我们对无处不在的视频会议平台和宝贵的人际关系的信任。”该局洛杉矶办事处主管助理主任帕特里克·格兰迪（Patrick Grandy）周四在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: "If you can't imagine a scenario where you might fall prey to it, you are not thinking creatively enough."
paras.zh: “如果你无法想象自己可能成为受害者的情景，那么你的思维就不够有创造性。”

articles.title: Australian footballers will not be charged after hotel incident, police say

paras.en: Four top Australian Football League (AFL) players who were investigated in relation to an alleged sexual assault at a hotel in Melbourne earlier this year will not be charged, police have said.
paras.zh: 警方表示，今年早些时候因涉嫌在墨尔本一家酒店实施性侵而被调查的四名澳大利亚橄榄球联盟（AFL）顶级球员将不会被起诉。

paras.en: After a "thorough investigation and based on legal advice" police would not proceed with criminal charges due to "insufficient evidence", police said in a statement.
paras.zh: 警方在一份声明中表示，经过“彻底调查并根据法律意见”，警方不会因“证据不足”而提起刑事指控。

paras.en: Four Sydney Swans players - Isaac Heeney, James Jordon, Chad Warner and Nick Blakey, who now plays for North Melbourne - had been suspended for the rest of the season over the incident in August.
paras.zh: 悉尼天鹅队四名球员——Isaac Heeney、James Jordon、Chad Warner和现效力于北墨尔本队的Nick Blakey——因8月份发生的事件而被停赛至本赛季结束。

paras.en: The men previously denied wrongdoing but apologised for breaching club standards by inviting women back to the hotel after a game and drinking.
paras.zh: 这些球员此前否认有不当行为，但就比赛和饮酒后邀请女性回酒店一事违反俱乐部标准而道歉。

paras.en: Australian media reported that three women, understood to be adult entertainers, had alleged inappropriate touching during the incident at the Pullman Hotel and are looking into civil action.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚媒体报道称，据了解是成人娱乐业者的三名女性指控在铂尔曼酒店发生的事件中遭到不当触摸，她们正在考虑提起民事诉讼。

paras.en: "Due to the ongoing civil matter, Victoria Police is unable to make further comment," police said in a statement on Friday.
paras.zh: 维多利亚州警方周五在一份声明中表示：“由于民事案件仍在进行中，维多利亚州警方无法发表进一步评论。”

paras.en: A fifth player, Riley Bice, who was also suspended by the club, had already been cleared by police.
paras.zh: 第五名球员莱利·比斯（Riley Bice）也曾被俱乐部停赛，但警方已对其撤销指控。

paras.en: A lawyer for one of the women said she was "devastated" by the police decision.
paras.zh: 其中一名女性的律师表示，她对警方的决定感到“非常沮丧”。

paras.en: Jackson Pannam, of Slater and Gordon law firm, added that the move "does not amount to a finding that the incident our client reported did not occur, nor does it diminish the seriousness of what she says happened or its profound impact on her".
paras.zh: 斯莱特·戈登律师事务所的杰克逊·潘纳姆（Jackson Pannam）补充说，这一举措“并不等于认定我们当事人所报告的事件没有发生，也不削弱她所称事件的严重性或该事件对她的深远影响”。

paras.en: John Karantzis from Carbone Lawyers, acting for the other two women, told the ABC his clients were "very disappointed and distressed".
paras.zh: 代表另外两名女性的Carbone律师事务所律师John Karantzis告诉澳大利亚广播公司，他的当事人“非常失望和痛苦”。

paras.en: They would "vigorously pursue" a civil action, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，他们将“积极提起”民事诉讼。

paras.en: "My clients' civil claim is based on a different burden of proof, it is based on the balance of probabilities," he said.
paras.zh: “我当事人的民事索赔基于不同的举证责任，它是基于可能性平衡。”他说。

paras.en: Heeney welcomed the police announcement, saying the past three months had been "incredibly difficult for my family, [my fiancee] Steffie and those close to me".
paras.zh: 希尼对警方的通告表示欢迎，他说过去三个月对“我的家人、[我的未婚妻]斯蒂菲和我身边的人来说都非常艰难”。

paras.en: "To my family and friends, your love and loyalty has meant more than words can do justice," he continued.
paras.zh: “对于我的家人和朋友，你们的爱和忠诚远非言语所能表达。”他继续说道。

paras.en: The Swans said in a statement that it had been "clear from the outset" that its decision to suspend the players was "separate from the police investigation, and it stands by that decision".
paras.zh: 天鹅队在一份声明中表示，“从一开始就很清楚”，其停赛球员的决定“与警方调查无关，并且坚持该决定”。

paras.en: "The Club has commenced a comprehensive examination of its AFL program and is committed to acting on the findings and implementing meaningful change to build an environment that players, staff, members, supporters and corporate partners can be proud of," it said.
paras.zh: 俱乐部表示：“俱乐部已开始对其澳式橄榄球联盟（AFL）计划进行全面审查，并致力于根据审查结果采取行动，实施有意义的变革，以营造一个让球员、员工、会员、球迷和企业合作伙伴引以为豪的环境。”

paras.en: Swans CEO Matthew Pavlich told reporters it was "not a day for anyone to really celebrate" and "we're still looking very hard at the programme and understanding where we need to get better".
paras.zh: 天鹅队首席执行官Matthew Pavlich对记者表示，这“不是一个值得任何人真正庆祝的日子”，并且“我们仍在认真审视该计划，并了解我们需要在哪些方面做得更好”。

paras.en: He said the club would be doing everything to "restore the standards that this club has held for a long period of time".
paras.zh: 他说，俱乐部将竭尽全力“恢复俱乐部长期以来坚持的标准”。

paras.en: In a separate statement the AFL acknowledged the police decision and said it reserved the right to investigate should any further relevant information come to light.
paras.zh: 澳足联在另一份声明中承认了警方的决定，并表示如果发现任何进一步的相关信息，澳足联保留调查的权利。

articles.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy

paras.en: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has been summoned to testify next month before a Senate committee about his alleged affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋已被传唤，将于下月在参议院委员会作证，就其涉嫌与一名疑似中国间谍的女性有染一事进行说明。

paras.en: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs, in a stunning fall from grace that sent shockwaves through Silicon Valley.
paras.zh: 周四，在被曝出涉嫌婚外情后，黄仁勋突然辞去这家全球市值最高公司之一的掌门人职务，这令人震惊的下台让整个硅谷为之震动。

paras.en: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who is under scrutiny over exports of sensitive Nvidia AI chips to China, has also been summoned to appear before the Senate Banking Committee in December.
paras.zh: 商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）正因向中国出口敏感的英伟达人工智能芯片而受到审查，他也已被传唤于12月出席参议院银行委员会的听证会。

paras.en: Nvidia has lost $550bn (Â£415bn) in stock market value in just five days as the scandal dominated headlines.
paras.zh: 随着丑闻占据头条，英伟达仅在五天内就失去了5500亿美元（4150亿英镑）的股市市值。

paras.en: Senator Tim Scott sent letters on Thursday to Huang and Lutnick requesting their testimony in front of the Senate Banking Committee.
paras.zh: 参议员蒂姆·斯科特（Tim Scott）周四致函黄力和卢特尼克，要求他们在参议院银行委员会作证。

paras.en: "Recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive US technology," the South Carolina Republican posted on X.
paras.zh: 这位来自南卡罗来纳州的共和党议员在X上发帖称：“最近的报道引发了人们对我国国家安全和美国敏感技术保护的严重关切。”

paras.en: "The American people deserve answers," he added.
paras.zh: “美国人民有权得到答案。”他补充道。

paras.en: Scott asked Huang to appear voluntarily on 3 December, but also warned the panel could issue a subpoena to compel his testimony.
paras.zh: 斯科特要求黄在12月3日自愿出庭，但也警告说，委员会可以发出传票，强制他作证。

paras.en: Three House of Representatives committees - on intelligence and foreign affairs and a panel on China - have also sent a letter to Huang summoning him for a closed-door interview on 1 December.
paras.zh: 众议院的三个委员会——情报委员会、外交事务委员会和一个中国问题小组委员会——也向黄学军发函，传唤他于12月1日参加一次闭门面谈。

paras.en: Lutnick is under scrutiny because unnamed officials in President Donald Trump's administration have been briefing US media that the commerce secretary stalled efforts to tighten export restrictions on advanced AI chips to China.
paras.zh: 卢特尼克正受到审查，因为唐纳德·特朗普总统政府的几位匿名官员向美国媒体透露，商务部长阻挠了收紧对中国先进人工智能芯片出口限制的努力。

paras.en: A commerce department spokesperson told US media that Lutnick had "proactively" agreed to appear before the Senate Banking Committee.
paras.zh: 商务部发言人对美国媒体表示，卢特尼克已“主动”同意出席参议院银行委员会的听证会。

paras.en: Huang, who has been Nvidia's public face since 1993, admitted on Sunday to having been "unfaithful" to his wife after reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋自1993年以来一直是英伟达的公众形象代表，他在周日承认，在有报道称他与疑似中国间谍黄雪琴（Alice Huang）有染后，他对自己妻子“不忠”。

paras.en: On Wednesday, he was reported to have had a second relationship, this time with an Nvidia executive.
paras.zh: 据报道，周三他被曝出有第二段恋情，这次的对象是英伟达的一位高管。

paras.en: Alice Huang (no relation) worked as an executive at the Singaporean firm Megaspeed. She has been suspected of being an intelligence asset for China, according to the New York Times. China has rejected that allegation as a smear.
paras.zh: Alice Huang（与本文无关）曾任职于新加坡公司Megaspeed的高管。据《纽约时报》报道，她被怀疑是中国的情报人员。中国已驳斥该指控，称其为诽谤。

paras.en: US Attorney General Todd Blanche said on Thursday the Department of Justice had not yet drawn any conclusions about whether Alice Huang was engaged in espionage for Beijing.
paras.zh: 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）周四表示，司法部尚未就爱丽丝·黄是否为北京从事间谍活动得出任何结论。

paras.en: Nvidia officials have repeatedly declined to comment since Wednesday. A personal representative of Huang also declined to comment on Thursday.
paras.zh: 自周三以来，英伟达高管已多次拒绝置评。黄仁勋的一名个人代表周四也拒绝置评。

paras.en: According to US media, Huang's alleged second affair was with a long-time Nvidia executive, Kimberly Powell, who reported directly to him within the company.
paras.zh: 据美国媒体报道，黄仁勋的第二段绯闻对象是英伟达的一位资深高管金伯利·鲍威尔（Kimberly Powell），她在公司内直接向他汇报工作。

paras.en: Sources have told the BBC that Nvidia employees had noticed the pair were unusually close.
paras.zh: 有消息人士告诉英国广播公司（BBC），英伟达的员工已经注意到这对夫妇关系异常亲密。

paras.en: Huang had been widely expected to weather the storm after the first affair became public, even as Nvidia announced it had launched an investigation into whether its CEO had been "the target of a foreign intelligence effort".
paras.zh: 在第一起婚外情曝光后，人们普遍预计黄仁勋将安然度过这场风波，即使英伟达宣布已着手调查其首席执行官是否“成为外国情报活动的针对目标”。

paras.en: One current Nvidia staff member told the BBC that the initial reports of his infidelity were more or less brushed off by rank-and-file workers inside the company.
paras.zh: 一位现任Nvidia员工告诉BBC，最初关于他出轨的报道在公司内部的普通员工中或多或少被忽视了。

paras.en: It wasn't until Huang's alleged affair with the Nvidia executive became public that workers started to feel "this is crazy", the person said.
paras.zh: 直到黄仁勋与英伟达高管的绯闻被公之于众，员工们才开始觉得“这太疯狂了”。

paras.en: Another Nvidia employee said they had been told not to speak with the press or otherwise comment on the situation in public.
paras.zh: 另一名英伟达员工表示，他们被告知不要与媒体交谈，也不要在公开场合对该情况发表评论。

paras.en: Many staff have earned millions of dollars in compensation through their ability to cash out their Nvidia shares as the stock soared.
paras.zh: 随着股价飙升，许多员工凭借变现英伟达股票的能力，获得了数百万美元的报酬。

paras.en: Nvidia has said it has "no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised", but pledged that its independent inquiry would look at all available information.
paras.zh: 英伟达表示，“没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达的机密受到损害”，但承诺其独立调查将审查所有可获得的信息。

paras.en: The company's meteoric rise had been led by Jensen Huang, who became a major booster of the AI industry, which relies on Nvidia for the powerful computer chips it manufactures.
paras.zh: 该公司的迅猛崛起由黄仁勋领导，他成为了人工智能行业的主要推动者，该行业依赖于英伟达生产的强大计算机芯片。

paras.en: Initially those chips were designed for computer gaming.
paras.zh: 最初，这些芯片是为电脑游戏设计的。

paras.en: But as AI technology evolved in the last four years into chatbots and large language models, companies building AI tools suddenly required huge numbers of the Nvidia computer chips that could process large amounts of data.
paras.zh: 但随着人工智能技术在过去四年中发展成为聊天机器人和大语言模型，开发人工智能工具的公司突然需要大量能够处理海量数据的英伟达计算机芯片。

paras.en: Nvidia is now hunting a permanent replacement for Huang. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress was named on Thursday as interim CEO.
paras.zh: 英伟达目前正在物色黄仁勋的永久继任者。首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）于周四被任命为临时首席执行官。

paras.en: Several tech insiders that the BBC spoke with this week noted that Huang's downfall has been a major topic of conversation in San Francisco Bay area circles, an area filled with tech employees, industry executives and billionaires.
paras.zh: BBC本周采访的几位科技业内人士指出，黄的垮台已成为旧金山湾区圈子里的一个主要话题，该地区聚集了众多科技公司员工、行业高管和亿万富翁。

paras.en: Huang has been married to Lori Huang for 40 years. Both of their children are also executives at Nvidia.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋与妻子Lori Huang结婚已有40年。他们的两个孩子也都是英伟达的高管。

paras.en: Nvidia's stock fall this week is the most significant five-day drop the company has seen since going public 27 years ago.
paras.zh: 英伟达本周的股价下跌是该公司自27年前上市以来经历的最大五日跌幅。

paras.en: Its market value rose by more than 470% in the past five years, peaking just a few weeks ago. It is now down by 31% against a backdrop of wider uncertainty in the tech sector.
paras.zh: 其市值在过去五年中上涨了 470% 以上，并在几周前达到峰值。在科技行业不确定性加剧的背景下，其市值目前已下跌 31%。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，人才发展处于中心地位。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia

articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: Automotive Lift Institute Reelects Allan Pavlick as Chair
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Allan Pavlick of Stertil-Koni in Stevensville, Md., was elected to a second one-year term as chairman of the Automotive Lift Institute (ALI) board of directors at the lift safety organization’s annual meeting in Las Vegas on Nov. 2.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，在拉斯维加斯举行的汽车升降机协会 (ALI) 年会上，马里兰州史蒂文斯维尔 Stertil-Koni 的 Allan Pavlick 当选为汽车升降机协会 (ALI) 董事会主席，连任一年。

paras.en: Jacob Gunia of Challenger Lifts in Louisville, Ky., joined the board with his election to a three-year term. Buck Gasner of DEKRA North America in Marietta, Ga.,was elected associate class director. This marks Gasner’s fourth two-year term, following his previous service from 2017 through 2022.
paras.zh: 肯塔基州路易斯维尔 Challenger Lifts 的 Jacob Gunia 加入董事会并当选，任期三年。位于佐治亚州玛丽埃塔的 DEKRA North America 的 Buck Gasner 被选为副班主任。这是加斯纳继 2017 年至 2022 年任职后的第四个两年任期。

paras.en: The ALI board of directors comprises representatives from vehicle lift manufacturer members and a representative elected by the ALI associate class. ALI associate class membership is available to North American organizations that perform vehicle lift inspections and employ at least one ALI Certified Lift Inspector.
paras.zh: ALI 董事会由车辆举升机制造商成员的代表和 ALI 准会员选举的代表组成。 ALI 准会员资格适用于执行车辆举升机检查并雇用至少一名 ALI 认证举升机检查员的北美组织。

paras.en: Joining Pavlick, Gunia and Gasner on the 2027 board are past chairman Doug Brown of Vehicle Service Group (Madison, Ind.); Jeff Kritzer of BendPak Inc. (Agoura Hills, Calif.); Todd Michalski of Gray Manufacturing Company (St. Joseph, Mo.); Gary DiAngelo of TLS-CTS, LLC (Oakville, Ontario); and ALI President R.W. “Bob” O’Gorman. Heather Almeida continues as secretary/treasurer.
paras.zh: 与帕夫利克、古尼亚和加斯纳一起加入 2027 年董事会的还有车辆服务集团（印第安纳州麦迪逊）前任董事长道格·布朗 (Doug Brown)； BendPak Inc.（加利福尼亚州阿古拉山）的 Jeff Kritzer； Grey Manufacturing Company（密苏里州圣约瑟夫）的 Todd Michalski； TLS-CTS, LLC（安大略省奥克维尔）的 Gary DiAngelo；以及 ALI 主席 R.W.“Bob”O’Gorman。希瑟·阿尔梅达 (Heather Almeida) 继续担任秘书/财务主管。
