paras.en: Didymos, a mass of rocks about twice as wide as the Empire State Building is tall, and its small moonlet Dimorphos have had a rough time lately. In 2022, NASA slammed its Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) spacecraft into Dimorphos, sending a plume of debris into space and shortening its orbit around Didymos by more than half an hour.
paras.zh: Didymos 是一块宽约是帝国大厦高两倍的岩石，它的小卫星 Dimorphos 最近经历了一段艰难的时期。 2022 年，美国宇航局将其双小行星重定向测试 (DART) 航天器撞向 Dimorphos，将大量碎片送入太空，并将其绕 Didymos 的轨道缩短了半个多小时。

paras.en: The cosmic realignment wasn’t a mere lark. Such an impact is one of the few ways scientists can practice planetary defense, the field dedicated to searching for dangerous asteroids and developing ways to deal with them lest humans go the way of the dinosaurs. DART and Hera are a carefully coordinated pair, with Hera’s top priority being to investigate the aftermath of DART’s crash and inform future planetary defense efforts.
paras.zh: 宇宙的重新调整不仅仅是一场闹剧。这种撞击是科学家进行行星防御的少数方法之一，该领域致力于寻找危险的小行星并开发处理它们的方法，以免人类重蹈恐龙的覆辙。 DART 和 Hera 是一对精心协调的搭档，Hera 的首要任务是调查 DART 坠机事件的后果，并为未来的行星防御工作提供信息。

paras.en: That process will also yield a treasure trove of observations asteroid scientists are determined to exploit.
paras.zh: 这一过程还将产生小行星科学家决心利用的观测宝库。

paras.en: “Planetary defense and science are sort of two sides of the same coin,” says planetary scientist Jessica Sunshine of the University of Maryland, who was on the DART team but is not involved in the Hera mission. On the science side, she says, “we’re trying to figure out not so much how did we break the thing, but how was it put together in the first place.”
paras.zh: “行星防御和科学是同一枚硬币的两面，”马里兰大学的行星科学家杰西卡·桑夏恩 (Jessica Sunshine) 说道，她是 DART 团队的成员，但并未参与赫拉任务。她说，在科学方面，“我们并不是想弄清楚我们是如何破坏这个东西的，而是想弄清楚它最初是如何组装在一起的。”

paras.en: DART purposefully targeted a binary system instead of a solo asteroid to make measuring the change in orbit it accomplished easier: Any difference would be much more obvious against the 12-hour baseline orbit of Dimorphos around Didymos than against the months- or yearslong orbit of an asteroid circling the sun. (Despite the difficulty, scientists were able to calculate that DART shortened the more-than-two-year orbit of the Didymos system around the sun by a fraction of a second.)
paras.zh: DART 有目的地瞄准双星系统而不是单独的小行星，以便更容易测量它所完成的轨道变化：与 Dimorphos 围绕 Didymos 的 12 小时基线轨道相比，任何差异都会比小行星绕太阳运行数月或数年的轨道更明显。 （尽管困难重重，科学家还是能够计算出 DART 将 Didymos 系统围绕太阳运行两年多的轨道缩短了不到一秒。）

paras.en: Hera’s observations will provide a crucial glimpse at binary asteroids generally, which astronomers believe account for some 15 percent of all asteroids. Scientists expect that most binary asteroids in the inner solar system, including the Didymos system, probably formed their moonlets from debris that sloughed off the larger object then clumped together in orbit.
paras.zh: 赫拉的观测将为双小行星提供一个重要的视角，天文学家认为双小行星约占所有小行星的 15%。科学家预计，内太阳系中的大多数双星小行星，包括狄迪莫斯系统，可能是由较大天体脱落的碎片形成的，然后在轨道上聚集在一起。

paras.en: Didymos spins so quickly that its gravity may not be strong enough to hold all its rock together. As the asteroid spins, it may send boulders into space, where they could end up landing on Dimorphos, continuing that material transfer today. Scientists will comb through Hera’s imagery for signs of rocks moving across each object’s surface, as well as between the two objects.
paras.zh: Didymos 旋转得如此之快，以至于它的重力可能不足以将所有岩石固定在一起。当小行星旋转时，它可能会将巨石送入太空，最终降落在 Dimorphos 上，继续今天的物质转移。科学家将梳理赫拉的图像，寻找岩石在每个物体表面以及两个物体之间移动的迹象。

paras.en: Scientists expect that Dimorphos is a rubble pile composed of boulders and rocky debris. It’s similar in structure to other recent spacecraft targets Ryugu and Bennu, although those are both significantly larger. The boulder-strewn landscape DART saw as it sped toward Dimorphos aligns with this theory, but how deep the rubbly structure extends is a mystery. “We’ve never seen the interior of an asteroid before,” says planetary scientist Angela Stickle of the Johns Hopkins University’s Applied Physics Laboratory.
paras.zh: 科学家预计迪莫弗斯是由巨石和岩石碎片组成的碎石堆。它的结构与最近的其他航天器目标“龙宫”和“本努”相似，尽管它们都大得多。 DART 在飞向 Dimorphos 时看到的布满巨石的景观与这一理论相符，但碎石结构延伸到多深仍然是个谜。 “我们以前从未见过小行星的内部，”约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室的行星科学家安吉拉·斯蒂克尔说。

paras.en: Juventas, Hera’s companion cubesat about the size of a breadbox, will change that. It carries a first-of-its-kind radar instrument to investigate Dimorphos’ internal structure.
paras.zh: 赫拉的同伴立方体尤文塔斯（Juventas）大约有一个面包盒那么大，它将改变这一现状。它搭载了首个雷达仪器来研究 Dimorphos 的内部结构。

paras.en: Juventas will also attempt to land on Dimorphos, allowing scientists to directly interact with the surface. That’s a particularly tantalizing endeavor given one of the biggest surprises of NASA’s OSIRIS-REx mission. When that spacecraft grabbed a sample of Bennu, it accidentally sank some half a meter into the rubble as the asteroid unexpectedly gave way beneath it, even though the surface had looked perfectly sturdy.
paras.zh: Juventas 还将尝试降落在 Dimorphos 上，让科学家能够直接与地表互动。鉴于美国宇航局奥西里斯-雷克斯任务的最大惊喜之一，这是一项特别诱人的努力。当该航天器抓取贝努的样本时，由于小行星意外地在其下方塌陷，它意外地沉入了废墟中约半米，尽管表面看起来非常坚固。

paras.en: “Even though we had amazing images, the reaction was not what we expected,” says planetary scientist Patrick Michel of the French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS) of that experience. “There is still sort of a mismatch between what we see and what we feel.” He hopes that the Juventas landing will help scientists better connect appearance and reality on this front.
paras.zh: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）的行星科学家帕特里克·米歇尔（Patrick Michel）在谈到那次经历时表示：“尽管我们拍摄到了令人惊叹的图像，但人们的反应却出乎我们的意料。” “我们所看到的和我们感受到的之间仍然存在某种不匹配。”他希望尤文塔斯的登陆能够帮助科学家在这方面更好地连接表象和现实。

paras.en: Although scientists will need to pick out the ways DART made Didymos and Dimorphos different from other binary asteroids, observations with Hera will offer new avenues for investigating more general questions in asteroid science.
paras.zh: 尽管科学家需要找出 DART 使 Didymos 和 Dimorphos 与其他双小行星不同的方式，但 Hera 的观测将为研究小行星科学中更普遍的问题提供新途径。

paras.en: For example, scientists know that before DART’s impact, Dimorphos always showed the same face to Didymos, just like our moon does to Earth. The collision probably changed that, sending Dimorphos tumbling — but there’s no way to know what state it’s in now because scientists have never seen this resetting process unfold. “Eventually, the system might stabilize, but we don’t know how long it takes,” says planetary scientist Eva Lilly of the Planetary Science Institute, who is not involved in either mission.
paras.zh: 例如，科学家们知道，在 DART 撞击之前，Dimorphos 总是向 Didymos 展示相同的面孔，就像我们的月球向地球展示一样。这次碰撞可能改变了这一点，导致 Dimorphos 翻滚——但无法知道它现在处于什么状态，因为科学家从未见过这种重置过程的展开。 “最终，该系统可能会稳定下来，但我们不知道需要多长时间，”行星科学研究所的行星科学家伊娃·莉莉（Eva Lilly）说，她没有参与这两项任务。

paras.en: Similarly, scientists know that the rain of charged particles onto an asteroid’s surface darkens a thin layer of rock at the surface, but without the detailed understanding they’d like. At Dimorphos, they’ll be able to observe fresh rock uncovered by a known event, potentially offering clearer insight into the universal process.
paras.zh: 同样，科学家们知道小行星表面的带电粒子雨会使表面的一层薄薄的岩石变暗，但他们并没有得到他们想要的详细了解。在 Dimorphos，他们将能够观察已知事件中发现的新鲜岩石，从而有可能为普遍过程提供更清晰的见解。

paras.en: Cosmic crash scene or not, asteroid scientists are never going to miss out on up-close views of two different space rocks.
paras.zh: 无论是否存在宇宙碰撞场景，小行星科学家都不会错过两种不同太空岩石的近距离观察。

articles.title: The brain’s fear center moonlights as the save button for memories
articles.author: Allie Skalnik

paras.en: The walnut-sized fear center of the brain also distinguishes the memorable from the mundane.
paras.zh: 大脑核桃大小的恐惧中心也将难忘的事情与平凡的事情区分开来。

paras.en: Neurons in the amygdala act like a save button for memories, scientists report October 27 in Nature Neuroscience. Though the study doesn’t nail down the exact mechanism for memory formation, it points to a broader role for the amygdala within the memory-sorting apparatus.
paras.zh: 科学家于 10 月 27 日在《自然神经科学》杂志上发表报告称，杏仁核中的神经元就像记忆的保存按钮。尽管这项研究没有确定记忆形成的确切机制，但它指出了杏仁核在记忆分类装置中发挥着更广泛的作用。

paras.en: The study probes an enduring quandary about the mind, says neuroscientist Jiayang Xiao of Cedars-Sinai Health Sciences University in Los Angeles. “We forget much of what we experience … only a fraction of the information we encounter becomes a lasting memory,” she says.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶雪松-西奈健康科学大学的神经科学家肖嘉阳表示，这项研究探讨了关于大脑的一个持久的难题。 “我们忘记了我们经历过的很多事情……只有我们遇到的信息的一小部分会成为持久的记忆，”她说。

paras.en: Although a role for the amygdala in memory has been suggested before, previous studies that used electrodes reading brain activity through the scalp, or at the scale of thousands rather than individual neurons, captured a blurrier picture. It’s akin to a microphone recording from outside of a stadium, says cognitive neuroscientist Cory Inman at the University of Utah in Salt Lake City, who was not involved in the study.
paras.zh: 尽管之前已经提出过杏仁核在记忆中的作用，但之前的研究使用电极通过头皮读取大脑活动，或者以数千个而不是单个神经元的规模读取大脑活动，捕捉到的图像更加模糊。盐湖城犹他大学认知神经科学家科里·英曼（未参与这项研究）表示，这类似于体育场外的麦克风录音。

paras.en: “You might be able to tell that there’s a game happening. You might be able to tell when somebody scores a touchdown. You might even be able to tell that one side of the stadium is cheering for one team and another side of the stadium is cheering for another team,” but that’s about it, Inman says. The new study is more like a lapel mic pinned on a single fan in terms of scale and what the researchers were able to capture, adding clarity.
paras.zh: “你也许能够分辨出正在发生一场比赛。你也许能够分辨出某人何时达阵。你甚至可能能够分辨出体育场的一侧正在为一支球队欢呼，而体育场的另一侧正在为另一支球队欢呼，”但仅此而已，英曼说。就规模和研究人员能够捕获的内容而言，这项新研究更像是固定在单个风扇上的翻领麦克风，从而增加了清晰度。

paras.en: The amygdala, which is typically associated with regulating emotions like fear and aggression, has neurons that are challenging to reach, residing in two clusters deep within the brain. Xiao and her colleagues leveraged electrodes previously surgically implanted in more than 90 people with drug-resistant epilepsy to identify where seizures originate. In their new role, the electrodes singled out neurons involved in saving memories.
paras.zh: 杏仁核通常与调节恐惧和攻击性等情绪有关，其神经元难以到达，位于大脑深处的两个簇中。肖和她的同事利用之前通过手术植入 90 多名耐药性癫痫患者体内的电极来确定癫痫发作的根源。在新的角色中，电极挑选出了参与保存记忆的神经元。

paras.en: Patients were shown images of everyday objects belonging to five categories such as food and animals. About 10 to 30 minutes later, they attempted to recall which images were already shown. Xiao and her colleagues found that activity in certain amygdala neurons corresponded with an image being remembered. The image had been earmarked for longer term storage, Xiao says.
paras.zh: 向患者展示属于食物和动物等五类的日常物品的图像。大约 10 到 30 分钟后，他们试图回忆起已经播放过哪些图像。肖和她的同事发现，某些杏仁核神经元的活动与所记住的图像相对应。肖说，该图像已指定用于长期存储。

paras.en: Although participants had to recall something from half an hour ago at most and the exact mechanism for saving memories is still unclear, the researchers think there are two main steps of the process. The team showed that individual neurons have a preference for one of the five categories of images. First the image is categorized by the amygdala. Then, the strength of the category neuron response the first time the image is shown dictates whether the image is later recalled.
paras.zh: 尽管参与者最多只能回忆半小时前的事情，而且保存记忆的确切机制仍不清楚，但研究人员认为这个过程有两个主要步骤。研究小组表明，单个神经元对五类图像之一有偏好。首先，图像按杏仁核分类。然后，第一次显示图像时类别神经元响应的强度决定了以后是否会回忆起该图像。

paras.en: A better understanding of this mechanism may pave the way for more effective treatments of memory disorders, Xiao says, a medical conundrum for which there are currently no broadly effective treatments.
paras.zh: 肖说，更好地理解这一机制可能为更有效地治疗记忆障碍铺平道路，这是一个目前还没有广泛有效的治疗方法的医学难题。

paras.en: The hippocampus is typically more directly linked to memory, so “it surprised me that we observe such a clear relationship between memory formation and activity in the amygdala,” Xiao says. By contrast, the correlation between hippocampus neuron activity and image recall was weaker and slightly delayed.
paras.zh: 海马体通常与记忆有更直接的联系，因此“令我惊讶的是，我们观察到记忆形成和杏仁核活动之间存在如此清晰的关系，”肖说。相比之下，海马神经元活动与图像回忆之间的相关性较弱且略有延迟。

paras.en: Future work like observing the impacts of stimulating amygdala neurons on memory will help researchers discern if this region can be targeted to improve memory, Xiao says.
paras.zh: 肖说，未来的工作，比如观察刺激杏仁核神经元对记忆的影响，将有助于研究人员辨别该区域是否可以针对改善记忆。

paras.en: For now, the secret to memory’s hidden machinations remains in the shadows.
paras.zh: 目前，记忆中隐藏的阴谋的秘密仍然处于阴影之中。

articles.title: NASA’s Parker Solar Probe discovers a hidden pattern in the Sun’s chaotic magnetic fields

paras.en: NASAâs Parker Solar Probe discovers a hidden pattern in the Sunâs chaotic magnetic fields
paras.zh: 美国宇航局帕克太阳探测器发现太阳混沌磁场中隐藏的模式

paras.en: - School of Science, The University of Tokyo
paras.zh: - 东京大学理学院

paras.en: - NASAâs Parker Solar Probe has revealed a surprising secret hidden within the chaos of space: turbulent magnetic fields reverse their direction of rotation when examined at extremely small scales. The discovery exposes an unexpected pattern in solar wind turbulence that could help scientists better understand solar activity and predict geomagnetic storms.
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局帕克太阳探测器揭示了隐藏在混乱太空中的一个令人惊讶的秘密：在极小尺度上进行检查时，湍流磁场会反转其旋转方向。这一发现揭示了太阳风湍流的一种意想不到的模式，可以帮助科学家更好地了解太阳活动并预测地磁风暴。

paras.en: Turbulence is all around us, from milk swirling into a cup of coffee to powerful storms churning through the atmosphere and oceans. But turbulence also occurs throughout space, where it behaves in ways that scientists are still struggling to understand.
paras.zh: 湍流就在我们周围，从牛奶旋转到一杯咖啡到穿过大气和海洋的强大风暴。但湍流也发生在整个太空中，其行为方式科学家们仍在努力理解。

paras.en: Unlike the air and water on Earth, much of the matter in space consists of electrically charged particles in a state (known as the plasma state). These particles interact strongly with magnetic and electric fields, creating turbulence that is fundamentally different from what we experience on Earth. Space plasma is also so thinly spread that particles rarely collide with one another, making its behavior even more unusual.
paras.zh: 与地球上的空气和水不同，太空中的大部分物质都是由某种状态（称为等离子体状态）的带电粒子组成。这些粒子与磁场和电场强烈相互作用，产生与我们在地球上经历的根本不同的湍流。太空等离子体的分布也非常稀疏，以至于粒子很少相互碰撞，这使得它的行为更加不寻常。

paras.en: Scientists have long struggled to explain how turbulence develops under these conditions and how energy is distributed among its constantly changing fluctuations. Now, an international research team has uncovered a surprising clue: hidden within the seemingly random motion of space plasma is a distinct magnetic pattern that reverses direction at very small scales.
paras.zh: 长期以来，科学家们一直在努力解释湍流在这些条件下如何形成，以及能量如何在不断变化的波动中分布。现在，一个国际研究小组发现了一个令人惊讶的线索：在空间等离子体看似随机的运动中隐藏着一种独特的磁性模式，它可以在非常小的尺度上反转方向。

paras.en: The discovery, published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, reveals a previously unobserved phenomenon that could improve our understanding of the solar wind and the turbulent conditions that influence space weather.
paras.zh: 这一发现发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上，揭示了一种以前未观察到的现象，可以提高我们对太阳风和影响太空天气的湍流条件的理解。

paras.en: NASA's Parker Solar Probe Reveals a Hidden Magnetic Reversal
paras.zh: 美国宇航局帕克太阳探测器揭示了隐藏的磁反转

paras.en: Researchers from the Technische Universität Braunschweig and the University of Tokyo, working with Tohoku University, Kyushu University, Osaka University, and other international institutions, identified the phenomenon using observations from NASA's Parker Solar Probe.
paras.zh: 来自布伦瑞克工业大学和东京大学的研究人员与东北大学、九州大学、大阪大学和其他国际机构合作，利用美国宇航局帕克太阳探测器的观测结果发现了这一现象。

paras.en: The collaboration brought together scientists from ten countries, including researchers at the Institute of Theoretical Physics at Technische Universität Braunschweig.
paras.zh: 此次合作汇聚了来自十个国家的科学家，其中包括布伦瑞克工业大学理论物理研究所的研究人员。

paras.en: By analyzing highly precise measurements of magnetic fields and particles, the team discovered that turbulent magnetic fields reverse their direction of rotation at a particular range of wavelengths. This marks the first direct observation of such a reversal in space turbulence.
paras.zh: 通过分析磁场和粒子的高精度测量结果，研究小组发现湍流磁场在特定波长范围内会反转其旋转方向。这标志着首次直接观察到太空湍流的这种逆转。

paras.en: Even more surprisingly, the reversal becomes more pronounced and shifts toward longer wavelengths as the solar wind travels farther from the Sun.
paras.zh: 更令人惊讶的是，随着太阳风远离太阳，这种逆转变得更加明显，并转向更长的波长。

paras.en: The change occurs at a critical boundary where the behavior of plasma shifts from the collective movement of a flowing fluid to the dynamics of individual particles. This connection suggests that the magnetic reversal may provide an important new way to understand how turbulence operates across different physical scales.
paras.zh: 这种变化发生在临界边界处，等离子体的行为从流动流体的集体运动转变为单个粒子的动力学。这种联系表明，磁反转可能提供一种重要的新方法来理解湍流如何在不同的物理尺度上运行。

paras.en: Finding Order in the Chaos of Space Turbulence
paras.zh: 在空间湍流的混乱中寻找秩序

paras.en: At larger scales, plasma moves much like a fluid. Swirling structures called vortices and electromagnetic waves create increasingly complex fluctuations, producing the turbulent conditions found throughout space.
paras.zh: 在更大的尺度上，等离子体的运动很像流体。称为涡流和电磁波的旋转结构会产生越来越复杂的波动，从而产生整个太空中的湍流条件。

paras.en: Although these movements appear random, the researchers discovered that the rotation of the magnetic fields follows a consistent pattern.
paras.zh: 尽管这些运动看起来是随机的，但研究人员发现磁场的旋转遵循一致的模式。

paras.en: When viewed along a direction pointing outward from the Sun, magnetic fields at larger scales tend to rotate counterclockwise. At much smaller scales, however, the preferred rotation switches to clockwise.
paras.zh: 当沿着从太阳向外的方向观察时，较大尺度的磁场倾向于逆时针旋转。然而，在更小的尺度上，首选旋转切换为顺时针方向。

paras.en: This reversal occurs precisely where plasma stops behaving primarily like a fluid and begins exhibiting behavior governed by individual particles.
paras.zh: 这种逆转恰好发生在等离子体停止主要像流体一样的行为并开始表现出受单个粒子控制的行为的地方。

paras.en: The finding is particularly striking because it reveals a clear, organized feature within a system otherwise dominated by seemingly unpredictable fluctuations.
paras.zh: 这一发现特别引人注目，因为它揭示了一个系统中的清晰、有组织的特征，否则系统会受到看似不可预测的波动的支配。

paras.en: "We see a clear structure in the spectrum, even though the turbulence represents unstructured motions," says Dr. Masatomi Iizawa (TU Braunschweig), the study's first author.
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者 Masatomi Iizawa 博士（布伦瑞克工业大学）表示：“尽管湍流代表了非结构化运动，但我们在光谱中看到了清晰的结构。”

paras.en: Dr. Yokoi (University. of Tokyo) emphasizes the broader importance of the discovery, stating, "The results are of great significance for both plasma physics and astrophysics."
paras.zh: 横井博士（东京大学）强调了这一发现的更广泛重要性，他表示：“这些结果对于等离子体物理学和天体物理学都具有重要意义。”

paras.en: Why the Discovery Matters for Solar Storms and Space Weather
paras.zh: 为什么这一发现对太阳风暴和太空天气很重要

paras.en: Although the magnetic reversal occurs at extremely small scales, understanding it could have far-reaching consequences for space physics.
paras.zh: 尽管磁反转发生在极小的尺度上，但了解它可能会对空间物理学产生深远的影响。

paras.en: Plasma turbulence is a major feature of many environments throughout the universe, including Earth's magnetosphere, the solar wind, regions affected by solar eruptions, interplanetary space, and the disks of material surrounding astronomical objects known as accretion disks.
paras.zh: 等离子体湍流是整个宇宙许多环境的一个主要特征，包括地球磁层、太阳风、受太阳喷发影响的区域、行星际空间以及天体周围的物质盘（称为吸积盘）。

paras.en: It also influences the shock waves and clouds of magnetic material that travel through interplanetary space following eruptions on the Sun.
paras.zh: 它还影响太阳喷发后穿过行星际空间的冲击波和磁性物质云。

paras.en: These disturbances can play an important role in geomagnetic storms, making plasma turbulence a critical factor in efforts to predict space weather.
paras.zh: 这些扰动在地磁风暴中发挥着重要作用，使等离子体湍流成为预测太空天气的关键因素。

paras.en: By showing how an organized magnetic pattern emerges as turbulent plasma transitions from fluid behavior to particle behavior, the new research provides an important piece of a longstanding physics puzzle. The findings could ultimately help scientists better understand the complex processes that govern the solar wind and improve the physical models used to forecast geomagnetic storms.
paras.zh: 通过展示当湍流等离子体从流体行为转变为粒子行为时，有组织的磁性模式是如何出现的，这项新研究为长期存在的物理难题提供了重要的一块。这些发现最终可以帮助科学家更好地了解控制太阳风的复杂过程，并改进用于预测地磁风暴的物理模型。

articles.title: Earth's fiery birth may have created hundreds of oceans' worth of water

paras.en: Earth's fiery birth may have created hundreds of oceans' worth of water
paras.zh: 地球的诞生可能创造了相当于数百个海洋的水

paras.en: - Earth's water may have been born in the planet's fiery atmosphere rather than delivered by icy comets or asteroids. Scientists discovered that rocky pebbles reacting with hydrogen under extreme heat can produce water in minutes, potentially generating hundreds of oceans' worth during Earth's formation. The findings suggest that water may be a natural part of how rocky planets form, rather than something that must arrive from space.
paras.zh: - 地球上的水可能是在地球炽热的大气层中诞生的，而不是由冰冷的彗星或小行星带来的。科学家发现，岩石卵石在极端高温下与氢发生反应可以在几分钟内产生水，在地球形成期间可能产生价值数百个海洋的水。研究结果表明，水可能是岩石行星形成的自然组成部分，而不是必须来自太空的东西。

paras.en: Earth may have created a substantial amount of its own water as the planet was forming, rather than relying entirely on comets, meteorites, or other objects to deliver it from space. New research published in Nature Geoscience suggests that chemical reactions between rocky pebbles and the hydrogen-rich atmosphere of the young Earth could have produced enormous quantities of water.
paras.zh: 地球在形成时可能已经产生了大量的水，而不是完全依靠彗星、陨石或其他物体从太空输送水。发表在《自然地球科学》上的新研究表明，岩石卵石与年轻地球富含氢的大气之间的化学反应可能产生大量的水。

paras.en: The discovery offers a new explanation for how our planet acquired one of the most important ingredients for life. It also raises the possibility that other rocky planets throughout the universe could generate water through similar processes, potentially making habitable worlds more common than previously thought.
paras.zh: 这一发现为我们的星球如何获得生命最重要的成分之一提供了新的解释。它还提出了一种可能性，即整个宇宙中的其他岩石行星也可以通过类似的过程产生水，从而有可能使宜居世界比之前想象的更加普遍。

paras.en: Researchers at The University of New Mexico investigated this possibility by recreating some of the extreme conditions that existed during Earth's formation. The study was led by graduate student Susmita Garai, along with Zachary Sharp, professor and director of Earth and Planetary Sciences, and Peter Olson. Their experiments examined what happens when rocks containing iron react with hydrogen at extremely high temperatures.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥大学的研究人员通过重现地球形成过程中存在的一些极端条件来研究这种可能性。这项研究由研究生 Susmita Garai 、地球与行星科学教授兼主任扎卡里·夏普 (Zachary Sharp) 以及彼得·奥尔森 (Peter Olson) 领导。他们的实验研究了含铁岩石在极高温度下与氢发生反应时会发生什么。

paras.en: "Previous ideas about the source of water to Earth rely on an external source, such as comets or meteorites. Here we show that virtually any Earth-sized planet should have water by this newly identified mechanism," explained Sharp. "In order to evaluate the possibility of 'pebble' rain' being a source of water, we needed to construct and execute some very challenging high-temperature experiments. Dr. Garai's efforts paid off mightily, as she found that water is produced in just minutes in the high temperature environment of the Early Earth's atmosphere."
paras.zh: 夏普解释说：“以前关于地球水源的想法依赖于外部来源，例如彗星或陨石。在这里，我们表明，通过这种新发现的机制，几乎任何地球大小的行星都应该有水。” “为了评估‘卵石’雨’作为水源的可能性，我们需要构建并执行一些非常具有挑战性的高温实验。加莱博士的努力得到了巨大的回报，因为她发现在早期地球大气的高温环境中，水在短短几分钟内就产生了。”

paras.en: A New Explanation for the Origin of Earth's Water
paras.zh: 对地球水起源的新解释

paras.en: For decades, scientists have debated where Earth's water originally came from. One prominent theory suggests that much of it was transported to the developing planet by icy material originating in the colder, more distant regions of the early solar system.
paras.zh: 几十年来，科学家们一直在争论地球上的水最初来自哪里。一种著名的理论表明，其中大部分是通过起源于早期太阳系较冷、较遥远区域的冰物质输送到正在发展的行星的。

paras.en: According to this explanation, water-rich objects, including small icy pebbles, traveled inward and eventually contributed to Earth's water supply. However, researchers have struggled to fully explain how enough of this material could have reached our planet from such great distances. There are also unresolved questions about whether this delivery process accounts for Earth's chemical composition.
paras.zh: 根据这种解释，富含水的物体，包括小的冰卵石，向内移动并最终为地球提供了水供应。然而，研究人员一直在努力充分解释如何有足够的这种物质从如此遥远的距离到达我们的星球。关于这种输送过程是否解释了地球的化学成分，也存在未解决的问题。

paras.en: The new study investigates a different route by which water could have appeared. Instead of arriving already contained in ice or other materials, water may have been produced directly through reactions involving the rocky ingredients that built Earth and the gases surrounding it.
paras.zh: 这项新研究调查了水可能出现的不同途径。水可能是通过涉及构成地球的岩石成分及其周围气体的反应直接产生的，而不是已经包含在冰或其他材料中。

paras.en: During the planet's earliest stages, countless small pieces of rock gradually came together to form a larger body. Scientists refer to this growth process as pebble accretion. As Earth gained mass, it could have accumulated a dense atmosphere containing large amounts of hydrogen, with temperatures and pressures far higher than those found on the planet today.
paras.zh: 在地球的早期阶段，无数的小岩石逐渐聚集在一起形成一个更大的物体。科学家将这种生长过程称为卵石增生。随着地球质量的增加，它可能积累了含有大量氢气的稠密大气，其温度和压力远高于当今地球上的温度和压力。

paras.en: Under those conditions, rocky pebbles falling through the atmosphere could have triggered a remarkable chemical reaction. Hydrogen in the surrounding gas would react with iron oxide inside the silicate rocks, transforming the iron oxide into metallic iron while releasing water vapor.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，落入大气层的卵石可能会引发显着的化学反应。周围气体中的氢气会与硅酸盐岩石内的氧化铁发生反应，将氧化铁转化为金属铁，同时释放出水蒸气。

paras.en: Experiments Reveal Water Can Form in Minutes
paras.zh: 实验表明水可以在几分钟内形成

paras.en: To determine whether this process could actually occur, the researchers exposed samples of silicate rock to temperatures ranging from 1,200 to 1,400 degrees Celsius. They conducted experiments using flowing hydrogen gas and repeated the tests with helium to provide a comparison. Each experiment ran for between 15 minutes and three hours.
paras.zh: 为了确定这个过程是否真的会发生，研究人员将硅酸盐岩石样本暴露在 1,200 至 1,400 摄氏度的温度下。他们使用流动的氢气进行了实验，并用氦气重复了测试以进行比较。每个实验持续 15 分钟到 3 小时。

paras.en: The results provided strong evidence that the proposed reaction works under these extreme conditions. When the rocks were heated in hydrogen, almost 80% of their iron oxide was transformed into metallic iron, with water vapor produced during the reaction.
paras.zh: 结果提供了强有力的证据，证明所提出的反应在这些极端条件下有效。当岩石在氢气中加热时，几乎 80% 的氧化铁转化为金属铁，反应过程中会产生水蒸气。

paras.en: In contrast, the researchers did not observe the same reaction when helium was used instead of hydrogen. This difference confirmed that hydrogen played a crucial role in generating the water.
paras.zh: 相比之下，当使用氦气代替氢气时，研究人员没有观察到相同的反应。这种差异证实了氢气在生成水方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

paras.en: The speed and scale of the reaction were especially striking. Although the scientists had expected some water to form, the results suggested that the process could have been far more productive than anticipated. When they extended their experimental findings to conditions on the early Earth, their calculations indicated that the mechanism might have generated hundreds of oceans' worth of water.
paras.zh: 反应的速度和规模尤其惊人。尽管科学家们预计会形成一些水，但结果表明该过程的生产力可能比预期高得多。当他们将实验结果扩展到早期地球的条件时，他们的计算表明，该机制可能产生了相当于数百个海洋的水。

paras.en: "We had suspected and hoped that we would produce iron metal and water in our reduction experiments, but we really had no way of knowing how fast and how much. We were quite surprised to find that extrapolation of our work suggests that hundreds of oceans' worth of water were likely produced in this way. Looking out over a large body of water, it is hard to imagine that that water may have been produced 4 ½ billion years ago in a hell-like atmosphere, but it very well may have," said Sharp.
paras.zh: 夏普说：“我们曾怀疑并希望在还原实验中能够产生铁金属和水，但我们确实无法知道有多快和多少。我们非常惊讶地发现，根据我们的工作推断，很可能以这种方式产生了相当于数百个海洋的水。放眼望去一大片水域，很难想象这些水可能是在 4.5 亿年前地狱般的大气中产生的，但很可能确实如此。”

paras.en: Earth's Fiery Beginnings May Have Helped Create Its Oceans
paras.zh: 地球的火热起源可能有助于形成海洋

paras.en: These findings suggest that the conditions of Earth's formation may have actively contributed to its water supply. Rather than being entirely dependent on water delivered from elsewhere in the solar system, the growing planet may have possessed the ingredients needed to manufacture water through its own chemical reactions.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，地球的形成条件可能对其供水做出了积极贡献。这颗不断生长的行星可能拥有通过自身化学反应制造水所需的成分，而不是完全依赖从太阳系其他地方输送的水。

paras.en: The implications extend well beyond Earth. If rocky planets around other stars develop similarly hot, hydrogen-rich atmospheres during their formation, they might also produce substantial amounts of water as rocky material accumulates.
paras.zh: 其影响远远超出了地球范围。如果其他恒星周围的岩石行星在形成过程中也形成类似的高温、富含氢的大气层，那么随着岩石物质的积累，它们也可能会产生大量的水。

paras.en: This possibility could have important consequences for understanding how common water is across the universe. A process that naturally occurs during the formation of Earth-sized planets would mean that obtaining water might not require the right icy objects to arrive from distant regions of a planetary system.
paras.zh: 这种可能性可能会对了解水在宇宙中的普遍程度产生重要影响。地球大小的行星形成过程中自然发生的过程意味着，获取水可能不需要从行星系统的遥远区域到达合适的冰物体。

paras.en: Could Other Earth-Like Planets Make Their Own Water?
paras.zh: 其他类地行星可以自己制造水吗？

paras.en: The research also adds to growing interest in pebble accretion as an explanation for how planets form. Although the concept has gained attention relatively recently, it has already helped scientists address several longstanding questions about planetary development.
paras.zh: 这项研究还增加了人们对卵石吸积作为行星如何形成的解释的兴趣。尽管这个概念最近才引起人们的关注，但它已经帮助科学家解决了有关行星发展的几个长期存在的问题。

paras.en: "The idea of pebble accretion is still relatively new. It's only been around for the last decade. But it seems to solve many problems that exist with the existing paradigm for planet formation," Sharp said. "And now we see that it also can explain why our planet is habitable. By extension, it is reasonable to expect that other Earth-sized bodies circling other stars would also have water and possibly life."
paras.zh: “卵石吸积的想法仍然相对较新。它在过去十年才出现。但它似乎解决了现有行星形成范式中存在的许多问题，”夏普说。 “现在我们看到，它也可以解释为什么我们的星球适合居住。推而广之，可以合理地预期，围绕其他恒星运行的其他地球大小的天体也有水，甚至可能有生命。”

paras.en: There are still important uncertainties to resolve. While the experiments show that rocky material can generate water when exposed to hydrogen under conditions resembling those of the early Earth, they do not establish how much of our planet's present water supply was actually produced this way. Additional research will be needed to determine the contribution of this mechanism compared with water delivered by comets, meteorites, and other sources.
paras.zh: 仍有重要的不确定性需要解决。虽然实验表明，在类似于早期地球的条件下，岩石材料在接触氢气时可以产生水，但他们并没有确定我们星球上目前的供水有多少实际上是通过这种方式产生的。需要进行更多的研究来确定这种机制与彗星、陨石和其他来源输送的水相比的贡献。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the findings reveal a potentially important process that may have shaped Earth billions of years ago. They also suggest that the ability to produce water could be built into the formation of rocky planets themselves, opening new possibilities for understanding where water, and perhaps life, might exist beyond our solar system.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些发现揭示了一个潜在的重要过程，可能在数十亿年前塑造了地球。他们还建议，产生水的能力可以融入到岩石行星本身的形成中，这为了解太阳系之外的水（也许还有生命）可能存在的地方开辟了新的可能性。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of New Mexico. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由新墨西哥大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Common forever chemicals linked to nearly double the rate of aggressive breast cancer

paras.en: Common forever chemicals linked to nearly double the rate of aggressive breast cancer
paras.zh: 常见的永久化学物质与侵袭性乳腺癌发病率几乎翻倍有关

paras.en: - An NIH study found that women with high levels of two common âforever chemicalsâ had up to 93% higher rates of an aggressive form of breast cancer. The discovery raises concerns about the potential health effects of persistent chemicals found in everyday products.
paras.zh: - NIH 的一项研究发现，两种常见“永久化学物质”水平较高的女性患侵袭性乳腺癌的几率要高出 93%。这一发现引起了人们对日常产品中持久性化学物质对健康潜在影响的担忧。

paras.en: Women with higher blood levels of two common "forever chemicals" may face an increased risk of developing a particularly aggressive form of breast cancer, according to new research from the National Institutes of Health (NIH), part of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
paras.zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部 (HHS) 下属的国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 的最新研究表明，血液中两种常见“永久化学物质”水平较高的女性可能会面临更高的罹患侵袭性乳腺癌的风险。

paras.en: The study identified a connection between estrogen receptor-negative, or ER-negative, breast cancer and two widely encountered chemicals: perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) and perfluorooctanesulfonic acid (PFOS). Women with greater concentrations of these substances in their blood were more likely to develop this type of cancer. However, researchers found no clear link between either chemical and breast cancer risk overall.
paras.zh: 该研究确定了雌激素受体阴性或 ER 阴性乳腺癌与两种广泛使用的化学物质：全氟辛酸 (PFOA) 和全氟辛烷磺酸 (PFOS) 之间的联系。血液中这些物质浓度较高的女性更有可能患上此类癌症。然而，研究人员发现化学物质与乳腺癌风险之间并没有明显的联系。

paras.en: Both substances belong to a large family of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, commonly called PFAS. These chemicals have been used in numerous everyday consumer products and are often described as "forever chemicals" because they resist breaking down in the environment. They can also accumulate in the human body and remain there for years.
paras.zh: 这两种物质都属于全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质大家族，通常称为 PFAS。这些化学品已用于许多日常消费品中，并且通常被称为“永久化学品”，因为它们在环境中不易分解。它们还可以在人体内积聚并保留多年。

paras.en: "Women deserve clear answers about how chemicals in their environment may affect their health," said HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. "This NIH study links two forever chemicals to a higher risk of ER-negative breast cancer and demands further investigation. Under President Trump's leadership, we will pursue the evidence, confront environmental health risks, and give women the information they need to protect their health."
paras.zh: 美国卫生与公众服务部部长罗伯特·肯尼迪 (Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.) 表示：“女性应该得到关于环境中的化学物质如何影响她们健康的明确答案。美国国立卫生研究院 (NIH) 的这项研究将两种永久性化学物质与 ER 阴性乳腺癌的较高风险联系起来，需要进一步调查。在特朗普总统的领导下，我们将追寻证据，应对环境健康风险，并为女性提供保护健康所需的信息。”

paras.en: Why This Aggressive Breast Cancer Is Concerning
paras.zh: 为什么这种侵袭性乳腺癌令人担忧

paras.en: ER-negative breast cancer differs from more common forms of the disease because its tumor cells lack the receptors that allow estrogen to stimulate cancer growth. These cancers are often more aggressive and generally have poorer outcomes than tumors that respond to estrogen.
paras.zh: ER阴性乳腺癌与更常见的疾病不同，因为它的肿瘤细胞缺乏雌激素刺激癌症生长的受体。这些癌症通常比对雌激素有反应的肿瘤更具侵袭性，并且通常预后较差。

paras.en: Despite their severity, researchers still have relatively little information about what makes someone more likely to develop ER-negative breast cancer. The new findings suggest that exposure to certain persistent environmental chemicals could be one contributing factor.
paras.zh: 尽管病情严重，但研究人员对于是什么导致人们更有可能患上 ER 阴性乳腺癌的信息仍然相对较少。新发现表明，接触某些持久性环境化学物质可能是一个影响因素。

paras.en: "Our findings, which we confirmed using a meta-analysis of prior research, indicate that certain legacy PFAS, including PFOA and PFOS, are associated with a higher risk of ER-negative breast cancer, a more aggressive tumor type with few known risk factors," explained NIH Stadtman Investigator Alexandra White, Ph.D., who led the study.
paras.zh: “我们通过对先前研究的荟萃分析证实了我们的发现，表明某些遗留的 PFAS，包括 PFOA 和 PFOS，与 ER 阴性乳腺癌的较高风险相关，这是一种更具侵袭性的肿瘤类型，已知的危险因素很少，”领导该研究的 NIH Stadtman 研究员 Alexandra White 博士解释道。

paras.en: The findings were published in the Journal of Clinical Oncology.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《临床肿瘤学杂志》上。

paras.en: Higher Forever Chemical Levels Linked to Greater Cancer Risk
paras.zh: 永远较高的化学物质水平与较高的癌症风险相关

paras.en: To investigate the possible connection, NIH scientists and their collaborators examined blood samples that had been collected years before participants received a cancer diagnosis. The researchers measured concentrations of 17 different PFAS chemicals, allowing them to compare earlier exposure levels with subsequent breast cancer outcomes.
paras.zh: 为了调查可能的联系，美国国立卫生研究院的科学家和他们的合作者检查了参与者接受癌症诊断前几年收集的血液样本。研究人员测量了 17 种不同 PFAS 化学物质的浓度，使他们能够将早期暴露水平与随后的乳腺癌结果进行比较。

paras.en: The results revealed substantial differences for two chemicals. Women in the highest PFOA exposure group had a 67% higher rate of ER-negative breast cancer than women in the lowest group. The association was even stronger for PFOS, with the highest exposure group showing a 93% higher rate, nearly twice that of the lowest group.
paras.zh: 结果显示两种化学品存在显着差异。 PFOA 暴露最高组的女性患 ER 阴性乳腺癌的几率比最低组的女性高 67%。 PFOS 的相关性甚至更强，最高暴露组的比率高出 93%，几乎是最低暴露组的两倍。

paras.en: These percentages represent relative differences between groups rather than the absolute probability that an individual woman will develop breast cancer. The findings also establish an association, not proof that the chemicals directly cause the disease.
paras.zh: 这些百分比代表群体之间的相对差异，而不是单个女性患乳腺癌的绝对概率。研究结果还建立了一种关联，但不能证明化学物质直接导致疾病。

paras.en: The analysis used data from the Sister Study, a major research project conducted by NIH's National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences (NIEHS). Between 2003 and 2009, the study enrolled 50,884 women ages 35-74 from across the United States and Puerto Rico.
paras.zh: 该分析使用了姐妹研究的数据，该研究是 NIH 国家环境健康科学研究所 (NIEHS) 进行的一项重大研究项目。 2003年至2009年间，该研究招募了来自美国和波多黎各的50,884名年龄在35岁至74岁之间的女性。

paras.en: All participants were free of breast cancer when they enrolled, although each had a full or half-sister who had already been diagnosed with the disease. For the PFAS investigation, researchers analyzed information from 1,609 women who subsequently developed breast cancer and a comparison group of 2,269 women.
paras.zh: 所有参与者在入组时均未患有乳腺癌，尽管每个参与者都有一个已被诊断患有乳腺癌的同父异母或同父异母的姐妹。在 PFAS 调查中，研究人员分析了 1,609 名随后患乳腺癌的女性和 2,269 名女性对照组的信息。

paras.en: Could Reducing PFAS Exposure Lower Cancer Risk?
paras.zh: 减少 PFAS 暴露可以降低癌症风险吗？

paras.en: Although PFAS can remain in the environment and the body for long periods, researchers emphasize that exposure is not necessarily unavoidable. The findings could eventually help identify new ways to reduce the risk of aggressive breast cancer.
paras.zh: 尽管PFAS可以长期残留在环境和体内，但研究人员强调，接触PFAS并不一定是不可避免的。这些发现最终可能有助于找到降低侵袭性乳腺癌风险的新方法。

paras.en: "These findings matter for women's health broadly," said first author, Che-Jung Chang, Ph.D., who previously worked as an NIH research fellow and is now a researcher at DLH, a scientific research organization. "Although PFAS are persistent in the environment and in our bodies, exposure to them is still potentially modifiable, meaning people can take steps to reduce their exposure, and these findings could open new avenues for prevention."
paras.zh: 第一作者 Che-Jung Chang 博士说：“这些发现对女性健康具有广泛的影响。”他曾担任 NIH 研究员，现在是科学研究组织 DLH 的研究员。 “尽管 PFAS 在环境和我们的身体中持久存在，但对它们的接触仍然是可以改变的，这意味着人们可以采取措施减少接触，这些发现可能会开辟新的预防途径。”

paras.en: The researchers are also interested in understanding how these chemicals might influence cancer development. Because the strongest associations appeared in tumors that lack estrogen receptors, the findings suggest that PFAS could act through biological processes unrelated to hormonal signaling.
paras.zh: 研究人员也有兴趣了解这些化学物质如何影响癌症的发展。由于最强的关联出现在缺乏雌激素受体的肿瘤中，因此研究结果表明 PFAS 可以通过与激素信号传导无关的生物过程发挥作用。

paras.en: Potential explanations include changes in gene activity or alterations in the immune system. However, the study did not directly investigate these mechanisms, so their involvement remains uncertain.
paras.zh: 可能的解释包括基因活性的变化或免疫系统的改变。然而，该研究并没有直接调查这些机制，因此它们的参与仍然不确定。

paras.en: Newer Forever Chemicals Raise Unanswered Questions
paras.zh: 较新的 Forever 化学品提出了未解答的问题

paras.en: Although PFOA and PFOS have largely been phased out and replaced with other PFAS compounds, measurable amounts of both substances are still present in most people's bodies. Their persistence means that exposure to these older chemicals remains a potential public health concern.
paras.zh: 尽管 PFOA 和 PFOS 已基本被淘汰并被其他 PFAS 化合物取代，但大多数人体内仍然存在可检测到的这两种物质。它们的持续存在意味着接触这些旧化学物质仍然是一个潜在的公共卫生问题。

paras.en: The researchers say additional investigations should focus on populations with greater PFAS exposure, as well as groups that experience higher rates of ER-negative breast cancer. Such research could help clarify the strength of the observed associations and identify whether certain populations face greater risks.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，更多的调查应重点关注 PFAS 暴露较多的人群，以及 ER 阴性乳腺癌发病率较高的人群。此类研究可以帮助阐明观察到的关联的强度，并确定某些人群是否面临更大的风险。

paras.en: Scientists also need to determine whether the newer chemicals introduced as replacements for PFOA and PFOS carry similar health concerns.
paras.zh: 科学家还需要确定作为 PFOA 和 PFOS 替代品引入的新化学物质是否会带来类似的健康问题。

paras.en: "More research is needed, particularly evaluating the risk of breast cancer associated with newer replacement PFAS chemicals," White said.
paras.zh: “需要更多的研究，特别是评估与新型替代 PFAS 化学物质相关的乳腺癌风险，”怀特说。

paras.en: The findings add to growing questions about the long-term health effects of forever chemicals and highlight the importance of understanding how environmental exposures may contribute to aggressive forms of breast cancer.
paras.zh: 这些发现增加了人们对永远化学物质的长期健康影响越来越多的疑问，并强调了了解环境暴露如何导致侵袭性乳腺癌的重要性。

paras.en: The research received support from NIEHS grants Z01ES044005; Z1AES103332; and R01ES032831.
paras.zh: 该研究得到NIEHS Z01ES044005资助； Z1AES103332；和 R01ES032831。

paras.en: Materials provided by NIH/Office of the Director. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 NIH/主任办公室提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

Walker, Alexandra J. White. Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substance Exposure and Breast Cancer Incidence in the Sister Study. Journal of Clinical Oncology, 2026; DOI: 10.1200/JCO-26-00318

articles.title: Dark matter breakthrough coming? Euclid space telescope unveils its 1st look into the dark universe (video)
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: On Thursday (Nov. 12), the Euclid space telescope released its first major batch of data, capturing the light of more than a billion objects over an area of sky as big as 9,500 full moons. The data release lays the foundation for one of the largest-ever 3D maps of the cosmos and many groundbreaking discoveries about the nature of dark energy and dark matter.
paras.zh: 周四（11 月 12 日），欧几里得太空望远镜发布了第一批主要数据，捕获了 9,500 个满月那么大的天空区域中超过 10 亿个物体的光线。该数据的发布为有史以来最大的宇宙 3D 地图之一以及有关暗能量和暗物质本质的许多突破性发现奠定了基础。

paras.en: The European Space Agency's (ESA) Euclid space telescope has been called the "Dark Universe Detective" because of its capability to investigate the dual mysteries of dark matter, the universe's most mysterious stuff, and dark energy, the force accelerating the expansion of the universe. Collectively, these cosmic elements are sometimes referred to as the dark universe.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局（ESA）的欧几里得太空望远镜被称为“黑暗宇宙侦探”，因为它能够研究宇宙最神秘的物质暗物质和加速宇宙膨胀的力量暗能量的双重奥秘。这些宇宙元素有时统称为黑暗宇宙。

paras.en: The new data release, designated DR1-Foundation, was built from 13 months of observations and is accompanied by a multitude of images, including large sky mosaics. It marks the first major release of mission data since Euclid launched in mid-2023.
paras.zh: 新发布的数据被命名为 DR1-Foundation，是根据 13 个月的观测数据构建的，并附有大量图像，包括大型天空马赛克。这是自 2023 年中期推出 Euclid 以来首次重大任务数据发布。

paras.en: "These are far more than beautiful pictures; today marks a scientific milestone in our study of the cosmos," ESA's Director of Science, Carole Mundell said in a statement. "This major Euclid data release represents the largest space-based survey of its kind, laying the foundation of future discovery in a new regime for astronomy and demonstrating the excellence of European technology, science and international collaboration."
paras.zh: 欧空局科学主任卡罗尔·蒙代尔在一份声明中说：“这些不仅仅是美丽的图片；今天标志着我们宇宙研究的一个科学里程碑。” “这一重要的欧几里得数据发布代表了同类中最大的天基调查，为天文学新体制中的未来发现奠定了基础，并展示了欧洲技术、科学和国际合作的卓越性。”

paras.en: The ESA put into raw numbers the sheer number of celestial objects viewed by the Dark Universe Detective and contained in DR1-Foundation. That includes light spectra from 160 million sources, over 900 million galaxies, and 60 million candidates for quasars, regions of space dominated by feeding supermassive black holes.
paras.zh: ESA 将黑暗宇宙侦探观测到并包含在 DR1 基金会中的天体数量转化为原始数据。其中包括来自 1.6 亿个光源、超过 9 亿个星系和 6000 万个候选类星体的光谱，类星体是由超大质量黑洞主导的太空区域。

paras.en: "This is a change in scale from Euclid's previous releases, which included a few days of observations over around 60 degrees squared of sky," ESA's Euclid project scientist Valeria Pettorino said. "We're now releasing more than a year of data covering a significantly larger area. This unlocks groundbreaking science."
paras.zh: ESA 欧几里得项目科学家瓦莱里娅·佩托里诺 (Valeria Pettorino) 表示：“与欧几里得之前发布的版本相比，这在规模上发生了变化，其中包括对大约 60 度平方天空的几天观测。” “我们现在发布了一年多的数据，覆盖了更大的区域。这开启了突破性的科学。”

paras.en: Euclid can see such a vast number of cosmic objects thanks to the fact that its space-based position helps it avoid interference caused by Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: 欧几里得能够看到如此大量的宇宙物体，这要归功于它的太空位置有助于它避免地球大气层造成的干扰。

paras.en: This includes clusters of galaxies and even larger superclusters. The study of these objects, some of the largest structures in the cosmos, can reveal how matter came together across the larger network of gas, dust and dark matter called the cosmic web.
paras.zh: 这包括星系团甚至更大的超星系团。对这些宇宙中一些最大结构的物体的研究可以揭示物质如何通过气体、尘埃和暗物质组成的更大的网络（称为宇宙网）聚集在一起。

paras.en: "Euclid doesn't just look far back in time — it does so across huge areas of sky," Euclid Consortium member Barbara Sartoris of JL Lagrange Laboratory, Nice, France, explained. "This gives us an unprecedented view of large samples of ancient galaxy clusters that were previously out of reach.
paras.zh: 法国尼斯 JL 拉格朗日实验室的欧几里得联盟成员芭芭拉·萨托里斯 (Barbara Sartoris) 解释说：“欧几里得不仅仅是回顾过去，它还跨越了广阔的天空。” “这让我们对古代星系团的大型样本有了前所未有的了解，而这些样本以前是无法到达的。

paras.en: "We will explore these in the coming months to learn how these giants grew, and decipher what they reveal about the dark universe."
paras.zh: “我们将在接下来的几个月中探索这些，以了解这些巨人是如何成长的，并破译它们揭示的关于黑暗宇宙的信息。”

paras.en: Another exciting element of the new Euclid data release is the 15,000 strong gravitational lensing candidates catalogued by the space telescope. Gravitational lensing is an element of the universe first explained in Einstein magnum opus, general relativity, in 1915.
paras.zh: 新欧几里得数据发布的另一个令人兴奋的元素是太空望远镜编录的 15,000 个强引力透镜候选者。引力透镜是宇宙的一个元素，在 1915 年爱因斯坦的巨著《广义相对论》中首次得到了解释。

paras.en: General relativity says that objects with mass cause the very fabric of space to warp, and that gravity arises from this warping. But there is another consequence. When light passes this curvature, its usually straight path is curved. That means when light from a single background source passes an object with great mass, like a galaxy or galaxy cluster, a strong gravitational lens, it can arrive at our telescopes at different times.
paras.zh: 广义相对论说，有质量的物体会导致空间结构扭曲，而引力就是由这种扭曲产生的。但还有另一个后果。当光通过此曲率时，其通常笔直的路径会弯曲。这意味着当来自单一背景源的光穿过一个质量很大的物体（例如星系或星系团、强引力透镜）时，它可以在不同的时间到达我们的望远镜。

paras.en: As a result of this strong lensing, background sources can be greatly amplified. It is an effect that the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has been using to great effect to study galaxies in the early universe.
paras.zh: 由于这种强烈的透镜作用，背景源可以被大大放大。詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）利用这种效应来研究早期宇宙中的星系，并取得了巨大的效果。

paras.en: Thus, the prospect of mapping 15,000 strong gravitational lenses is monumental, especially in studying the rate at which the universe is expanding and thus the effect of dark energy.
paras.zh: 因此，绘制 15,000 个强引力透镜图的前景具有重大意义，特别是在研究宇宙膨胀的速度以及暗能量的影响方面。

paras.en: "Strong lensing provides unique insight into the dark universe, allowing us to 'weigh' individual galaxies, including their invisible dark matter, and explore how the universe is expanding," Natalie Lines of the University of Portsmouth, U.K., and member of the Euclid Consortium, said. "Over 10 years ago, we forecast that Euclid would revolutionize the field of strong lens discovery. That day is finally here."
paras.zh: 英国朴茨茅斯大学、欧几里得联盟成员娜塔莉·莱恩斯说：“强透镜效应为我们提供了对暗宇宙的独特洞察，使我们能够‘称量’单个星系，包括它们不可见的暗物质，并探索宇宙是如何膨胀的。” “十多年前，我们预测欧几里得将彻底改变强透镜发现领域。这一天终于到来了。”

paras.en: Arguably, the most exciting thing about DR1-Foundation is that Euclid is just getting started. The area of sky covered from spring 2024 to spring 2025 represents just 14% of Euclid's target for its entire six-year survey.
paras.zh: 可以说，DR1-Foundation 最令人兴奋的事情是 Euclid 才刚刚开始。 2024 年春季到 2025 年春季覆盖的天空面积仅占欧几里得整个六年调查目标的 14%。

paras.en: That means whatever scientists discover from this data release could be the tip of the iceberg in terms of how the Dark Universe Detective will change our understanding of the cosmos.
paras.zh: 这意味着科学家从这次数据发布中发现的任何内容都可能只是黑暗宇宙侦探将如何改变我们对宇宙的理解的冰山一角。

paras.en: "DR1-Foundation includes raw data, calibrated images, catalogues, and spectra over a huge sky area, with enough statistics touncover even rare objects," Valeria said. "It will be used to map the large-scale structure of the universe in unprecedented detail.
paras.zh: “DR1-Foundation 包括原始数据、校准图像、目录和广阔天空区域的光谱，并有足够的统计数据来发现甚至罕见的物体，”瓦莱里娅说。 “它将被用来以前所未有的细节绘制宇宙的大尺度结构图。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: 'Warhammer Survivors' is the perfect gateway into the 40K universe
articles.author: Fran Ruiz

paras.en: We've had no shortage of great Warhammer 40K games lately, but most aren't exactly aimed at the casual crowd. Warhammer Survivors changes that, finally providing curious gamers with an easy entry point into the grim darkness of the 41st millennium.
paras.zh: 最近我们不乏优秀的《战锤 40K》游戏，但大多数游戏并不是专门针对休闲人群的。 《战锤幸存者》改变了这一点，最终为好奇的游戏玩家提供了一个进入 41 世纪严酷黑暗的简单切入点。

paras.en: Developed by Auroch Digital (in collaboration with Vampire Survivors' Poncle), this new spin on the survivors-like roguelite subgenre mixes the sci-fi 40,000 setting with the pure fantasy Age of Sigmar universe. This means heroes and enemies from all over the Warhammer mythos meet together in a bite-sized game that anyone can figure out and enjoy in less than five minutes.
paras.zh: 由 Auroch Digital（与 Vampire Survivors' Poncle 合作）开发，这款类似幸存者 Roguelite 亚类型的新游戏将科幻 40,000 场景与纯奇幻的西格玛时代宇宙融为一体。这意味着来自战锤神话各地的英雄和敌人会在一款小游戏中相遇，任何人都可以在不到五分钟的时间内弄清楚并享受其中。

paras.en: When you look at the alternatives, that's a remarkable achievement for a franchise that's notoriously hard (and often expensive) to get into.
paras.zh: 当你考虑其他选择时，你会发现这对于一个众所周知很难（而且通常很昂贵）的特许经营权来说是一项了不起的成就。

paras.en: Warhammer Survivors isn't bogged down by dense lore, involved mechanics, or massive campaign playthroughs. It's more of an "inspired by" effort that gives casuals a small taste of the series' iconic characters — including Boltgun's Malum Caedo — and factions like the terrifying Tyranids, the raucous Orks, and the foul forces of Chaos.
paras.zh: 《战锤幸存者》不会被密集的故事、复杂的机制或大规模的战役游戏所困扰。它更像是一种“灵感”的努力，让休闲玩家初步了解该系列的标志性角色——包括爆弹枪的马鲁姆·凯多——以及可怕的泰伦虫族、喧闹的兽人和邪恶的混沌势力等派系。

paras.en: All of 40K's (and Age of Sigmar's) recognizable elements are on display, but they serve more as flavoring sprinkled on top of Vampire Survivors' successful formula.
paras.zh: 《40K》（以及《西格玛时代》）的所有可识别元素都在其中，但它们更多的是作为吸血鬼幸存者成功配方之上的调味品。

paras.en: If you're new to the Survivors-like subgenre, it's a unique gaming experience. You battle an endless onslaught of enemies that slowly march towards you, with your character passively attacking automatically. You only need to move them around sprawling arenas and select level-up upgrades and items after collecting enough gems (skulls in this case).
paras.zh: 如果您是幸存者类子类型的新手，这将是一次独特的游戏体验。你将与​​缓慢向你逼近的敌人进行无休止的攻击，而你的角色会自动被动攻击。您只需要在广阔的竞技场中移动它们，并在收集足够的宝石（在本例中为头骨）后选择升级和物品。

paras.en: The moment-to-moment gameplay is as simple as it can get outside of walking sims and interactive "experiences," but there's a deceiving depth to item synergies and how to correctly "build" characters to endure all the carnage.
paras.zh: 即时游戏玩法非常简单，因为它可以超越步行模拟和交互式“体验”，但物品协同作用以及如何正确“构建”角色来承受所有屠杀的深度具有欺骗性。

paras.en: Unlike Poncle's original game, Warhammer Survivors struggles a bit to get going. The early hours are sluggish until you unlock certain meta upgrades, but its still got that Vampire Survivors magic at its core.
paras.zh: 与 Poncle 的原版游戏不同，《战锤幸存者》的起步有些困难。在你解锁某些元升级之前，早期的时间很缓慢，但它仍然以吸血鬼幸存者的魔法为核心。

paras.en: As far as "podcast/gym games" go, this is a perfect fit. There's just enough going on to keep one's brain engaged, but minimal inputs and a tight overarching design lead to a rhythm that's easy to get into without using much brainpower. It's oddly satisfying to weave through enemies and level up your firepower, watching a single Astra Militarum grunt grow into a full Lasgun-spamming, chainsword-wielding wrecking ball.
paras.zh: 就“播客/健身游戏”而言，这是一个完美的组合。发生的事情足以让一个人的大脑保持活跃，但最少的输入和严格的总体设计会带来一种无需花费太多脑力就能轻松进入的节奏。穿过敌人并提升你的火力，看着一个星界军步兵成长为一个发射激光枪、挥舞链剑的破坏球，这是一种奇怪的满足感。

paras.en: Achievement and unlock hunters will find enough to bite into here, too. It's unclear if the devs will continue to add more Warhammer 40K and Age of Sigmar deep cuts to this game via DLCs and free updates, but those universes have daunting depths to explore. This really could become a gateway game for future 40K fans: by the time they realize they're hooked, they'll already have 2000 pts of space marines painted and ready to play.
paras.zh: 成就和解锁猎人也会在这里找到足够的东西。目前还不清楚开发者是否会继续通过 DLC 和免费更新为这款游戏添加更多《战锤 40K》和《西格玛时代》的深度内容，但这些宇宙有令人畏惧的深度可供探索。这确实可能成为未来 40K 粉丝的入门游戏：当他们意识到自己着迷时，他们已经画好了 2000 分的太空海军陆战队员并准备好玩。

paras.en: As massive sci-fi and fantasy properties try to aggressively expand and absorb more and more fans, it's easy to pander to already-converted diehards too much. And sure, we can't wait for strategy heavyweights like Dawn of War 4 and Total War: WH40K either, but they're hardly good recommendations for folks who don't even know what a Space Marine is or why the robotic Necrons are so grumpy.
paras.zh: 随着大量科幻和奇幻作品试图积极扩张并吸引越来越多的粉丝，很容易过度迎合已经皈依的顽固分子。当然，我们也迫不及待地想要《战争黎明 4》和《全面战争：WH40K》这样的重量级战略游戏，但对于那些甚至不知道什么是星际战士或为什么机器人太空死灵如此暴躁的人来说，它们几乎不是一个好的推荐。

paras.en: Warhammer Survivors won't answer those questions beyond the surface-level iconography, but it's fun enough to push those curious to dig deeper and embrace the same material in more mature video game genres... and maybe even pick up a few miniatures.
paras.zh: 《战锤幸存者》不会回答这些超出表面图像的问题，但它足够有趣，可以促使那些好奇的人更深入地挖掘并在更成熟的视频游戏类型中拥抱相同的材料……甚至可能会拿起一些微缩模型。

paras.en: Warhammer Survivors is now available on PC (Steam & GOG), PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 1/2, and mobile (iOS & Android). It's also playable on Game Pass.
paras.zh: 《战锤幸存者》现已在 PC（Steam 和 GOG）、PS5、Xbox Series X/S、Nintendo Switch 1/2 和移动设备（iOS 和 Android）上推出。它也可以在 Game Pass 上玩。

paras.en: Fran Ruiz is our resident Star Wars guy. His hunger for movies and TV series is only matched by his love for video games. He got a BA of English Studies, focusing on English Literature, from the University of Malaga, in Spain, as well as a Master's Degree in English Studies, Multilingual and Intercultural Communication. On top of writing features and other longform articles for Space.com since 2021, he is a frequent collaborator of VG247 and other gaming sites. He also serves as associate editor over at Star Wars News Net and its sister site, Movie News Net.
paras.zh: 弗兰·鲁伊斯是我们的星球大战常驻人员。他对电影和电视剧的渴望与他对电子游戏的热爱相匹配。他在西班牙马拉加大学获得英语研究学士学位，主修英国文学，以及英语研究、多语言和跨文化交流硕士学位。自 2021 年以来，他除了为 Space.com 撰写专题文章和其他长篇文章外，还经常与 VG247 和其他游戏网站合作。他还担任星球大战新闻网及其姊妹网站电影新闻网的副编辑。

articles.title: SpaceX's Starship megarocket will launch to orbit on Nov. 13. Will you be able to spot it in the night sky?
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: SpaceX's Starship megarocket is slated to launch on its ambitious 15th flight test as soon as this Friday (Nov. 13). Will you be able to spot its leviathan upper stage, known as Ship, or its Starlink satellite passengers as they circle Earth during the historic orbital jaunt?
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Starship 巨型火箭预计将于本周五（11 月 13 日）进行雄心勃勃的第 15 次飞行测试。您能否在历史性的轨道短途中发现其庞然大物的上级（称为“飞船”）或“星链”卫星乘客绕地球运行的情况？

paras.en: Flight 15's 75-minute launch window opens at 5:45 p.m. EST (2245 GMT) on Nov. 13. Starship will fly from SpaceX's Starbase site in South Texas, where it will be 4:45 p.m. at the opening of the window — about an hour before sunset. The launch could therefore be especially dramatic for folks in the area.
paras.zh: 15 号航班的 75 分钟发射窗口于下午 5:45 开放。美国东部时间（格林威治标准时间 2245），11 月 13 日。Starship 将从 SpaceX 位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 基地起飞，时间为下午 4:45。在窗户打开时——日落前大约一个小时。因此，此次发布对于该地区的人们来说可能特别引人注目。

paras.en: "As it launches towards the southeast, and it will be daylight, then the prospects for viewing from the U.S. are going to be in Texas and the states along the Gulf of Mexico," Robert Massey, deputy executive director at the Royal Astronomical Society, told Space.com. "They could see the exhaust plume (the 'jellyfish') with the sky darker for observers further east."
paras.zh: 英国皇家天文学会副执行主任罗伯特·马西 (Robert Massey) 告诉 Space.com：“当它向东南方向发射时，天气将是白天，那么从美国观看的前景将是德克萨斯州和墨西哥湾沿岸的各州。” “他们可以看到废气羽流（‘水母’），而对于更东边的观察者来说，天空更暗。”

paras.en: If all goes to plan, Starship's Super Heavy booster will propel the Ship upper stage through the densest part of Earth's atmosphere before returning to Starbase for a powered landing and capture via the "chopstick" arms of the "Mechazilla" tower system. Ship, meanwhile, will go on to orbit Earth approximately 14 times over the following 22 hours, during which time it will deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites before returning to Starbase for its own ambitious catch attempt.
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，星际飞船的超重型助推器将推动飞船上层穿过地球大气层最稠密的部分，然后返回星际基地进行动力着陆并通过“Mechazilla”塔系统的“筷子”臂捕获。与此同时，该船将在接下来的 22 小时内绕地球轨道运行约 14 圈，在此期间它将部署 26 颗 Starlink V3 卫星，然后返回 Starbase 进行自己雄心勃勃的捕获尝试。

paras.en: When should I look for Starship and its Starlink train?
paras.zh: 我应该什么时候寻找 Starship 及其 Starlink 列车？

paras.en: Satellite visibility in the night sky depends on a cocktail of factors, from the size of the spacecraft to its reflectivity, orbital inclination and position relative to the Earth and sun.
paras.zh: 夜空中的卫星可见度取决于多种因素，从航天器的大小到其反射率、轨道倾角以及相对于地球和太阳的位置。

paras.en: Ship is big — about 171 feet (52 meters) tall — so it will be a viable target for skywatchers, experts say.
paras.zh: 专家表示，这艘船很大，高约 171 英尺（52 米），因此它将成为天文观测者的可行目标。

paras.en: "It certainly will be visible in twilight hours. It should be very bright, considerably brighter than the Starlink satellites due to its size," professor James Osborn of Durham University told Space.com. "Where and when is a bit more tricky."
paras.zh: “它肯定会在黄昏时分可见。它应该非常明亮，由于其尺寸，它比星链卫星要亮得多，”杜伦大学教授詹姆斯·奥斯本告诉 Space.com。 “地点和时间有点棘手。”

paras.en: Ship and its Starlink satellites may be seen in the 90 minutes directly after sunset on Nov. 13 and before sunrise on Nov. 14, as the probes catch the sunlight on either side of Earth's colossal shadow as they drift through the twilight sky.
paras.zh: 飞船及其星链卫星可能会在 11 月 13 日日落后和 11 月 14 日日出前的 90 分钟内被观测到，因为探测器在暮色天空中飘过时，会捕捉到地球巨大阴影两侧的阳光。

paras.en: The spacecraft will initially appear as a string of bright, evenly spaced lights, with Ship most likely appearing significantly brighter than the Starlink satellites. However, Osborn noted that the lack of publicly available data makes it challenging to forecast exactly when the spacecraft will appear.
paras.zh: 该航天器最初将显示为一串明亮、间隔均匀的灯光，其中“飞船”很可能比“星链”卫星亮得多。然而，奥斯本指出，由于缺乏公开数据，很难准确预测航天器何时出现。

paras.en: "During its 14 orbits over 22 hours, the spacecraft is between inclinations of 30.5 [degrees] N and S of the equator," explained Massey. "So it will be best viewed between those latitudes, and then lower in the sky up to latitudes of 40 N and 40 S. That's pretty much the whole of the contiguous U.S."
paras.zh: “在 22 小时内绕行 14 圈的过程中，航天器处于赤道北纬 30.5 度和南纬 30.5 度之间，”梅西解释道。 “因此，在这些纬度之间，以及在北纬 40 度和南纬 40 度以下的天空中，观看它的效果最佳。这几乎是整个美国本土。”

paras.en: Space.com skywatching columnist and veteran meteorologist Joe Rao shared further details on what stargazers may see with the naked eye as Ship drifts silently through the autumn sky.
paras.zh: Space.com 天空观察专栏作家、资深气象学家乔·拉奥 (Joe Rao) 分享了当飞船静静地飘过秋季天空时观星者用肉眼可能看到的更多细节。

paras.en: "When it passes overhead, it will look like a bright, fast-moving star crossing the sky — similar to the International Space Station, but potentially even brighter depending on its orientation," explained Rao. "The Starlink V3 satellites are much smaller, so not as bright, perhaps ranging anywhere from 2nd to 4th magnitude, depending on the angle of illumination with reflected light from the sun."
paras.zh: 拉奥解释说：“当它经过头顶时，它看起来就像一颗明亮、快速移动的恒星穿过天空——类似于国际空间站，但根据其方向的不同，它可能会更亮。” “星链 V3 卫星要小得多，因此亮度不高，亮度可能在 2 等到 4 等之间，具体取决于太阳反射光的照明角度。”

paras.en: Magnitude is the scale used by astronomers to measure the brightness of objects in the night sky. The lower the magnitude, the brighter the object! The unaided eye can make out objects with a magnitude of around +6.5 under ideal dark sky conditions, while the planet Venus currently shines at magnitude -4.41.
paras.zh: 星等是天文学家用来测量夜空中物体亮度的尺度。星等越低，物体越亮！在理想的黑暗天空条件下，肉眼可以辨认出星等约为+6.5的物体，而金星目前的亮度为-4.41。

paras.en: The Starlink train will likely fall further behind Starship as the 22-hour mission progresses, while the train itself will become more elongated, according to Rao. "For locations where it will make a high arc across the sky, the Starship should be visible for at least a few minutes, although because it is orbiting at a lower altitude (170 miles/275 km) compared to the ISS, it probably will appear to move somewhat faster. "
paras.zh: Rao 表示，随着 22 小时任务的进行，“星链”列车可能会进一步落后于“星舰”，而列车本身将变得更加拉长。 “对于它将在天空中形成高弧线的位置，星舰应该至少在几分钟内可见，尽管由于与国际空间站相比，它的轨道高度较低（170英里/275公里），所以它可能看起来移动得更快一些。”

paras.en: There are multiple handy resources that should allow you to track Ship and the newly deployed batch of V3 Starlink satellites following their scheduled launch on Nov. 13, including the websites Heavens-Above, Star Dash, Orbital Radar and Find Starlink.
paras.zh: 有多种方便的资源可以让您跟踪船舶和计划于 11 月 13 日发射后新部署的一批 V3 Starlink 卫星，包括 Heavens-Above、Star Dash、Orbital Radar 和 Find Starlink 网站。

paras.en: Be sure to keep an eye on our Starship Flight 15 live blog for all the latest news along with our launch timings article containing details on how to watch SpaceX's potentially historic orbital launch attempt.
paras.zh: 请务必关注我们的 Starship Flight 15 实时博客，了解所有最新消息以及我们的发射时间文章，其中包含有关如何观看 SpaceX 潜在的历史性轨道发射尝试的详细信息。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you capture a photo of Starship and want to share it with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s), comments, and your name and location to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您拍摄了 Starship 的照片并希望与 Space.com 的读者分享，请将您的照片、评论以及您的姓名和位置发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。
