paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said in a Telegram post. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他在 Telegram 帖子中表示。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: His comments came as U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, arrived in the Russian capital for peace talks with President Vladimir Putin, a day after trilateral talks aimed at ending the war were held in the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 他发表上述言论之际，美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳抵达俄罗斯首都与总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行和平谈判，一天前，旨在结束战争的三方会谈在阿拉伯联合酋长国举行。

paras.en: The two-day Abu Dhabi summit, the first such meeting since February, ended with no major breakthrough, although representatives of Russia and Ukraine agreed on a large exchange of prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 为期两天的阿布扎比​​峰会是自二月份以来的首次此类会议，尽管俄罗斯和乌克兰代表同意大规模交换战俘，但峰会没有取得重大突破。

paras.en: In Moscow, Kushner told Putin that Europe wanted a role in future negotiations, according to Russia’s Tass state news agency.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，库什纳在莫斯科告诉普京，欧洲希望在未来的谈判中发挥作用。

paras.en: European countries cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly after Putin launched his invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, but have since expressed concern about the Trump administration’s softening stance toward the Kremlin. Kushner last week said he also wanted to address “long-term European security and stability,” signaling a focus beyond just Ukraine that prompted a firm response from European leaders.
paras.zh: 普京于 2022 年 2 月入侵乌克兰后，欧洲国家切断了与克里姆林宫的沟通，并拒绝直接与俄罗斯接触，但此后对特朗普政府对克里姆林宫的软化立场表示担忧。库什纳上周表示，他还希望解决“欧洲的长期安全与稳定”问题，这表明他的关注点不仅仅限于乌克兰，这促使欧洲领导人做出了坚定的回应。

paras.en: Expanding on that theme on Thursday, Kushner said there was a “very strong momentum and desire” from European leaders to “engage together,” adding that “understanding the long-term security between Russia, Ukraine, and Europe is a conversation that we started having with them.”
paras.zh: 库什纳周四进一步阐述了这一主题，表示欧洲领导人有“非常强烈的动力和愿望”“共同参与”，并补充说“了解俄罗斯、乌克兰和欧洲之间的长期安全是我们开始与他们进行的对话。”

paras.en: While representatives from several European countries were in Abu Dhabi, they did not play a direct role in the talks. Russian negotiators have previously opposed their involvement, citing Europe’s support for Kyiv as an obstacle.
paras.zh: 虽然几个欧洲国家的代表在阿布扎比，但他们没有在谈判中发挥直接作用。俄罗斯谈判代表此前曾反对他们的参与，称欧洲对基辅的支持是一个障碍。

paras.en: At the meeting in Moscow, the Interfax news agency reported that Putin proposed a joint Russian-Ukrainian humanitarian mission to the city of Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine, similar to the Melania Trump-brokered mission in Oleshky which allowed residents to leave the Russian-controlled town.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社报道，在莫斯科的会议上，普京提议向乌克兰东部的科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡市派遣俄罗斯和乌克兰联合人道主义特派团，类似于梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的奥列什基特派团，该特派团允许居民离开俄罗斯控制的城镇。

paras.en: Meanwhile in Ukraine, Zelenskyy said military units had for several days reported speed restrictions affecting the entire front line and Russian-occupied parts of the country.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在乌克兰，泽连斯基表示，军事单位连续几天报告称，该国整个前线和俄罗斯占领地区都受到限速。

paras.en: A limit of 100 mph is once again being “imposed on Starshield,” he said of the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink communications service. The system normally runs at a stable speed exceeding around 250 mph.
paras.zh: 他在谈到 SpaceX 星链通信服务的军用版本时表示，“星盾”再次受到 100 英里每小时的限制。该系统通常以超过 250 英里/小时左右的稳定速度运行。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他说。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: “Unfortunately, there have already been strikes that got through because our interception systems cannot reach sufficient speeds and are unable to intercept in time,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“不幸的是，由于我们的拦截系统无法达到足够的速度并且无法及时拦截，已经发生了一些袭击。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy, who is set to meet with Kushner and Witkoff in Dublin on Friday, added that Ukraine was trying to clarify the reasons for the restriction with the U.S. side.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基将于周五在都柏林会见库什纳和威特科夫，他补充说，乌克兰正试图向美国方面澄清限制的原因。

paras.en: SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: SpaceX 没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: Craig Albert, the graduate director of national defense Studies at Augusta University, said decreasing Starshield’s speed would slow down how fast Ukraine’s offensive drones travel, “which makes them pretty much target practice for faster interceptor drones by the Russians.”
paras.zh: 奥古斯塔大学国防研究研究生主任克雷格·阿尔伯特表示，降低“星盾”的速度将减慢乌克兰进攻性无人机的飞行速度，“这使得它们几乎成为俄罗斯人更快的拦截无人机的目标练习。”

paras.en: It would also slow down Ukrainian interceptor drones and their missile defense systems, meaning “Russian drones can get through their defenses much quicker.”
paras.zh: 它还会减慢乌克兰拦截无人机及其导弹防御系统的速度，这意味着“俄罗斯无人机可以更快地突破其防御系统。”

paras.en: “The Russians can target more infrastructure, and the Ukrainians just don’t have the speed to counteract,” he said, adding that “for the price, the scale, the scale, the speed, the scalability, and the efficiency,” there were no real options other than Starshield.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯人可以瞄准更多的基础设施，而乌克兰人只是没有足够的速度来应对，”他说，并补充说，“就价格、规模、规模、速度、可扩展性和效率而言”，除了星盾之外，没有其他真正的选择。

paras.en: Ukraine first raised the alarm last month about speed limits being imposed on Starshield, which is crucial to its battlefield operations and air defenses.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上个月首次就星盾号的速度限制发出警报，这对其战场行动和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Starlink owner Elon Musk initially put the responsibility for the restrictions on President Donald Trump, who has been trying to pressure Kyiv to make concessions to end the war. The U.S. government said that any such decision could only have been taken by Musk.
paras.zh: 星链所有者埃隆·马斯克最初将这些限制的责任归咎于唐纳德·特朗普总统，后者一直试图向基辅施压，要求其做出让步以结束战争。美国政府表示，任何此类决定只能由马斯克做出。

paras.en: Moscow has so far resisted such efforts to bring Europe to the main negotiating table, something Ukraine has long sought.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，莫斯科一直拒绝将欧洲带入主谈判桌，而这正是乌克兰长期以来所寻求的。

paras.en: The talks came against the backdrop of continued fighting on the front lines, where neither side has achieved significant progress for months.
paras.zh: 这次会谈是在前线持续战斗的背景下进行的，几个月来双方都没有取得重大进展。

paras.en: Instead, the focus has shifted to daily attacks with long-range missiles and drones. Russia has targeted Ukrainian cities, aiming to cut off water and power supplies as winter sets in. Kyiv has resumed attacks on energy infrastructure, a campaign that drew Trump’s ire.
paras.zh: 相反，焦点已转向远程导弹和无人机的日常攻击。俄罗斯以乌克兰城市为目标，旨在在冬季到来时切断水和电力供应。基辅恢复了对能源基础设施的攻击，这一行动引起了特朗普的愤怒。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials said Thursday that five civilians had been killed by Russian strikes on the country overnight, and 29 people injured. The Russian Defense Ministry said it had shot down 71 drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员周四表示，俄罗斯夜间对乌克兰发动的袭击已造成 5 名平民死亡，29 人受伤。俄罗斯国防部称已击落71架无人机。

articles.title: Megaspeed, chip firm at center of Nvidia scandal, pledges to cooperate with U.S. investigation
articles.author: Mithil Aggarwal

paras.en: HONG KONG — Megaspeed, the tech company at the center of the Chinese spy scandal that engulfed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, said Thursday it will cooperate with the U.S. government’s investigations into the matter.
paras.zh: 香港——英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 陷入中国间谍丑闻的核心科技公司 Megaspeed 周四表示，将配合美国政府对此事的调查。

paras.en: Megaspeed’s statement came hours before the resignation of Huang, one of the leaders of the AI boom, who co-founded the American chipmaker and helped build it into the world’s second most valuable company.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 的声明是在黄仁勋辞职前几个小时发表的。黄仁勋是人工智能热潮的领导者之一，他是这家美国芯片制造商的联合创始人，并帮助其成为全球第二大最有价值的公司。

paras.en: In its first statement since reports emerged about Huang’s extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, raising concerns about U.S. national security and the future of the tech giant, Megaspeed said that it takes its obligation to comply with U.S. export control laws “extremely seriously.”
paras.zh: 自有关黄与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情的报道曝光以来，Megaspeed 首次发表声明，引发了人们对美国国家安全和这家科技巨头未来的担忧。Megaspeed 表示，公司“极其严肃”地履行遵守美国出口管制法的义务。

paras.en: U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang had an affair with the Nvidia CEO and was a Chinese intelligence operative, a person with knowledge of the matter told NBC News on Sunday.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士周日告诉 NBC 新闻，美国情报机构确定爱丽丝·黄与英伟达首席执行官有染，并且是一名中国情报人员。

paras.en: She held a senior position at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that was one of Nvidia’s biggest customers in Southeast Asia. Megaspeed is under U.S. criminal investigation for allegedly smuggling American-made chips into China in defiance of U.S. export controls.
paras.zh: 她曾在新加坡公司 Megaspeed 担任高级职位，该公司是 Nvidia 在东南亚最大的客户之一。 Megaspeed 因涉嫌违反美国出口管制，将美国制造的芯片走私到中国而受到美国刑事调查。

paras.en: A criminal investigation is ongoing in Singapore, where officials said Thursday Alice Huang had been barred from re-entering the country. The government also issued her with a stern warning after finding that she had knowingly provided police with inaccurate information to downplay her role in the company. It said that Huang was not investigated for espionage.
paras.zh: 新加坡正在进行一项刑事调查，官员周四表示，爱丽丝·黄已被禁止再次入境该国。在发现她故意向警方提供不准确信息以淡化她在公司中的角色后，政府还向她发出了严厉警告。据称，黄没有因间谍罪受到调查。

paras.en: The country’s Ministry of Home Affairs said in a statement that authorities had interviewed Huang and impounded her passport in 2025, but that its requests for cooperation from U.S. authorities had gone unanswered.
paras.zh: 该国内政部在一份声明中表示，当局已约谈了黄女士，并于 2025 年扣押了她的护照，但其向美国当局提出的合作请求却没有得到答复。

paras.en: “Despite these repeated requests, Singapore has to date received limited information or assistance in respect of the company,” it said.
paras.zh: “尽管一再提出要求，新加坡迄今为止收到的有关该公司的信息或援助有限，”它说。

paras.en: Investigators concluded in February that there was “insufficient evidence to establish that Huang had committed any offences,” the statement said, adding that investigations into Megaspeed and six other individuals were continuing, related to the shipment of servers via Singapore.
paras.zh: 声明称，调查人员在 2 月份得出结论，“没有足够的证据证明黄犯有任何罪行”，并补充说，对 Megaspeed 和其他六人的调查仍在继续，涉及通过新加坡运输服务器的问题。

paras.en: Megaspeed, meanwhile, said in the statement Thursday that it has “cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and stands ready to cooperate fully with any other relevant U.S. government authority.” The statement was signed by its chairman and CEO, Tan Yong Pong, who also goes by James Tan.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Megaspeed 在周四的声明中表示，它“已配合美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 的检查，并准备与任何其他相关美国政府机构充分合作。”该声明由其董事长兼首席执行官陈永邦（又名詹姆斯·陈）签署。

paras.en: It said that “Megaspeed is committed to working constructively and transparently with the U.S. government.”
paras.zh: 声明称，“Megaspeed 致力于与美国政府进行建设性且透明的合作。”

paras.en: China has dismissed the spying allegations as “smears.” On Thursday, a Foreign Ministry spokesperson said that “the U.S. side should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives as a pretext for implementing technological blockades.”
paras.zh: 中国驳斥了这些间谍指控，称其为“诽谤”。周四，外交部发言人表示，“美方应停止编造所谓间谍言论，以此作为实施技术封锁的借口。”

paras.en: Megaspeed did not address the allegations surrounding Alice Huang, but said that “to further reinforce our commitment to compliance, Megaspeed has retained a leading U.S. law firm to lead a comprehensive census of its graphics processing units (GPUs) and independently verify its export control compliance practices.”
paras.zh: Megaspeed 没有回应围绕 Alice Huang 的指控，但表示“为了进一步加强我们对合规的承诺，Megaspeed 聘请了一家领先的美国律师事务所来牵头对其图形处理单元 (GPU) 进行全面普查，并独立验证其出口管制合规做法。”

paras.en: The company added that it “welcomes appropriate government scrutiny and is committed to demonstrating through concrete actions that it operates responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable U.S. laws.”
paras.zh: 该公司补充说，它“欢迎政府适当的审查，并致力于通过具体行动证明其运营负责任、透明且符合适用的美国法律。”

paras.en: Nvidia’s stock price has plunged since its 63-year-old chief admitted over the weekend to being “unfaithful” to his wife.
paras.zh: 自从 Nvidia 63 岁的首席执行官周末承认对妻子“不忠”以来，该公司的股价已经暴跌。

paras.en: Huang quit on Thursday in the wake of reports that he had multiple extramarital relationships. In a statement, Nvidia named its executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress as its interim CEO.
paras.zh: 在有报道称他有多次婚外情后，黄于周四辞职。英伟达在一份声明中任命其执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)为临时首席执行官。

paras.en: Nvidia’s board met Wednesday night to address Huang’s future at the company, a source familiar with the matter told NBC News, adding that the White House was aware of the meeting.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士告诉 NBC 新闻，英伟达董事会于周三晚间召开会议，讨论黄仁勋在公司的未来，并补充说白宫已知晓此次会议。

paras.en: The scandal has raised questions about how much U.S. government officials knew about Alice Huang and Megaspeed.
paras.zh: 该丑闻引发了人们对美国政府官员对 Alice Huang 和 Megaspeed 的了解程度的质疑。

paras.en: In the spring, Secretary of State Marco Rubio circulated a memo to officials in the Trump administration outlining how U.S. intelligence showed that the Nvidia CEO was in a romantic relationship with a business executive who was an asset of China’s spy service, according to a person familiar with Nvidia and a former national security official with knowledge of the matter. The New York Times and the Financial Times first reported on this memo.
paras.zh: 据一位熟悉英伟达的人士和一位知情的前国家安全官员透露，今年春天，国务卿马可·鲁比奥向特朗普政府官员分发了一份备忘录，概述了美国情报机构如何显示英伟达首席执行官与一名属于中国间谍机构的企业高管之间的恋爱关系。 《纽约时报》和《金融时报》首先报道了这份备忘录。

paras.en: Alice Huang’s precise role and relationship with China’s spy service remain unclear, however. It’s possible she was not a career spy for China’s spy agency, the Ministry of State Security, but was asked to cooperate and share information based on her access to Huang, a former national security official with knowledge of the matter told NBC News.
paras.zh: 然而，黄爱丽的确切角色以及与中国间谍部门的关系仍不清楚。一位知情的前国家安全官员告诉 NBC 新闻，她可能不是中国间谍机构国家安全部的职业间谍，但由于她与黄的接触，被要求合作并分享信息。

paras.en: Rep. Jim Himes, D-Conn., ranking Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, told NPR that Alice Huang’s role still needed to be clarified.
paras.zh: 众议院情报委员会资深民主党人、康涅狄格州众议员吉姆·海姆斯 (Jim Himes) 告诉 NPR，爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的角色仍需要澄清。

paras.en: Democrats will soon hold control of both the House and the Senate and, as a result, will have subpoena power.
paras.zh: 民主党很快将控制众议院和参议院，因此将拥有传票权。

paras.en: On Wednesday night, as the Nvidia board met, Sens. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass., and Chris Coons, D-Del., announced they had written to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick with a request to preserve records on the subject.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在英伟达董事会召开会议时，马萨诸塞州民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和特拉华州民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯 (Chris Coons) 宣布，他们已致函商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick)，请求保存有关该主题的记录。

articles.title: Live: Home affairs minister considers backdown on backpacker visa policy
articles.author: Joshua Boscaini

paras.en: Federal politics live: Home affairs minister considers backdown on backpacker visa policy
paras.zh: 联邦政治直播：内政部长考虑放弃背包客签证政策

paras.en: Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke is considering changing the government's backpacker visa policy, which was announced two months ago at the National Press Club.
paras.zh: 内政部长托尼·伯克正在考虑改变政府的背包客签证政策，该政策是两个月前在国家新闻俱乐部宣布的。

paras.en: Follow all the updates in our live blog.
paras.zh: 关注我们实时博客中的所有更新。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: National criminal history tracker to enter next phase of rollout
paras.zh: 国家犯罪历史追踪器将进入下一阶段的推出

paras.en: The federal government's long-awaited national criminal history tracker is set to enter the next stage of its rollout.
paras.zh: 联邦政府期待已久的国家犯罪历史追踪系统将进入下一阶段的部署。

paras.en: Once fully operational, the National Continuous Checking Capability (NCCC) will provide near-real time monitoring of national changes to criminal history information on Working with Children Check (WWCC) holders.
paras.zh: 一旦全面投入使用，国家连续检查能力（NCCC）将近乎实时地监控全国儿童工作检查（WWCC）持有者犯罪历史信息的变化。

paras.en: The pilot currently has access to information about Commonwealth and ACT offences and from Monday South Australia's Department of Human Services will connect.
paras.zh: 该试点目前可以获取有关联邦和首都地区犯罪行为的信息，从周一开始，南澳大利亚州公共服务部将进行连接。

paras.en: As previously reported by friend of the blog Claudia Long, the system was called for more than a decade ago in the royal commission into child sexual abuse.
paras.zh: 正如博客的朋友克劳迪娅·朗（Claudia Long）之前报道的那样，十多年前，针对儿童性虐待问题的皇家委员会就调用了该系统。

paras.en: The government has committed $37 million to the NCCC and says the focus will now turn to bringing remaining state and territory agencies on board as soon as possible, with police forces expected to join next year.
paras.zh: 政府已向 NCCC 投入 3700 万美元，并表示现在的重点将转向尽快让剩余的州和领地机构加入，预计警察部队将于明年加入。

paras.en: Home affairs minister considers backpacker backdown
paras.zh: 内政部长考虑让背包客退缩

paras.en: The federal government is considering a backdown on its backpacker visa policy, two months after immigration minister Tony Burke announced sweeping cuts at the National Press Club.
paras.zh: 移民部长托尼·伯克在国家新闻俱乐部宣布大幅削减两个月后，联邦政府正在考虑取消背包客签证政策。

paras.en: As part of its plan to reduce net migration to 225,000 people by 2028, Labor said it would impose a ballot system, cap second-year visa places at 45,000 (down from 57,000 this year) and cap third-year places at 5,000 (down from 31,000 this year).
paras.zh: 作为到 2028 年将净移民人数减少到 225,000 人的计划的一部分，工党表示将实施投票制度，将第二年签证名额上限为 45,000 个（低于今年的 57,000 个），将第三年签证名额上限为 5,000 个（低于今年的 31,000 个）。

paras.en: However, Burke says the government is considering changes to its policy after outcry from the hospitality and agriculture sectors.
paras.zh: 然而，伯克表示，在受到酒店业和农业部门的强烈抗议后，政府正在考虑改变其政策。

paras.en: "The parameters were clear — the total numbers, which I had announced in the Press Club speech, were something that I could not compromise on," Burke says.
paras.zh: “参数很明确——我在新闻俱乐部演讲中宣布的总数是我不能妥协的，”伯克说。

paras.en: "But if we could find a better way of getting a similar immigration outcome with a better outcome for industry, then I wanted us to work to that.
paras.zh: “但是，如果我们能够找到一种更好的方法来获得类似的移民结果，同时为工业带来更好的结果，那么我希望我们为此努力。

paras.en: Similarly, the prime minister last week sought to reinstate regional work obligations on British backpackers after ruling out such a move, after "representations" from industry and WA Premier Roger Cook.
paras.zh: 同样，在业界和西澳州长罗杰·库克的“陈述”后，总理上周排除了这一举措，试图恢复英国背包客的区域工作义务。

paras.en: The Australian is reporting the latest changes could include delaying the backpacker ballot until next year and increasing third-year visas to 25,000.
paras.zh: 《澳大利亚人报》报道称，最新的变化可能包括将背包客投票推迟到明年，并将第三年签证数量增加到 25,000 个。

paras.en: Hello and welcome to our federal politics live blog! It's great to have you here for another day of federal politics news.
paras.zh: 您好，欢迎来到我们的联邦政治实时博客！很高兴您又来到这里聆听联邦政治新闻。

paras.en: I'm Josh Boscaini, joining you live from Parliament House in Canberra, here and ready to bring you all of today's federal politics news.
paras.zh: 我是乔什·博斯卡尼 (Josh Boscaini)，将从堪培拉议会大厦现场直播，准备为您带来今天所有的联邦政治新闻。

paras.en: The home affairs minister is considering backing down on changes to backpacker visas just months after announcing them at the National Press Club.
paras.zh: 在国家新闻俱乐部宣布背包客签证变更几个月后，内政部长正在考虑放弃这一变更。

paras.en: And my colleague Clare Armstrong will have all the latest from the COP31 summit in Türkiye throughout the morning.
paras.zh: 我的同事克莱尔·阿姆斯特朗 (Clare Armstrong) 整个上午都会了解土耳其 COP31 峰会的所有最新消息。

paras.en: It's nearly the end of the working week, so let's get right into the day's news and see what it brings us!
paras.zh: 一周的工作即将结束，让我们直接关注当天的新闻，看看它给我们带来了什么！

articles.title: SA gives green light for gas to help power future data centres
articles.author: James Wakelin

paras.en: South Australia's energy minister says he is "absolutely fine" for gas-generated power to be used to help supply energy to proposed AI data centres across the state.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚州能源部长表示，他“完全同意”使用天然气发电来为全州拟议的人工智能数据中心提供能源。

paras.en: The SA Greens leader has criticised the change in position, calling it a "total backflip" by the state government.
paras.zh: 这位南澳绿党领导人批评了立场的改变，称其为州政府的“彻底倒转”。

paras.en: Plans are underway for at least four major data centres in SA.
paras.zh: 南澳至少四个主要数据中心的计划正在进行中。

paras.en: The South Australian government has been accused of doing a "backflip" by allowing gas-generated power to be used to supply energy for proposed AI data centres.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚州政府被指责“倒退”，允许使用天然气发电为拟建的人工智能数据中心提供能源。

paras.en: Energy Minister Tom Koutsantonis has told the ABC that he was "absolutely fine" with gas being used to help run the new large-scale centres that are proposed in various regional locations around the state.
paras.zh: 能源部长汤姆·库桑托尼斯 (Tom Koutsantonis) 告诉澳大利亚广播公司 (ABC)，他“绝对同意”使用天然气来帮助运营拟在该州各个地区建立的新大型中心。

paras.en: "We support the idea of gas use to firm data centres the same way we support the idea of gas firming our renewable energy right now," Mr Koutsantonis said.
paras.zh: 库桑托尼斯先生表示：“我们支持使用天然气来巩固数据中心的想法，就像我们现在支持使用天然气来巩固我们的可再生能源的想法一样。”

paras.en: The government's own Data Centre Strategy, released just under five months ago, focused on the promotion of the state's renewable energy sector.
paras.zh: 政府自己的数据中心战略于不到五个月前发布，重点是促进该州的可再生能源行业。

paras.en: That strategy document stated: "South Australia can produce the clean energy needed, at scale and on time, to power the artificial intelligence revolution".
paras.zh: 该战略文件指出：“南澳大利亚可以大规模、按时生产所需的清洁能源，为人工智能革命提供动力”。

paras.en: But Mr Koutsantonis said that data centres needed large amounts of energy continuously, and that gas could be used to "firm" up or guarantee ongoing electricity to data centres "if the sun stops shining or wind stops blowing".
paras.zh: 但库桑托尼斯表示，数据中心持续需要大量能源，“如果太阳停止照射或风停止吹”，天然气可以用来“加固”或保证数据中心持续供电。

paras.en: As part of the strategy, new data centres would be required to supply their own power.
paras.zh: 作为该战略的一部分，新的数据中心需要自行供电。

paras.en: Developer Quantum DC, who yesterday announced it was pausing its plans for a 1,200-megawatt data centre at Tungkillo, had previously estimated about 20 per cent of the energy it needed would be supplied by a gas power station to be built on a section of its 220-hectare Adelaide Hills block.
paras.zh: 开发商 Quantum DC 昨天宣布暂停在 Tungkillo 建设 1,200 兆瓦数据中心的计划，此前曾估计，其所需能源的约 20% 将由在其 220 公顷阿德莱德山区块的一部分上建造的天然气发电站提供。

paras.en: The company had proposed that the rest of the centre's electricity requirement would be supplied by renewables.
paras.zh: 该公司提议该中心的其余电力需求将由可再生能源提供。

paras.en: Apart from Tungkillo, plans are underway for at least three other major data centres in SA.
paras.zh: 除了 Tungkillo 之外，南澳至少另外三个主要数据中心的建设计划也正在进行中。

paras.en: Australian company Iren proposed a $10 billion 800MW facility at Bundey, near Robertstown in the state's Mid North, while AI giant Firmus previously announced plans for data centres near Tailem Bend and Port Augusta.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚公司 Iren 提议在该州中北部罗伯茨敦附近的 Bundey 建造一座 100 亿美元的 800MW 设施，而人工智能巨头 Firmus 此前宣布了在 Tailem Bend 和奥古斯塔港附近建立数据中心的计划。

paras.en: Conservation Foundation of SA chief executive Kirsty Bevan said the use of gas to supply energy to SA's data centres would be a "step backwards" for the government and the climate.
paras.zh: 南澳保护基金会首席执行官科斯蒂·贝文 (Kirsty Bevan) 表示，使用天然气为南澳数据中心提供能源对于政府和气候而言将是“倒退”。

paras.en: "South Australia has led the nation on renewable energy and is aiming for 100 per cent net renewable electricity by 2027, but that progress could be undermined by proposals to lock in more gas," she said.
paras.zh: “南澳大利亚州在可再生能源方面处于全国领先地位，目标是到 2027 年实现 100% 的净可再生电力，但这一进展可能会因锁定更多天然气的提议而受到破坏，”她说。

paras.en: Ms Bevan said using gas would also be ignoring "community expectations".
paras.zh: 贝文女士表示，使用天然气也会无视“社区期望”。

paras.en: "With energy storage and other backup technologies available to support grid reliability, expanding gas supply for data centres and AI infrastructure is a step backwards," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“随着能源存储和其他备份技术可用于支持电网可靠性，扩大数据中心和人工智能基础设施的天然气供应是一种倒退。”

paras.en: When asked generally about the potential environmental impacts of using gas for data centres, Mr Koutsantonis said: "Well if you don't let them use gas, they'll use diesel or they'll use coal."
paras.zh: 当被问及数据中心使用天然气的潜在环境影响时，库桑托尼斯先生说：“如果你不让他们使用天然气，他们就会使用柴油或煤炭。”

paras.en: SA Greens leader Rob Simms said green-lighting gas projects was a major step away from the government's previous policy.
paras.zh: 南澳绿党领袖罗布·西姆斯 (Rob Simms) 表示，天然气项目的绿灯是政府此前政策的重要一步。

paras.en: "It's a total backflip from where the government was just a few months ago when they gave an assurance to the people of South Australia that these data centres would be self-sufficient, they'd be reliant on renewables."
paras.zh: “这与几个月前政府的态度完全相反，当时他们向南澳大利亚人民保证这些数据中心将自给自足，他们将依赖可再生能源。”

paras.en: Mr Simms urged the government to reconsider its position, and proposed a moratorium on the construction of data centres in SA.
paras.zh: 西姆斯先生敦促政府重新考虑其立场，并提议暂停在南澳建设数据中心。

paras.en: Political parties including the Liberals, One Nation and the Greens welcomed the pause on the Tungkillo development, and united in the upper house to establish a parliamentary inquiry into data centres.
paras.zh: 自由党、一国党和绿党等政党对暂停 Tungkillo 开发表示欢迎，并在上议院联合起来，对数据中心进行议会调查。

paras.en: The SA government is currently establishing a regulatory framework for AI data centres, with dedicated legislation set to be introduced to parliament this year.
paras.zh: 南非政府目前正在建立人工智能数据中心的监管框架，并将于今年向议会提交专门立法。

paras.en: Belinda Dennett, chief executive of national peak body Data Centres Australia, defended the need for gas power generation.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚国家数据中心数据中心首席执行官贝琳达·丹尼特 (Belinda Dennett) 为天然气发电的需求进行了辩护。

paras.en: But, she said renewable energy would still have substantial role in delivering the large amount of energy needed.
paras.zh: 但是，她表示，可再生能源在提供大量所需能源方面仍将发挥重要作用。

paras.en: "I think assuming that suddenly this is all about gas is wrong, there is still a huge commitment to renewable energies," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为假设突然间一切都与天然气有关是错误的，但人们仍然对可再生能源做出了巨大的承诺，”她说。

paras.en: "[But] If we wait until we've gone through the energy transition, this investment in data centres will have moved elsewhere."
paras.zh: “[但是]如果我们等到完成能源转型，对数据中心的投资就会转移到其他地方。”

articles.title: Sixers win WBBL clash despite Ellyse Perry's strange run-out

paras.en: Mon, 14 Sept, 11:00 pm, Final score, ZIM 235, AUS 8/294
paras.zh: 9 月 14 日星期一，晚上 11:00，最终得分，ZIM 235，AUS 8/294

paras.en: Sydney Sixers beat Melbourne Renegades in WBBL despite Ellyse Perry run-out
paras.zh: 尽管埃利斯·佩里 (Ellyse Perry) 出局，悉尼 76 人队 (Sydney Sixers) 在 WBBL 中击败了墨尔本叛徒队 (Melbourne Renegades)

paras.en: The Sydney Sixers have beaten the Melbourne Renegades by 11 runs.
paras.zh: 悉尼七六人队以 11 分的优势击败墨尔本叛徒队。

paras.en: Ellyse Perry was initially given not out, but a replay on the big screen prompted the umpires to send it to the third umpire.
paras.zh: 埃利斯·佩里最初没有被判出局，但大屏幕上的重播促使裁判员将其发送给第三名裁判员。

paras.en: Replays showed her bat bouncing over the line as she dived to make her ground.
paras.zh: 回放显示，当她俯冲准备落地时，球棒在线上弹跳。

articles.title: U.S. envoys Kushner, Witkoff meet with Putin at Kremlin in talks to end Russia-Ukraine war

paras.en: U.S. envoys Kushner, Witkoff meet with Putin at Kremlin in talks to end Russia-Ukraine war
paras.zh: 美国特使库什纳和维特科夫在克里姆林宫会见普京，就结束俄罗斯-乌克兰战争进行会谈

paras.en: U.S. envoys fly from Russia to Ireland to brief Zelenskyy after speaking to Putin
paras.zh: 美国特使在与普京通话后从俄罗斯飞往爱尔兰向泽伦斯基通报情况

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump's envoys met on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin as Washington sought new momentum in peace efforts after two days of U.S.-mediated negotiations between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的特使周四会见了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，在美国调解的俄罗斯和乌克兰代表团之间进行了两天的谈判后，华盛顿寻求和平努力的新动力。

paras.en: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, who is also Trump's son-in-law, brokered the talks in Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates — the first direct discussions between representatives of Moscow and Kyiv in nine months as the push for peace stalled.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·威特科夫和特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳促成了在阿拉伯联合酋长国首都阿布扎比举行的会谈——这是莫斯科和基辅代表九个月来在和平进程陷入停滞之际进行的首次直接会谈。

paras.en: The two days of talks that ended on Wednesday produced no major breakthrough, aside from an agreement to swap a large number of prisoners, with the exact figure still to be announced.
paras.zh: 周三结束的两天谈判除了达成了交换大量囚犯的协议外，没有取得重大突破，具体数字仍有待公布。

paras.en: Kushner and Witkoff met with Putin at the Kremlin and are scheduled to fly later to Dublin, Ireland, for talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, as Moscow's full-scale invasion nears the five-year mark.
paras.zh: 库什纳和维特科夫在克里姆林宫会见了普京，并计划稍后飞往爱尔兰都柏林，与乌克兰总统泽伦斯基举行会谈，此时莫斯科的全面入侵已接近五年。

paras.en: Kushner said that one of the goals of the meeting with Putin was to get the Russian leader's blessing for European representatives to be part of the talks, which are looking at the continent's broader security arrangements.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，与普京会晤的目标之一是获得俄罗斯领导人的批准，让欧洲代表参加会谈，会谈正在研究欧洲大陆更广泛的安全安排。

paras.en: The U.S. and Zelenskyy want Europe to appoint a single person to negotiate with Moscow.
paras.zh: 美国和泽伦斯基希望欧洲任命一个人与莫斯科进行谈判。

paras.en: But Moscow doesn't want European countries involved in the direct negotiations, complaining they are financing and supplying Ukraine's war effort. The Europeans are concerned about Russia's conduct and broader intentions on the continent, and whether the U.S. will be too accommodating to Kremlin demands.
paras.zh: 但莫斯科不希望欧洲国家参与直接谈判，抱怨他们正在为乌克兰的战争努力提供资金和供应。欧洲人担心俄罗斯在欧洲大陆的行为和更广泛的意图，以及美国是否会过于迁就克里姆林宫的要求。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov argued that for Europe to join peace talks, it first must name a representative.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，欧洲要加入和谈，首先必须任命一名代表。

paras.en: "The Europeans squabble like spiders in a jar. If someone takes the initiative to establish contact with the Russian side, such people are facing ostracism."
paras.zh: “欧洲人就像罐子里的蜘蛛一样争吵。如果有人主动与俄罗斯方面建立联系，这样的人就会面临排斥。”

paras.en: Putin again warns against European troops
paras.zh: 普京再次警告欧洲军队

paras.en: Many in Europe see the inclusion of Moscow in discussions about postwar European security as an unwelcome concession to Putin, who has described NATO's eastward expansion as a main security threat to Russia. Putin has demanded the transatlantic alliance's troops be pulled back from Russia's borders.
paras.zh: 许多欧洲人认为，让莫斯科参与有关战后欧洲安全的讨论是对普京的不受欢迎的让步，普京将北约东扩描述为对俄罗斯的主要安全威胁。普京要求跨大西洋联盟的军队从俄罗斯边境撤出。

paras.en: Some analysts say negotiators may be looking to grant Russia concessions on NATO's strategy in return for peace in Ukraine — a possibility that alarms European leaders.
paras.zh: 一些分析人士表示，谈判代表可能寻求让俄罗斯在北约战略上做出让步，以换取乌克兰的和平——这种可能性令欧洲领导人感到震惊。

paras.en: Putin reaffirmed to the U.S. envoys that any European troops sent to Ukraine after a ceasefire — an idea long floated by Europe to prevent a new attack by Moscow — would be "absolutely unacceptable" and Russia would regard the deployment as a security threat and legitimate targets.
paras.zh: 普京向美国特使重申，停火后欧洲向乌克兰派遣任何军队——这是欧洲长期以来为防止莫斯科发动新的袭击而提出的想法——将是“绝对不可接受的”，俄罗斯将把这一部署视为安全威胁和合法目标。

paras.en: "In other words, the war would resume immediately," he said.
paras.zh: “换句话说，战争将立即恢复，”他说。

paras.en: He also said Russia regards its border with Ukraine to be sealed by a prospective peace deal as now extending to cover the four Ukrainian regions that Moscow annexed in 2022 but never fully controlled.
paras.zh: 他还表示，俄罗斯认为，未来的和平协议将封锁与乌克兰的边界，目前边界已扩大到莫斯科于 2022 年吞并但从未完全控制的四个乌克兰地区。

paras.en: Zelenskyy is in Dublin for a meeting of more than 40 European countries that also includes NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney was also present.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基正在都柏林参加 40 多个欧洲国家参加的会议，其中包括北约秘书长马克·吕特。加拿大总理马克·卡尼也在场。

paras.en: Rutte said the U.S., Europe and Ukraine are "very much aligned" on what security guarantees should look like, following a meeting in Paris in January.
paras.zh: 吕特表示，一月份在巴黎举行会议后，美国、欧洲和乌克兰就安全保障的内容“非常一致”。

paras.en: "But now of course we need the peace deal, or at least a ceasefire," Rutte said.
paras.zh: “但现在我们当然需要和平协议，或者至少是停火，”吕特说。

paras.en: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stands next to French President Emmanuel Macron, centre, and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney as they pose for a photo along with other leaders at the European Political Community (EPC) Summit in Dublin, Ireland, on Thursday. (Peter Morrison/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，在爱尔兰都柏林举行的欧洲政治共同体 (EPC) 峰会上，乌克兰总统泽连斯基站在法国总统马克龙（中）和加拿大总理马克卡尼旁边，与其他领导人合影。 （彼得·莫里森/美联社）

paras.en: Zelenskyy called the proposed prisoner exchange a positive step but also insisted Ukraine won't surrender Russian-occupied territory in return for peace.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基称拟议的囚犯交换是积极的一步，但也坚称乌克兰不会放弃俄罗斯占领的领土以换取和平。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine have occasionally swapped prisoners, but both sides remain far apart in their terms for accepting a settlement.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰偶尔会交换囚犯，但双方在接受和解的条款上仍存在很大分歧。

paras.en: Amid the negotiations, fighting continues along the 1,200-kilometre front line.
paras.zh: 谈判期间，1200公里前线的战斗仍在继续。

paras.en: Russia's bigger army has been held back by dogged Ukrainian resistance while Moscow's drone and missile strikes aim to deny civilians heat, electricity and running water, sapping public morale in what Kyiv calls a "weaponization of winter."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯规模更大的军队一直受到乌克兰顽强抵抗的阻碍，而莫斯科的无人机和导弹袭击旨在剥夺平民的供暖、电力和自来水，削弱公众士气，基辅称之为“冬季武器化”。

paras.en: Zelenskyy says Starshield service disrupted again
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称“星盾”服务再次中断

paras.en: Ukraine is experiencing another slowdown in the U.S. Starshield system — SpaceX's military-grade version of the Starlink satellite internet service — that the country needs to defend itself against Russian attacks, Zelenskyy said Thursday on social media.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周四在社交媒体上表示，乌克兰正在经历美国星盾系统（SpaceX 的星链卫星互联网服务的军用级版本）的又一次放缓，该国需要该系统来防御俄罗斯的攻击。

paras.en: Military units have recorded "significant disruptions," including speed restrictions limiting its drones to 161 kph, Zelenskyy said. He added that a military investigation established that the restrictions weren't random errors.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，军事单位记录了“严重干扰”，包括将无人机的速度限制在 161 公里/小时。他补充说，军事调查证实这些限制并非随机错误。

paras.en: Ukraine uses Starlink and Starshield for intercepting Russian drones and launching its own mid- and long-range strikes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰利用“星链”和“星盾”拦截俄罗斯无人机并发动自己的中远程打击。

paras.en: Last month, limits on Ukrainian drone speeds severely disrupted operations and alarmed Kyiv officials who fear U.S. support could drop off.
paras.zh: 上个月，对乌克兰无人机速度的限制严重扰乱了行动，并令基辅官员感到震惊，他们担心美国的支持可能会下降。

paras.en: Firefighters work on Thursday at an apartment building in Kyiv that was damaged following a Russian drone strike. (Gleb Garanich/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周四，消防队员在基辅的一栋公寓楼工作，该公寓楼在俄罗斯无人机袭击后受损。 （格莱布·加兰尼奇/路透社）

paras.en: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk acknowledged that his company had throttled the Starlink internet service in Ukraine for about a week, saying the system couldn't be used for offensive strikes against Russia.
paras.zh: SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克承认，他的公司已对乌克兰的 Starlink 互联网服务进行了大约一周的限制，并表示该系统不能用于对俄罗斯进行进攻。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said in Dublin that the speed limits cover operations in Russian-occupied parts of Ukraine and that Kyiv is trying to find out from U.S. officials what is going on.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在都柏林表示，速度限制涵盖了俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区的行动，基辅正在试图从美国官员那里了解发生了什么。

paras.en: "If someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then this tells us where things are going," he said.
paras.zh: “如果美国某人做出的决定基本上将乌克兰领土视为非乌克兰领土，那么这就会告诉我们事情的发展方向，”他说。

paras.en: Republican House member reacts to reports of Starshield throttling:
paras.zh: 共和党众议院议员对星盾节流的报道做出反应：

paras.en: Russia's Defence Ministry said its air defences downed 71 Ukrainian drones overnight. Its forces struck a drone-making plant in Kyiv and three other facilities producing missile fuel and drone components in the area around the Ukrainian capital, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，其防空系统一夜之间击落了 71 架乌克兰无人机。乌克兰国防部表示，其部队袭击了基辅的一家无人机制造厂以及乌克兰首都周边地区的另外三座生产导弹燃料和无人机零部件的设施。

paras.en: Russia launched missiles and 123 drones, 73 of them jet-powered drones, at Ukraine overnight, the Ukrainian air force said. Hits were recorded at 17 locations, it said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，俄罗斯连夜向乌克兰发射了导弹和 123 架无人机，其中 73 架是喷气式无人机。据称，有 17 个地点被击中。

articles.title: U.S. army guard receives medal from Hegseth after scolding him at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier

paras.en: U.S. army guard receives medal from Hegseth after scolding him at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
paras.zh: 美国陆军警卫在无名烈士墓辱骂赫格赛斯后获得奖章

paras.en: Pentagon said Specialist Thomas Iglesias 'correctly and respectfully' called for proper decorum
paras.zh: 五角大楼表示，专家托马斯·伊格莱西亚斯“正确且恭敬地”呼吁适当的礼仪

paras.en: U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth has given a top award to the service member who scolded him and his staff at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier following a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery.
paras.zh: 在阿灵顿国家公墓举行的退伍军人节仪式后，美国陆军部长皮特·赫格斯向在无名烈士墓中责骂他和他的工作人员的军人颁发了最高奖项。

paras.en: Hegseth welcomed to the Pentagon the army unit that guards the tomb and awarded Specialist Thomas Iglesias with the Joint Service Commendation Medal "for the execution of his duties at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Nov. 11, 2026," the Pentagon said.
paras.zh: 五角大楼表示，赫格斯欢迎守卫该墓的陆军部队来到五角大楼，并授予托马斯·伊格莱西亚斯联合服役奖章，以表彰他“于 2026 年 11 月 11 日在无名烈士墓履行职责”。

paras.en: On social media, Hegseth posted photos Thursday that show him pinning the award and shaking hands with a soldier. His post says: "We love soldiers. We love standards. Well done, Specialist."
paras.zh: 赫格斯周四在社交媒体上发布了照片，照片显示他将奖项别在胸前，并与一名士兵握手。他的帖子中写道：“我们热爱士兵。我们热爱标准。干得好，专家。”

paras.en: Iglesias reprimanded Hegseth and a group of his staffers when a loud laugh was heard after they took photos at the site following a ceremony that included U.S. President Donald Trump and Vice- President JD Vance.
paras.zh: 伊格莱西亚斯斥责了赫格斯和他的一群工作人员，当时他们在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和副总统 JD 万斯参加的仪式后在现场拍照，引发了一阵大笑。

paras.en: Video showed Hegseth taking photos on the empty steps in front of the tomb on Wednesday with his wife, Jennifer, chief of staff Ricky Buria, deputy chief of staff Patrick Weaver and senior adviser Tami Radabaugh.
paras.zh: 视频显示，赫格斯周三与妻子詹妮弗、幕僚长瑞奇·布里亚、副幕僚长帕特里克·韦弗和高级顾问塔米·拉达博在坟墓前的空台阶上拍照。

paras.en: The tomb is considered to be one of the most solemn and revered war memorials in the U.S., being the final resting place of unidentified soldiers from the First World War, the Second World War and the Korean War. It has been guarded around the clock regardless of weather conditions by a soldier from the Army's 3rd Infantry Regiment, also known as "The Old Guard," since 1948.
paras.zh: 该墓被认为是美国最庄严、最受尊敬的战争纪念碑之一，是第一次世界大战、第二次世界大战和朝鲜战争中身份不明的士兵的最后安息之地。自 1948 年以来，无论天气状况如何，这里都由一名来自陆军第三步兵团的士兵（也称为“老卫兵”）全天候守卫。

paras.en: The Joint Service Commendation Medal is considered to be one of the higher awards in the military and is not typically issued to junior enlisted service members.
paras.zh: 联合服役嘉奖奖章被认为是军队中的最高奖项之一，通常不会颁发给初级入伍军人。

paras.en: Sean Parnell, the Pentagon's top spokesperson, said soon after video of the reprimand emerged that the soldier "correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum."
paras.zh: 五角大楼最高发言人肖恩·帕内尔(Sean Parnell)在训斥视频曝光后不久表示，这名士兵“正确且恭敬地提醒大家保持礼仪”。

paras.en: The scolding drew attention once more to the embattled war secretary, who had survived an attempt to open impeachment proceedings. The effort was led by Republican Rep. Thomas Massie and backed by Democrats, though 11 missed the vote as other Republicans rejected the effort.
paras.zh: 这些责骂再次引起了人们对四面楚歌的战争部长的关注，他在弹劾程序的尝试中幸存下来。这项努力由共和党众议员托马斯·马西 (Thomas Massie) 领导，并得到民主党人的支持，但由于其他共和党人拒绝了这项努力，有 11 人错过了投票。

paras.en: While Hegseth's critics were not successful in Tuesday's vote, Republicans may have only delayed a bid to impeach him. With Democrats set to take control of the House and Senate in January, those efforts are likely to be renewed.
paras.zh: 虽然赫格斯的批评者在周二的投票中没有成功，但共和党人可能只是推迟了弹劾他的努力。随着民主党将于一月份控制众议院和参议院，这些努力可能会重新启动。

paras.en: Hegseth rebuked the move Tuesday in his first news conference in months, arguing that he had committed none of the high crimes required in the U.S. Constitution for his removal and framing the effort as an indictment against the nation's service members and their successes.
paras.zh: 周二，赫格斯在几个月来的首次新闻发布会上谴责了这一举动，称他没有犯下美国宪法规定的免职重罪，并将这一努力视为对美国军人及其成功的起诉。

paras.en: "This is not patriotism," Hegseth argued. "This is sabotage."
paras.zh: “这不是爱国主义，”赫格斯辩称。 “这是破坏活动。”

articles.title: Will U.S. travel pick up after midterm 'blue wave'? Not so fast, say these Canadians
articles.author: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours

paras.en: Will U.S. travel pick up after midterm 'blue wave'? Not so fast, say these Canadians
paras.zh: 中期“蓝色浪潮”过后，美国旅游业会回暖吗？这些加拿大人说，没那么快

paras.en: Many Canadians have been boycotting U.S. travel amid Trump's tariffs and other threats
paras.zh: 由于特朗普的关税和其他威胁，许多加拿大人一直抵制美国旅行

paras.en: John May had low expectations ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.
paras.zh: 约翰·梅对美国中期选举抱有较低的期望。

paras.en: But he was glad to see the Democratic Party take control of both chambers of Congress in a Nov. 3 vote that many observers have described as a resounding rebuke of U.S. President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 但他很高兴看到民主党在 11 月 3 日的投票中控制了参众两院，许多观察家称这是对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的响亮谴责。

paras.en: "It's encouraging, isn't it? To see that there's finally some common sense coming around down there," said the 73-year-old from Manotick, Ont., an Ottawa suburb.
paras.zh: 这位来自渥太华郊区安省马诺蒂克的 73 岁老人说：“这很令人鼓舞，不是吗？看到那里终于有了一些常识。”

paras.en: - LISTEN How will Republicans and Democrats move forward after midterms?
paras.zh: - 听听中期选举后共和党和民主党将如何前进？

paras.en: - Americans in Canada hope midterm results will help mend ties between both countries
paras.zh: - 加拿大美国人希望中期选举结果将有助于修复两国之间的关系

paras.en: May, who stopped travelling to the United States last year amid Trump's repeated threats against Canada, said he and his wife Patti aren't ready to go south of the border again just yet though.
paras.zh: 梅去年因特朗普一再威胁加拿大而停止前往美国，他表示，他和妻子帕蒂目前还没有准备好再次前往边境以南。

paras.en: The couple had spent winters in Florida for more than a decade before May said the atmosphere turned "toxic" as Trump mocked Canadian leaders and pushed to turn Canada into the "51st state."
paras.zh: 这对夫妇在佛罗里达州度过了十多年的冬天，直到特雷莎·梅表示，随着特朗普嘲笑加拿大领导人并推动将加拿大变成“第51个州”，气氛变得“有毒”。

paras.en: "We'd like to, but we're not feeling like we want to go back yet," May told CBC News.
paras.zh: “我们愿意，但我们还不想回去，”梅告诉加拿大广播公司新闻。

paras.en: "I think we've got to wait until they've got a different president down there and a whole different attitude," he said. "Things haven't changed enough. We'll need a couple more years, I think."
paras.zh: “我认为我们必须等到他们有一位不同的总统并采取完全不同的态度，”他说。 “事情还没有发生足够的改变。我想我们还需要几年的时间。”

paras.en: John and Patti May pose for a photo in Key West, Fla., in February 2024. (Submitted by John May)
paras.zh: 约翰·梅 (John May) 和帕蒂·梅 (Patti May) 于 2024 年 2 月在佛罗里达州基韦斯特合影留念。（约翰·梅提交）

paras.en: Many Canadians, including those with relatives or business interests south of the border, have continued to travel to the U.S. amid Trump's threats and the trade war with Canada.
paras.zh: 在特朗普的威胁和与加拿大的贸易战中，许多加拿大人，包括那些在边境以南有亲戚或商业利益的加拿大人，继续前往美国。

paras.en: But data shows travel to the U.S. has dropped alongside the strained relationship.
paras.zh: 但数据显示，随着两国关系紧张，赴美旅游人数有所下降。

paras.en: According to Statistics Canada, return border crossings from the U.S. fell by about 25 per cent in 2025 compared with the previous year.
paras.zh: 根据加拿大统计局的数据，2025 年从美国返回的过境人数比上一年减少了约 25%。

paras.en: - Are you changing your holiday plans due to the cost of domestic airfare in Canada? Getting creative to find cheaper alternatives? Send an email to ask@cbc.ca.
paras.zh: - 您是否因为加拿大国内机票的价格而改变您的假期计划？发挥创意寻找更便宜的替代品？发送电子邮件至ask@cbc.ca。

paras.en: There has been a slight increase in 2026: A total of 1.9 million return trips by car and air from the U.S. were reported in October, marking the seventh consecutive month of year-over-year growth and a three per cent increase from October 2025, Statistics Canada reported.
paras.zh: 2026 年略有增长：据加拿大统计局报告，10 月份从美国乘汽车和飞机回程的旅客总数为 190 万人次，连续第七个月同比增长，较 2025 年 10 月增长 3%。

paras.en: But when compared with October 2024, return trips by car were down 29 per cent while those by air were down 19.6 per cent.
paras.zh: 但与 2024 年 10 月相比，乘汽车回程减少了 29%，乘飞机回程则减少了 19.6%。

paras.en: It's too soon to say whether the midterms will lead to a major increase in Canadian travel south.
paras.zh: 现在判断中期选举是否会导致加拿大南部旅游大幅增加还为时过早。

paras.en: McKenzie McMillan, a travel consultant and co-owner of The Travel Group in Vancouver, said that, anecdotally, there may be some "softening" around U.S. travel.
paras.zh: 温哥华旅游集团的共同所有者兼旅游顾问麦肯齐·麦克米伦 (McKenzie McMillan) 表示，据传闻，美国旅游可能会出现一些“疲软”。

paras.en: "But it hasn't really translated at this point into new bookings, or a real change in the overall sentiment to avoid the United States," McMillan said. "We are still hearing overall that travellers are looking to alternative destinations for their winter travel and beyond."
paras.zh: 麦克米伦说：“但目前这还没有真正转化为新的预订，也没有真正改变避开美国的整体情绪。” “总体而言，我们仍然听说旅行者正在寻找其他目的地来进行冬季旅行及以后的旅行。”

paras.en: Spokespersons for Air Canada and Porter Airlines also told CBC this week that it was too early to say whether the midterms have had an effect on travel. Air Transat said it did not have sufficient data to identify a trend.
paras.zh: 加拿大航空和波特航空的发言人本周也告诉加拿大广播公司，现在判断中期选举是否对旅行产生影响还为时过早。越洋航空表示，没有足够的数据来确定趋势。

paras.en: But the midterms may help ease the negative feelings that some Canadians have had.
paras.zh: 但中期选举可能有助于缓解一些加拿大人的负面情绪。

paras.en: Marja Vermeer, a 67-year-old from Strathroy, Ont., said the vote results, coupled with messages over the past two years from Americans rejecting the Trump administration's attacks against Canada, make her more open to visiting the U.S.
paras.zh: 来自安大略省斯特拉斯罗伊的 67 岁玛贾·维米尔 (Marja Vermeer) 表示，投票结果，加上过去两年美国人拒绝特朗普政府攻击加拿大的信息，使她对访问美国更加持开放态度。

paras.en: "Especially to the states where they voted Democrat, I think they're ... a bit more comfortable and a bit more welcoming," she said.
paras.zh: “特别是对于那些投票给民主党的州，我认为他们……更舒服一些，更受欢迎一些，”她说。

paras.en: Jill Ellis-Worthington, 65, of London, Ont., also said the midterms made a recent trip to the U.S. more palatable.
paras.zh: 来自安大略省伦敦的 65 岁吉尔·埃利斯-沃辛顿 (Jill Ellis-Worthington) 也表示，中期选举让最近的美国之行变得更加愉快。

paras.en: Ellis-Worthington — who is originally from the U.S. but has been living in Canada since age 25 — said she went to her home country this month to deal with issues at a Texas property she owns. It was her first visit since 2024, and one she had put off for as long as possible.
paras.zh: 埃利斯-沃辛顿来自美国，但自 25 岁以来一直居住在加拿大。她说，她本月前往祖国处理她在德克萨斯州拥有的一处房产的问题。这是她自 2024 年以来第一次访问，但她已经尽可能推迟了。

paras.en: - Windsor residents not ready to return to U.S. despite Democratic midterm wins
paras.zh: - 尽管民主党中期选举获胜，温莎居民还没有准备好返回美国

paras.en: - Analysis How the Democrats' midterm wave shows a path back to the presidency
paras.zh: - 分析民主党的中期浪潮如何显示重返总统宝座的道路

paras.en: "There's just so much chaos and so much denial of everything that is America going on now with the government, so I just didn't want to support that in any way," she told CBC.
paras.zh: 她告诉加拿大广播公司：“美国政府现在发生的一切都非常混乱，而且都被否认，所以我不想以任何方式支持这一点。”

paras.en: "I think there are a lot of people who feel great relief [after the midterms] and feel that there might be some light on the horizon."
paras.zh: “我认为（中期选举后）很多人都感到如释重负，并感觉地平线上可能会出现一些曙光。”

paras.en: Ellis-Worthington said Americans had been "nothing but friendly, gracious [and] hospitable" during her trip. But she acknowledged that some Canadians likely won't be going back soon, despite last week's vote. "And some won't ever go back, I don’t think."
paras.zh: 埃利斯-沃辛顿表示，在她的旅途中，美国人“除了友好、亲切和好客之外什么都没有”。但她承认，尽管上周进行了投票，一些加拿大人可能不会很快回去。 “我认为有些人永远不会回去。”

paras.en: The Peace Bridge U.S.-Canada border crossing is seen on March 20 in Buffalo, N.Y. (Yuki Iwamura/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 3 月 20 日，纽约州布法罗的和平桥美加边境口岸（Yuki Iwamura/美联社）

paras.en: Indeed, the new Congress doesn't take office until January, and many observers say the Trump administration's policies — including an immigration crackdown that has led to the detention of several Canadian citizens in recent months — continue to fuel distrust.
paras.zh: 事实上，新国会要到一月份才就职，许多观察家表示，特朗普政府的政策——包括近几个月导致几名加拿大公民被拘留的移民镇压政策——继续加剧不信任。

paras.en: Mary Thurber, who lives in Lake Country in B.C.'s Okanagan Valley, said she has avoided going to the U.S. for several reasons.
paras.zh: 住在不列颠哥伦比亚省奥肯那根山谷湖区的玛丽·瑟伯说，她出于多种原因避免去美国。

paras.en: "It's a combination of anger at their policies and disgust with some of the treatment of their own citizens, and frankly, a little bit of fear," said Thurber, 70. "And do I want to support the economy of ... an administration that is actively attacking my country?"
paras.zh: 70 岁的瑟伯说：“这是对他们政策的愤怒和对本国公民所受待遇的厌恶的结合，坦率地说，还有一点恐惧。我想支持一个正在积极攻击我的国家的政府的经济吗？”

paras.en: But she said visiting the U.S. is now "an active discussion" in her home after the midterms.
paras.zh: 但她表示，中期选举结束后，访问美国现在是她家中的“一个积极的讨论”。

paras.en: "My husband sometimes says, 'I know! Let's only go to the blue states,'" she said with a laugh. "And I'm like, 'Yeah but that doesn't quite deal with the fact that their president is still actively attacking us.'"
paras.zh: “我丈夫有时会说，‘我知道！我们只去蓝色州吧，’”她笑着说。 “我想，‘是的，但这并不能完全解决他们的总统仍在积极攻击我们的事实。’”

paras.en: Thurber said she doesn't know when she might feel comfortable going back, adding she expects the Trump administration's policies to have a lasting impact. "That's a hard one," she said.
paras.zh: 瑟伯表示，她不知道什么时候可以放心回去，并补充说她预计特朗普政府的政策将产生持久影响。 “这很难，”她说。

articles.title: What have the talks with Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi achieved for Ukraine?

paras.en: The two-day talks between delegations from Ukraine, the US and Russia in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11 ended without a ceasefire agreement.
paras.zh: 乌克兰、美国和俄罗斯代表团于11月10日至11日在阿布扎比举行了为期两天的会谈，但没有达成停火协议。

paras.en: The main outcome was an agreement on a prisoner exchange.
paras.zh: 主要成果是就囚犯交换达成了协议。

paras.en: "We have agreed on the largest humanitarian release of prisoners, and tomorrow we will finalize the numbers," Jared Kushner announced after the talks. US envoys Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow on Thursday, where they are due to meet President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 贾里德·库什纳在会谈后宣布：“我们已就最大规模的人道主义释放囚犯达成一致，明天我们将敲定具体数字。”美国特使库什纳和史蒂夫·威特科夫周四抵达莫斯科，他们将在那里会见总统弗拉基米尔·普京。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy had earlier suggested an exchange of "1,000 for 1,000" prisoners, or "1,500 for 1,500." Russia said a large-scale prisoner exchange with Ukraine could take place within the next two to three weeks.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基早些时候曾建议以“1,000 人换 1,000 名”囚犯，或“1,500 人换 1,500 人”。俄罗斯表示，未来两到三周内可能会与乌克兰进行大规模的囚犯交换。

paras.en: Following the meetings, Zelenskyy wrote on Telegram that the parties had discussed security guarantees and that "the first step should be ending this war and ensuring Ukraine's security." He also stressed that Europe should be involved "at every stage of genuine diplomacy."
paras.zh: 会面结束后，泽伦斯基在 Telegram 上写道，双方讨论了安全保障，“第一步应该是结束这场战争并确保乌克兰的安全”。他还强调，欧洲应该参与“真正外交的每个阶段”。

paras.en: Experts interviewed by DW agree that the main outcome of the talks is humanitarian.
paras.zh: 接受德国之声采访的专家一致认为，此次会谈的主要成果是人道主义方面的。

paras.en: "The agreement on a prisoner exchange is already a major step forward," says Artjom Bronzhukov of the Ukrainian think tank Polityka.
paras.zh: 乌克兰智库Polityka的Artjom Bronzhukov表示：“交换囚犯的协议已经是向前迈出的重要一步。”

paras.en: Pavlo Lakiychuk of the Ukrainian Center for Global Studies Strategy XXI also viewed it as a "very tangible result." He told DW that "getting our people back is already a major success. That is why it is worth continuing."
paras.zh: 乌克兰第二十一届全球研究战略中心的帕夫洛·拉基丘克（Pavlo Lakiychuk）也认为这是一个“非常切实的结果”。他告诉德国之声，“让我们的员工回来已经是一个重大成功。这就是为什么值得继续下去。”

paras.en: A real breakthrough, he added, would be the release of civilian detainees from territories occupied since 2014, particularly people from Crimea, who have been held in Russian prisons for years.
paras.zh: 他补充说，真正的突破将是释放自 2014 年以来被占领领土上被拘留的平民，特别是来自克里米亚的人，他们已被关押在俄罗斯监狱多年。

paras.en: Empty diplomacy without a real breakthrough?
paras.zh: 空洞的外交没有真正的突破？

paras.en: Davyd Arakhamia, head of the ruling Servant of the People parliamentary faction and Ukraine's representative at the talks in Abu Dhabi, gave a positive assessment of the trilateral talks with the US and Russia, expressing hope that an agreement could be reached by the end of the year.
paras.zh: 执政党人民公仆党党魁、乌克兰出席阿布扎比会谈的代表戴维德·阿拉卡米亚对美俄三方会谈给予积极评价，表示希望年底前达成协议。

paras.en: "I think the Russians came with extremely strict instructions, and it was difficult to ease the tone of the discussion. But the way the US representatives structured the talks with a view to the postwar situation in both countries opened up a dialogue, in my opinion, and allowed us to work together more productively," Arakhamia said at a joint press conference with US and Ukrainian representatives following the talks.
paras.zh: 阿拉卡米亚在会谈后与美国和乌克兰代表举行的联合新闻发布会上表示：“我认为俄罗斯人带着极其严格的指示而来，很难缓和讨论的基调。但我认为，美国代表着眼于两国战后局势而安排会谈的方式开启了对话，并使我们能够更富有成效地合作。”

paras.en: Iuliia Osmolovska of the Kyiv office of the international think tank GLOBSEC cautions against reading too much into the positive assessments of the talks from Washington and Kyiv.
paras.zh: 国际智库 GLOBSEC 基辅办事处的尤利娅·奥斯莫洛夫斯卡 (Iuliia Osmolovska) 警告不要过度解读华盛顿和基辅对会谈的积极评价。

paras.en: "Diplomats taking part in negotiations will never say that everything went badly and that they have no expectations. Even when no results are achieved, they will still emphasize that the talks were constructive," she said. "For anyone familiar with diplomatic language, these are simply standard phrases."
paras.zh: “参加谈判的外交官永远不会说一切都不顺利，没有任何期望。即使没有取得任何成果，他们仍然会强调谈判是建设性的，”她说。 “对于任何熟悉外交语言的人来说，这些只是标准短语。”

paras.en: Experts: chances for Russia-Ukraine ceasefire low as things currently stand
paras.zh: 专家：从目前情况看，俄罗斯和乌克兰停火的可能性很低

paras.en: Osmolovska points to a joint assessment by 71 Ukrainian security and defense experts published by GLOBSEC in the summer. According to the assessment, the chances of a peace agreement or at least a ceasefire being reached this year or next stand at just 19%.
paras.zh: 奥斯莫洛夫斯卡指出，GLOBSEC 今年夏天发布了 71 名乌克兰安全和国防专家的联合评估报告。据评估，今年或明年达成和平协议或至少达成停火的可能性仅为19%。

paras.en: She blames this on the fact that neither side is "ready" for genuine negotiations. Russia, in particular, has yet to accept that its objectives cannot be achieved by military means. "What we are seeing now is more of a farce, an attempt by all sides to put a brave face on things and create the impression that something is moving forward," Osmolovska said.
paras.zh: 她将此归咎于双方都没有“准备好”进行真正的谈判。尤其是俄罗斯，尚未承认其目标无法通过军事手段实现。奥斯莫洛夫斯卡说：“我们现在看到的更像是一场闹剧，各方都试图勇敢地面对事情，给人留下事情正在向前发展的印象。”

paras.en: Artjom Bronzhukov sees the talks as a way for Moscow to buy time.
paras.zh: 阿乔姆·布龙朱科夫认为会谈是莫斯科争取时间的一种方式。

paras.en: "The visits by the Russian delegation, particularly under the leadership of Vladimir Medinsky, are nothing more than an attempt to stall and sell empty promises to the US administration in the form of grand agreements, in order to continue receiving so-called gestures of goodwill from Washington, such as the lifting of sanctions on Russian diesel," the political scientist says.
paras.zh: 这位政治学家表示：“俄罗斯代表团的访问，特别是在弗拉基米尔·梅丁斯基领导下的访问，无非是试图拖延并向美国政府兜售大协议形式的空头承诺，以继续收到华盛顿所谓的善意姿态，例如取消对俄罗斯柴油机的制裁。”

paras.en: Redrawing borders to make Putin feel like a winner?
paras.zh: 重新划定边界让普京感觉自己是胜利者？

paras.en: Ahead of the talks, several Western media outlets reported on new US proposals concerning disputed territories. The Economist, for example, reported on a proposal to redraw the administrative boundaries of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions. However, a member of the Ukrainian delegation stressed that there had "never been any discussion of concessions on territories occupied by Russia."
paras.zh: 会谈前，多家西方媒体报道了美国有关争议领土的新提议。例如，《经济学人》报道了一项重新划定顿涅茨克和卢甘斯克地区行政边界的提案。不过，乌克兰代表团的一名成员强调，“从未讨论过对俄罗斯占领的领土让步的问题”。

paras.en: Washington made no official comment on the reports.
paras.zh: 华盛顿没有对这些报道发表正式评论。

paras.en: Kyrylo Budanov, a member of the negotiating delegation and head of the Ukrainian president's office, declined to say whether Russia had used the talks to demand that Ukrainian troops withdraw from the Donbas. Asked by journalists whether Moscow was still insisting that Ukraine pull out of the region, Budanov said the content of the negotiations would remain confidential until an agreement was reached.
paras.zh: 谈判代表团成员、乌克兰总统办公室主任凯里洛·布达诺夫拒绝透露俄罗斯是否利用此次会谈要求乌克兰军队从顿巴斯撤军。当被记者问及莫斯科是否仍坚持要求乌克兰退出该地区时，布达诺夫表示，在达成协议之前，谈判内容将保密。

paras.en: "The issues discussed in the talks are matters for negotiation. The only thing that matters is the outcome. Once we achieve it, it will be made public," Budanov said.
paras.zh: 布达诺夫说：“会谈中讨论的问题是谈判的问题。唯一重要的是结果。一旦我们实现了目标，就会公开。”

paras.en: The head of the Russian delegation, Vladimir Medinsky, took a different tone, declaring that "every inch of our land will be returned to Russia one way or another." He was responding to reports in European media that Ukraine was rejecting territorial concessions.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯代表团团长弗拉基米尔·梅丁斯基则采取了不同的语气，宣称“我们的每一寸土地都将以某种方式归还俄罗斯”。他是在回应欧洲媒体有关乌克兰拒绝领土让步的报道。

paras.en: Putin demands large swaths of Ukrainian territory
paras.zh: 普京要求获得乌克兰大片领土

paras.en: In addition to the Crimean Peninsula, annexed in 2014, Russian President Vladimir Putin claims the four Ukrainian regions of Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson in their entirety as Russian territory, even though Russia does not have full military control over them.
paras.zh: 除了2014年吞并的克里米亚半岛外，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京声称顿涅茨克、卢甘斯克、扎波罗热和赫尔松这四个乌克兰地区全部都是俄罗斯领土，尽管俄罗斯对这些地区没有完全的军事控制权。

paras.en: "Putin is not fighting over villages and ruined cowsheds in the Donbas. He is fighting for geopolitical influence and trying to exploit the collapse of the old world order," says Artjom Bronzhukov.
paras.zh: “普京并不是为了顿巴斯的村庄和被毁的牛棚而战。他是为了地缘政治影响力而战，并试图利用旧世界秩序的崩溃，”阿乔姆·布隆朱科夫说。

paras.en: The expert from the Polityka think tank recalls that Ukraine was already asked in early 2026 to withdraw its troops from the part of the Donbas it controls and turn the area into a free economic zone. Such a zone "would very quickly become a Russian-controlled area," he warns.
paras.zh: Polityka智库的专家回忆说，乌克兰已于2026年初被要求从其控制的顿巴斯地区撤军，并将该地区转变为自由经济区。他警告说，这样的地区“很快就会成为俄罗斯控制的地区”。

paras.en: Pavlo Lakiychuk questions the idea of changing administrative boundaries.
paras.zh: 帕夫洛·拉基丘克 (Pavlo Lakiychuk) 对改变行政边界的想法提出质疑。

paras.en: "Why would Putin stop there?" asks the expert from the Strategy XXI center. In his view, US negotiators are seeking to extract unilateral concessions from Ukraine "step by step" without demanding anything in return from Russia.
paras.zh: “普京为什么要停在那里？” XXI 战略中心的专家问道。他认为，美国谈判代表正在寻求“一步一步”迫使乌克兰做出单方面让步，而不要求俄罗斯做出任何回报。

paras.en: Iuliia Osmolovska describes the proposal as "very original," but says it would pose risks for Ukraine's leadership. Even if the Ukrainian delegation agreed to it, which Osmolovska doubts, the decision would have to be explained to the public, which, she says, is not ready to accept it.
paras.zh: 尤利娅·奥斯莫洛夫斯卡 (Iuliia Osmolovska) 称该提案“非常新颖”，但表示这会给乌克兰领导层带来风险。即使乌克兰代表团同意这一决定（奥斯莫洛夫斯卡对此表示怀疑），该决定也必须向公众解释，她说公众还没有准备好接受这一决定。

paras.en: The GLOBSEC expert points out that, following the last harsh winter, marked by shortages of electricity and heating, only 5% of Ukrainians were willing to make concessions to Russia in exchange for an end to attacks on the energy sector.
paras.zh: GLOBSEC专家指出，在经历了去年电力和供暖短缺的严冬之后，只有5%的乌克兰人愿意向俄罗斯做出让步，以换取停止对能源部门的攻击。

paras.en: Following the meeting between Jared Kushner, US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Vladimir Putin in Moscow, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he wants to "coordinate positions with the Americans once again." No further trilateral meetings have been announced so far.
paras.zh: 贾里德·库什纳、美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和弗拉基米尔·普京在莫斯科会晤后，弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基表示，他希望“再次与美国人协调立场”。到目前为止，尚未宣布进一步的三边会议。

paras.en: Iuliia Osmolovska believes the parties will sooner or later have to admit that the negotiations have reached a dead end. She expects each side to return to military action.
paras.zh: 尤利娅·奥斯莫洛夫斯卡（Iuliia Osmolovska）认为，双方迟早必须承认谈判已陷入僵局。她希望双方恢复军事行动。

paras.en: Pavlo Lakiychuk, by contrast, believes the talks should continue, if only to secure the return of prisoners. He is also convinced that Europeans "will always be there," because the issue is not just the Russian-Ukrainian war but the security of the entire continent.
paras.zh: 相比之下，帕夫洛·拉基丘克（Pavlo Lakiychuk）认为，即使只是为了确保囚犯返回，谈判也应该继续进行。他还坚信欧洲人“将永远在那里”，因为问题不仅仅是俄罗斯-乌克兰战争，而是整个大陆的安全。

paras.en: This article was originally published in Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 本文最初以乌克兰语发表。

articles.title: Can the EU make it harder to trick consumers online?

paras.en: Under the European Commission's proposed Digital Fairness Act (DFA), a company would have to remind you before the free trial ends and get your explicit agreement before it can start charging you. The proposed law would also make it easier to cancel a subscription online and require reminders before certain contracts renew automatically.
paras.zh: 根据欧盟委员会提议的数字公平法案 (DFA)，公司必须在免费试用结束之前提醒您，并获得您的明确同意，然后才能开始向您收费。拟议的法律还将使在线取消订阅变得更加容易，并在某些合同自动续订之前要求提醒。

paras.en: The Commission presented the proposal on Wednesday. It wants to give consumers more control over how much time and money they spend online.
paras.zh: 委员会于周三提交了该提案。它希望让消费者更好地控制自己在网上花费的时间和金钱。

paras.en: "We haven't seen that kind of reform in consumer protection in the last 20 years," Agustin Reyna, director general of the European Consumer Organisation (BEUC), told DW.
paras.zh: 欧洲消费者组织（BEUC）总干事奥古斯丁·雷纳（Agustin Reyna）告诉德国之声：“过去20年我们还没有看到这种消费者保护方面的改革。”

paras.en: His organization pushed for stronger EU rules against manipulative online practices. He sees the proposal as a good starting point for tackling problems that frustrate consumers every day.
paras.zh: 他的组织推动欧盟制定更严格的规则，打击网络操纵行为。他认为该提案是解决每天困扰消费者的问题的一个良好起点。

paras.en: Ending doomscrolling and 'dark patterns'
paras.zh: 结束末日卷轴和“黑暗模式”

paras.en: The proposal also includes a ban on manipulative marketing tactics, so-called "dark patterns." A concrete example: You are trying to reserve a hotel room and the website claims that only three are left, a potentially false claim to pressure you into buying.
paras.zh: 该提案还包括禁止操纵性营销策略，即所谓的“黑暗模式”。一个具体的例子：您正在尝试预订一个酒店房间，而该网站声称只剩下三个房间，这可能是一个错误的说法，旨在迫使您购买。

paras.en: A concert ticket that gets more expensive while you're waiting in an online queue raises a different problem. The price could still go up in the process, but the seller would have to show the current price while you wait and tell you the maximum you could be asked to pay.
paras.zh: 当你在线排队等候时，音乐会门票会变得更加昂贵，这会引发另一个问题。在此过程中，价格仍可能上涨，但卖家必须在您等待时显示当前价格，并告诉您可能需要支付的最高金额。

paras.en: Online games that encourage users to spend their money to advance are also targeted. Children would no longer be able to pay to win or get to the next level of their online game.
paras.zh: 鼓励用户花钱晋级的网络游戏也是目标。孩子们将无法再付费赢得在线游戏或进入下一个级别。

paras.en: Marketing and personalized ads would need to be clearly marked and restricted in the case of children. Consumers should get the option to switch off doomscrolling functions such as the autoplay of videos, showing one clip after the other. With these new rules, the EU wants to make apps and websites less addictive.
paras.zh: 针对儿童的营销和个性化广告需要明确标记和限制。消费者应该可以选择关闭末日滚动功能，例如视频自动播放，一个接一个地播放剪辑。通过这些新规则，欧盟希望降低应用程序和网站的成瘾性。

paras.en: For Christoph Busch, an academic with a focus on consumer law and digital services based at Osnabrück University in Germany, the option to opt out doesn't go far enough. He argues that a version in which consumers actively have to choose to opt into those functions would be more effective.
paras.zh: 德国奥斯纳布吕克大学专注于消费者法和数字服务的学者克里斯托夫·布施 (Christoph Busch) 认为，选择退出还远远不够。他认为，消费者必须主动选择使用这些功能的版本会更有效。

paras.en: "But then there is always the question of proportionality," Busch said. "And I think here the European legislators are trying to balance different interests."
paras.zh: “但始终存在比例问题，”布希说。 “我认为欧洲立法者正在试图平衡不同的利益。”

paras.en: These competing interests are particularly visible in the gaming industry, where interest groups have warned that the proposed EU restrictions could hurt developers and leave players with fewer options to choose from.
paras.zh: 这些相互竞争的利益在游戏行业尤其明显，利益团体警告称，拟议的欧盟限制可能会损害开发商，并使玩家的选择更少。

paras.en: Video Games Europe and the European Games Developer Federation called the proposal "unworkable, unjustified and disproportionate," arguing that a ban on selling children features that help them win or advance is worded so broadly that it "could cover almost any purchase in a game."
paras.zh: 欧洲视频游戏和欧洲游戏开发商联合会称该提案“不可行、不合理且不相称”，并认为禁止销售有助于儿童获胜或晋级的功能的禁令措辞过于广泛，以至于“几乎涵盖了游戏中的所有购买行为”。

paras.en: For Busch, this argument doesn't hold. "If your business model is based on addictive design features, then maybe your business model has to be reviewed," he said.
paras.zh: 对于布施来说，这个论点并不成立。 “如果你的商业模式是基于令人上瘾的设计功能，那么也许你的商业模式必须进行审查，”他说。

paras.en: Catalina Goanta, an associate professor of private law and technology at Utrecht University, emphasized in an interview with DW that "regulation can very easily slide into overregulation."
paras.zh: 乌得勒支大学私法与技术副教授卡特琳娜·戈安塔(Catalina Goanta)在接受德国之声采访时强调，“监管很容易陷入过度监管”。

paras.en: Even though she believes that the DFA is a solid and reasonable compromise, she argues that prohibiting dark patterns and doomscrolling altogether would be too prohibitive. Many of the issues consumers currently face could be resolved by enforcing existing regulation more effectively, she said.
paras.zh: 尽管她认为 DFA 是一个可靠且合理的妥协方案，但她认为，完全禁止黑暗模式和末日滚动会过于令人望而却步。她说，消费者目前面临的许多问题可以通过更有效地执行现有监管来解决。

paras.en: She points to the fact that the EU has made a name for itself in the past by adding new rules and regulations that have made it more difficult to access the European market, especially for small online businesses.
paras.zh: 她指出，欧盟过去曾通过增加新的规则和法规而闻名，这些规则和法规使得进入欧洲市场变得更加困难，特别是对于小型在线企业而言。

paras.en: "Instead of having 27 different regulations to adhere to, companies will now only get one," Reyna said.
paras.zh: “公司现在只需遵守一项法规，而不是 27 项不同的法规，”雷纳说。

paras.en: For him, this speaks for simplification, especially when the responsibility for compliance is shared between online influencers and the platforms they publish on.
paras.zh: 对他来说，这意味着简化，尤其是当合规责任由在线影响者和他们发布的平台共同承担时。

paras.en: According to the new legislation, the EU would have the possibility to impose fines of up to six percent of a company's global annual revenue should the company violate the law.
paras.zh: 根据新立法，如果公司违反法律，欧盟将有可能对其处以高达全球年收入百分之六的罚款。

paras.en: The European Parliament and the Council, which represents member state governments, still have to agree on the text and formally adopt it. All experts agree that in that process, changes are still very likely.
paras.zh: 代表成员国政府的欧洲议会和理事会仍需就文本达成一致并正式通过。所有专家都认为，在这个过程中，改变的可能性仍然很大。

paras.en: "It will be a difficult trialogue, especially in this climate of simplification and deregulation with a focus on strengthening European competitiveness," said Christoph Busch. In that climate, it is not easy to add consumer rights, he adds.
paras.zh: 克里斯托夫·布施表示：“这将是一场艰难的三方对话，尤其是在这种简化和放松管制、重点是加强欧洲竞争力的环境下。”他补充说，在这种环境下，增加消费者权利并不容易。

paras.en: Agustin Reyna is more optimistic. "The parliament is a divided house, much more than in the past," he says. "But consumer protection is a subject that brings parties together because it brings tangible outcomes to people."
paras.zh: 奥古斯丁·雷纳则更为乐观。 “议会是一个分裂的议院，比过去更加分裂，”他说。 “但消费者保护是一个将各方聚集在一起的主题，因为它给人们带来了切实的成果。”

articles.title: Czechia braces for massive protest as anger over government's public media reform plans boils

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of people are expected to rally in Prague this weekend to protest the Czech government's bid to ram a bill to reform public media funding through parliament in a surprise overnight session late last month.
paras.zh: 预计本周末将有数十万人在布拉格集会，抗议捷克政府在上个月末的一次夜间会议上出人意料地通过议会提出改革公共媒体资金的法案。

paras.en: The populist coalition of Prime Minister Andrej Babis fast-tracked the first of three readings of the legislation, which culminated in a vote of approval at 04:36 a.m. on October 24.
paras.zh: 总理安德烈·巴比斯 (Andrej Babis) 领导的民粹主义联盟迅速对该法案进行了三读中的第一读，最终于 10 月 24 日凌晨 04:36 投票通过。

paras.en: The bill has already provoked numerous demonstrations and strikes across the country, but Sunday's gathering in the capital's Letna Park is likely to be by far the largest to date.
paras.zh: 该法案已经在全国各地引发了无数示威和罢工，但周日在首都莱特纳公园举行的集会可能是迄今为止规模最大的一次。

paras.en: Under the government's proposal, the license fee model that currently funds Czech Television (CT) and Czech Radio (CRo) would be scrapped, and the broadcasters would be funded directly from the state budget.
paras.zh: 根据政府的提议，目前为捷克电视台（CT）和捷克广播电台（CRo）提供资金的许可费模式将被取消，广播公司将直接由国家预算提供资金。

paras.en: The three parties in the coalition — Babis's centrist ANO, the far-right SPD, and radical conservative Motorists, whose voter bases tend to be less affluent — insist that the license fee is an unfair tax.
paras.zh: 联盟中的三个政党——巴比斯的中间派ANO、极右翼的社民党和选民基础往往不太富裕的激进保守派汽车党——坚持认为牌照费是一种不公平的税收。

paras.en: The parties argue that the new arrangement, which would see funding for CT and CRo cut by around 15% in the first year, would make the two more efficient. They also point out that several other European Union states have made similar changes.
paras.zh: 双方认为，新的安排将使 CT 和 CRo 的资金在第一年减少约 15%，从而提高两者的效率。他们还指出，其他几个欧盟国家也做出了类似的改变。

paras.en: Critics have angrily dismissed these justifications.
paras.zh: 批评者愤怒地驳斥了这些理由。

paras.en: Opposition parties, civil society organizations and international watchdogs accuse the government of seeking to undermine the independence of the broadcasters, whose critical reporting has long irked ANO and the SPD in particular.
paras.zh: 反对党、民间社会组织和国际监管机构指责政府试图破坏广播公司的独立性，而广播公司的批评性报道长期以来一直激怒了 ANO 和社会民主党。

paras.en: Analysts point out that while models in other EU states include guarantees of long-term financial stability and editorial independence, the Czech government proposal offers neither.
paras.zh: 分析人士指出，虽然其他欧盟国家的模式包括对长期金融稳定和编辑独立性的保证，但捷克政府的提案两者都没有提供。

paras.en: CT and CRo have warned that the reduced budget included in the bill will mean programming- and staff cuts.
paras.zh: CT 和 CRO 警告称，该法案中预算的减少将意味着节目编排和人员削减。

paras.en: When the first publication of the proposed bill was met with protests over the summer, Vaclav Stetka of the European New School of Digital Studies told DW that such "dramatic budget cuts represent an act of cultural vandalism."
paras.zh: 今年夏天，当拟议法案首次发布时遭到抗议，欧洲数字研究新学院的瓦茨拉夫·斯泰特卡(Vaclav Stetka)告诉德国之声，这种“大幅预算削减代表了一种文化破坏行为”。

paras.en: There has also been condemnation of the restriction of the parliamentary debate amid the fast-tracking of the bill.
paras.zh: 在该法案的快速审议过程中，也有人谴责限制议会辩论。

paras.en: "The confrontational approach, the attempts to limit parliamentary debate and the government's rhetoric towards journalists and critics have all contributed to the public backlash," Otto Eibl, political scientist at Masaryk University in Czechia's second city Brno, told DW.
paras.zh: 捷克第二大城市布尔诺马萨里克大学的政治学家奥托·艾布尔（Otto Eibl）告诉德国之声：“对抗性的做法、限制议会辩论的尝试以及政府对记者和批评家的言论都加剧了公众的强烈反对。”

paras.en: What has happened since the bill was fast-tracked?
paras.zh: 自该法案快速通过以来发生了什么？

paras.en: The backlash was immediate. Crowds picketed parliament through the night as the government pushed through the first reading of the bill.
paras.zh: 立即遭到强烈反对。当政府推动该法案的一读时，人群整夜在议会周围聚集。

paras.en: Since then, multiple rallies have taken place in cities and towns across the country. Many of these protests were led by students and joined by unions, Churches and representatives of educational and cultural institutions.
paras.zh: 此后，全国各地城镇多次举行集会。其中许多抗议活动由学生领导，工会、教会以及教育和文化机构的代表也加入其中。

paras.en: CT and CRo staff called a strike in early November, disrupting the country's TV and radio schedules.
paras.zh: CT 和 CRo 工作人员于 11 月初发起罢工，扰乱了该国的电视和广播节目表。

paras.en: It will take place two days before the anniversary of the start of the Velvet Revolution, which ultimately brought down communism in what was then Czechoslovakia in 1989.
paras.zh: 此次活动将在天鹅绒革命爆发周年纪念日前两天举行，这场革命最终于 1989 年推翻了当时的捷克斯洛伐克的共产主义。

paras.en: The civil society group Million Moments for Democracy, which is organizing Sunday's rally, brought an estimated 300,000 onto the streets to protest during Babis's first term as prime minister in 2019 and more than 200,000 earlier this year.
paras.zh: 正在组织周日集会的民间社会组织“民主百万时刻”在巴比什 2019 年担任总理的第一个任期期间吸引了大约 30 万人走上街头抗议，今年早些时候则吸引了超过 20 万人。

paras.en: The government's sudden bid to push through the proposal reflects impatience to deliver on a core pledge made ahead of the October 2025 election, as well as the longstanding ambition of the prime minister, who was stymied in his attempt to engineer control of CT's governing council during his first term in power in 2017–21.
paras.zh: 政府突然试图推动该提案，反映出对兑现 2025 年 10 月选举前做出的核心承诺的不耐烦，以及总理的长期雄心，他在 2017-21 年第一个任期内试图控制 CT 管理委员会的努力受到阻碍。

paras.en: Vaclav Stetka notes that repeated assaults on public media by Czech governments past and present reflect a particular political culture across Europe's post-communist states.
paras.zh: 瓦茨拉夫·斯泰特卡指出，捷克政府过去和现在对公共媒体的反复攻击反映了欧洲后共产主义国家的特殊政治文化。

paras.en: "The political elite has never accepted the independence of public media," he asserted.
paras.zh: “政治精英从未接受公共媒体的独立性，”他断言。

paras.en: In Czechia, however, the public broadcasters have earned special status as cornerstones of democracy.
paras.zh: 然而，在捷克，公共广播公司作为民主的基石赢得了特殊地位。

paras.en: That standing was forged in what became known as the "Czech TV crisis" of 2000–01, when an occupation of CT's studios by staff and mass protests forced the government of the day to back down on a bid to wrest control.
paras.zh: 这一地位是在 2000-01 年所谓的“捷克电视危机”中形成的，当时 CT 工作室被工作人员占领，大规模抗议活动迫使当时的政府放弃了夺取控制权的努力。

paras.en: "The fight over the public service media has become a symbol of the defense of liberal democratic values and institutions," Eibl said.
paras.zh: 艾布尔说：“围绕公共服务媒体的斗争已成为捍卫自由民主价值观和制度的象征。”

paras.en: As anger has swelled, the government has sought to calm the situation. Babis has said that a new proposal, which would see public media funding moved off budget and editorial independence guaranteed, would be drawn up and made available for a full and open debate.
paras.zh: 随着愤怒的加剧，政府试图平息局势。巴比斯表示，将起草一项新提案，并将其提供给全面和公开的辩论，该提案将使公共媒体资金从预算中移出并保证编辑独立性。

paras.en: However, critics remain unimpressed, noting a lack of any detail and the fact that other members of the government appear determined to remain on course.
paras.zh: 然而，批评者仍然不为所动，他们指出缺乏任何细节，而且政府其他成员似乎决心继续前进。

paras.en: Million Moments for Democracy has insisted the pressure must continue.
paras.zh: “百万民主时刻”坚称压力必须持续下去。

paras.en: "Words are worth nothing," the group said. "While people stand up for independent media, the government continues to act as if it owns the country."
paras.zh: 该组织表示：“言语毫无价值。” “当人们支持独立媒体时，政府却继续表现得好像它拥有这个国家一样。”

paras.en: What are the potential risks for the government?
paras.zh: 政府面临哪些潜在风险？

paras.en: With little sign that the opposition will dissipate, the government faces a choice.
paras.zh: 几乎没有迹象表明反对派会消散，政府面临着一个选择。

paras.en: It has the parliamentary majority it needs to push the bill through and defeat any likely vetoes from the upper house Senate and President Petr Pavel.
paras.zh: 它拥有推动该法案通过并击败上议院参议院和总统彼得·帕维尔可能否决的任何可能的否决权所需的议会多数席位。

paras.en: Polls suggest political support for the government has been weakened and could diminish further if the protests expand to include growing frustrations over the cost of living and housing, as happened recently with student-led protests in France and other European countries.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，对政府的政治支持已经被削弱，如果抗议活动扩大到包括对生活和住房成本日益增长的不满，对政府的政治支持可能会进一步减少，就像最近法国和其他欧洲国家学生领导的抗议活动所发生的那样。

paras.en: "The real risk for the government is that the media issue becomes a lightning rod for broader dissatisfaction," said Martin Vokalek of the Prague-based EUROPEUM Institute for European Policy.
paras.zh: 总部位于布拉格的 EUROPEUM 欧洲政策研究所的马丁·沃卡莱克 (Martin Vokalek) 表示：“政府面临的真正风险是媒体问题会引发更广泛的不满。”

paras.en: The PM announced that he will not attend the Velvet Revolution anniversary celebrations on November 17, which are hugely symbolic, in the hope that his absence might "calm the tense situation."
paras.zh: 总理宣布他不会参加11月17日具有巨大象征意义的天鹅绒革命周年庆典，希望他的缺席能够“平息紧张局势”。

paras.en: However, there's little concern that the Czech protests could descend into violence.
paras.zh: 然而，几乎没有人担心捷克的抗议活动可能会演变成暴力。

paras.en: Analysts note that the anger in Czechia remains tightly focused on the public media proposal and continues to be expressed in a similar way to the seismic events of the country's modern history.
paras.zh: 分析人士指出，捷克的愤怒仍然集中在公共媒体的提议上，并继续以与该国现代历史上的地震事件类似的方式表达。

paras.en: "I would not expect French-style scenes," Vokalek told DW, noting that the same "large, peaceful and civic Czech protest culture," which gave the Velvet Revolution and 1993's Velvet Divorce from Slovakia their name, is still strong.
paras.zh: 沃卡莱克告诉德国之声：“我不会期待法国式的场景。”他指出，同样的“大规模、和平和公民的捷克抗议文化”仍然很强大，天鹅绒革命和1993年与斯洛伐克的天鹅绒离婚也因此而得名。

articles.title: UK mosque rebukes comission’s ‘warning’ following Palestine comments

paras.en: The Lewisham Islamic Centre (LIC) in London has rejected a warning issued by the UK’s independent Charity Commission, which reprimanded the mosque for comments on Palestinian suffering made by an imam during October 2023 sermons.
paras.zh: 伦敦刘易舍姆伊斯兰中心 (LIC) 拒绝了英国独立慈善委员会发出的警告，该委员会谴责该清真寺一名伊玛目在 2023 年 10 月布道期间就巴勒斯坦苦难发表的评论。

paras.en: “The matters raised by the Commission represent a troubling attempt to scrutinise, restrict and penalise legitimate religious worship” and “the expression of solidarity with the Palestinian people,” the mosque said in an official statement issued Wednesday.
paras.zh: 该清真寺在周三发布的一份官方声明中表示，“委员会提出的问题是审查、限制和惩罚合法宗教崇拜的令人不安的企图”和“表达对巴勒斯坦人民的声援”。

paras.en: The statement comes after the charity watchdog accused the religious centre of including “content that was inflammatory, divisive and not in the charity’s best interests” during two separate sermons, as they issued an official warning urging the centre to “improve its handling of speakers and events hosted at the charity’s premises” on October 20.
paras.zh: 在此声明发布之前，慈善机构监管机构指责该宗教中心在两次单独的布道中包含“煽动性、分裂性且不符合慈善机构最佳利益的内容”，并于 10 月 20 日发布正式警告，敦促该中心“改进对在慈善机构举办的演讲者和活动的处理”。

paras.en: The commission warned that if the mosque fails to “remedy the misconduct”, it may be subjected to further action.
paras.zh: 该委员会警告说，如果清真寺未能“纠正不当行为”，可能会受到进一步的行动。

paras.en: The mosque also accused the commission of imposing disproportionate expectations on Muslim charities after the warning, describing them as “unnecessarily burdensome”. The religious centre explained that a sermon, or khutbah, is an integral part of Islamic worship and often speaks to the issues affecting the wellbeing of congregations and their communities. The LIC worried that the warning suggested the commission was “entitled to dictate which subjects Imams may address in their khutbahs”.
paras.zh: 该清真寺还指责该委员会在发出警告后对穆斯林慈善机构强加了不成比例的期望，称它们“造成了不必要的负担”。该宗教中心解释说，布道（或称 khutbah）是伊斯兰崇拜的一个组成部分，经常谈论影响会众及其社区福祉的问题。 LIC 担心，该警告表明该委员会“有权规定伊玛目可以在其呼图白中讨论哪些主题”。

paras.en: LIC added that they are currently seeking legal advice as to the best way to move forward following the warning.
paras.zh: LIC 补充说，他们目前正在寻求法律建议，以了解警告后采取行动的最佳方式。

paras.en: CAGE International, a London-based human rights organisation, supported the mosque, and claimed the Charity Commission showed lenience when it came to pro-Israel charities.
paras.zh: 总部位于伦敦的人权组织 CAGE International 支持这座清真寺，并声称慈善委员会在对待亲以色列慈善机构时表现出了宽大处理。

paras.en: “The Commission’s position treats the word ‘Zionist’ as inflammatory in itself,” CAGE said on Thursday. “This merges opposition to a political ideology with hatred of a people, and places Muslim religious expression under suspicion by default.”
paras.zh: “委员会的立场将‘犹太复国主义’这个词本身视为煽动性的，”凯奇周四表示。 “这将对政治意识形态的反对与对人民的仇恨结合在一起，默认情况下会让穆斯林的宗教表达受到怀疑。”

paras.en: “The Commission has told a mosque that naming who is responsible for Palestinian suffering falls outside acceptable religious practice,” a spokesperson for CAGE said. “This is the same regulator asking for the power to remove trustees for their views,” they added, referring to a recent government consultation to expand the Charity Commission’s powers.
paras.zh: CAGE 发言人表示：“委员会已告诉一座清真寺，指出谁应对巴勒斯坦人的苦难负责不符合可接受的宗教习俗。”他们补充说：“这也是同一家监管机构要求有权根据受托人的意见罢免他们。”他们指的是最近政府就扩大慈善委员会权力进行的磋商。

articles.title: Senegal’s wrestlers turn tradition into gold at Dakar Youth Olympics
